allWorkPackages.description:
# Rencana Riset & Test Matrix - Stabilitas WhatsApp Unofficial via Baileys

**Untuk:** Tim Developer SatuInbox  
**Tanggal:** 3 Juni 2026  
**Versi:** Draft 1.1  
**Status:** Untuk dieksekusi & diverifikasi

---

## 1. Ringkasan & Tujuan

Penggunaan WhatsApp unofficial dengan library Baileys di SatuInbox diklaim tidak stabil: nomor yang baru di-scan sering tersuspend, dan beberapa nomor tersuspend setelah mengirim beberapa pesan. Riset ini menstrukturkan gejala menjadi hipotesis yang bisa diuji, mendefinisikan A/B testing yang terukur, serta menetapkan rate limit, logging suspend, dan event log lifecycle account channel.

**Tujuan riset:**

- Mengidentifikasi akar penyebab suspend dengan eksperimen terkontrol, bukan asumsi.
- Memisahkan apakah suspend disebabkan perilaku unofficial automation atau cara pakai/implementasi.
- Menetapkan kebijakan rate limit outbound yang aman untuk SatuInbox.
- Menetapkan skema logging agar setiap suspend bisa dianalisis.
- Menetapkan event log lifecycle account channel: created, init, scan, connected, lifetime, disconnected, suspended.

> Catatan penting: Baileys adalah library unofficial yang mengemulasi WhatsApp Web Multi-Device. Suspend hampir selalu merupakan penegakan anti-spam dari sisi WhatsApp, bukan bug library. "Stabilitas" harus dipahami sebagai meminimalkan sinyal yang memicu deteksi spam, bukan sekadar patch kode.

---

## 2. Kategorisasi Gejala Yang Dilaporkan

| Kode | Gejala | Detail |
| --- | --- | --- |
| G1 | Suspend tepat setelah connect | Sesaat setelah scan QR / connect, nomor langsung tersuspend sebelum atau segera setelah aktivitas. |
| G2 | Suspend setelah kirim beberapa chat | Setelah connect dan mengirim beberapa pesan, nomor tersuspend. |
| G3 | Trigger via broadcast ke nomor asing | Initial message / BC via Baileys ke nomor yang tidak dikenal sender memicu suspend. |
| G4 | Trigger via kirim ke nomor dikenal | Suspend juga muncul saat kirim ke nomor yang sudah dikenal, baik isi sama maupun berbeda. |
| G5 | Suspend sementara (2 jenis) | Bisa suspend di WhatsApp Web atau di mobile device; membatasi pengiriman ke nomor baru, tapi nomor lama masih bisa dikirim. |
| G6 | Broadcast tidak jadi conversation | Dari 5 broadcast hanya 4 yang menjadi conversation; belum diketahui apakah karena pengiriman simultan atau sebab lain. |

---

## 3. Faktor Risiko & Pola Pemicu Suspend

Faktor pemicu dibagi menjadi dua kelompok: pola perilaku pengiriman dan faktor akun/infrastruktur. Bobot di bawah ini bersifat heuristik awal dan wajib dikalibrasi dengan data eksperimen.

### 3.1 Pola Perilaku Pengiriman

| ID | Faktor | Penjelasan | Bobot |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| F1 | Kirim ke nomor baru/asing | First contact ke nomor yang belum pernah berinteraksi. | 3 |
| F2 | New-conversation velocity tinggi | Banyak first-contact unik per jam/hari. | 4 |
| F3 | Volume & kecepatan tinggi tanpa jeda | Ritme pengiriman tidak manusiawi. | 3 |
| F4 | Pesan identik / broadcast | Konten sama dikirim ke banyak penerima. | 2 |
| F5 | Konten berisiko | Link/shortlink, kata kunci promosi sensitif, media forwarded berulang. | 3 |
| F6 | Kirim ke nomor tidak terdaftar WA | Banyak target gagal validasi `onWhatsApp()`. | 2 |
| F7 | Tanpa rate limit / batch | Pengiriman borongan tanpa throttle/jeda. | 3 |
| F8 | Tanpa warm-up | Nomor langsung dipakai outbound volume tinggi. | 2 |
| F9 | Block/report dari penerima | Feedback negatif dari penerima, pengganda risiko terbesar. | 5 |
| F10 | Operasi grup massal | Mass-add ke grup, banyak grup, abuse broadcast list. | 2 |
| F11 | Tanpa engagement dua arah | Pesan keluar tanpa balasan/percakapan. | 2 |

### 3.2 Faktor Akun & Infrastruktur

| ID | Faktor | Penjelasan | Bobot |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| F12 | Nomor cold / baru | Baru didaftarkan atau baru login multi-device. | 3 |
| F13 | Nomor VoIP / virtual | Bukan SIM fisik asli. | 3 |
| F14 | Nomor daur ulang / bekas banned | Reputasi buruk melekat pada nomor. | 4 |
| F15 | IP datacenter / VPN | Tidak menggunakan IP residensial. | 2 |
| F16 | Geolokasi IP != region SIM | Mismatch lokasi server dengan region nomor. | 2 |
| F17 | Profil kosong | Tanpa nama, foto, atau verifikasi business profile. | 1 |
| F18 | Reconnect/re-scan loop & multi-session | Sering putus-sambung, scan QR berulang, atau session paralel. | 2 |
| F19 | Manajemen auth/session buruk | `creds.update` tidak dipersist konsisten. | 2 |
| F20 | Fleet correlation | Banyak nomor identik dari IP/infrastruktur sama. | 3 |
| F21 | Fingerprint/presence tidak manusiawi | Browser/presence statis dan tidak wajar. | 1 |

> Interaksi faktor bersifat multiplikatif, bukan sekadar penjumlahan. Contoh: nomor cold + VoIP + IP datacenter + first-contact massal berisi link akan jauh lebih berisiko daripada masing-masing faktor berdiri sendiri. Block/report mempercepat suspend secara drastis.

---

## 4. Hipotesis Yang Akan Diuji

| ID | Hipotesis | Prediksi jika benar | Test terkait |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| H0 | Suspend bisa terjadi hanya karena proses login/connect tanpa outbound sama sekali. | Nomor tersuspend dalam 24-72 jam meski tidak mengirim pesan. | T0 |
| H1 | Suspend dipicu terutama oleh pengiriman ke nomor baru/tidak dikenal, bukan oleh Baileys itu sendiri. | Kirim hanya ke nomor dikenal lebih stabil daripada ke nomor asing. | T1, T2 |
| H2 | Broadcast ke banyak nomor asing dengan isi identik lebih cepat memicu suspend daripada isi bervariasi. | Personalisasi konten menurunkan suspend rate dibanding konten identik. | T2, T3 |
| H3 | Suspend juga terjadi via WhatsApp Web/HP manual untuk pola yang sama. | Broadcast manual ke nomor baru via WA Web/HP juga bisa kena suspend. | T4, T5 |
| H4 | Volume & kecepatan tinggi tanpa rate limit meningkatkan probabilitas suspend. | Rate limit + jeda acak menurunkan suspend pada volume sama. | T2, T3 |
| H5 | Nomor tanpa warm-up jauh lebih rentan daripada nomor yang dipanaskan bertahap. | Nomor warm-up bertahan lebih lama dan punya batas kirim lebih tinggi. | T7 |
| H6 | Broadcast tidak jadi conversation terkait pengiriman simultan / pesan tertahan filter, bukan sekadar error UI. | Pengiriman bertahap meningkatkan rasio delivered ke conversation. | T6 |
| H7 | Konfigurasi socket memengaruhi ketahanan nomor. | Variasi browser fingerprint / `markOnlineOnConnect` / presence menghasilkan beda suspend rate yang terukur. | T8 |

---

## 5. Rencana A/B Testing & Test Matrix

### 5.1 Variabel Eksperimen

- Channel: SatuInbox (Baileys) vs WhatsApp Web resmi vs HP manual.
- Target penerima: nomor baru/tidak dikenal vs nomor yang sudah dikenal.
- Isi pesan: identik vs dipersonalisasi/bervariasi.
- Volume & rate: tanpa limit vs dengan rate limit + jeda acak.
- Warm-up: nomor cold vs nomor yang sudah di-warm-up.
- Cara broadcast: batch vs drip.
- Aktivitas outbound: connect-only tanpa kirim pesan vs kirim pesan.

### 5.2 Prinsip Metodologi

1. Gunakan beberapa nomor uji yang setara per skenario agar hasil tidak bias satu nomor.
2. Ubah satu variabel pada satu waktu; sisanya dibuat konstan.
3. Sediakan kelompok kontrol dengan volume rendah ke nomor dikenal.
4. Catat `time-to-suspend` dan `jumlah pesan sebelum suspend` sebagai metrik utama.
5. Wajib ada uji manual via WA Web / HP untuk pola yang sama agar efek Baileys vs kebijakan WhatsApp bisa dipisahkan.
6. Gunakan kontak dummy yang dikendalikan tim bila memungkinkan.
7. Definisikan `nomor dikenal` secara konsisten: minimal pernah ada conversation/inbound sebelumnya. Kontak tersimpan dan hasil `onWhatsApp()` dicatat sebagai label terpisah.

### 5.3 Test Matrix

| ID | Hipotesis | Channel | Target | Isi pesan | Volume/Rate | Warm-up | Cara kirim | Ekspektasi |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| T0 | H0 | SatuInbox | N/A | Tidak ada | 0 pesan | Cold | Connect-only | Tidak suspend 24-72 jam |
| T1 | H1 | SatuInbox | Nomor dikenal | Bervariasi | Limit + jeda | Matured | Drip | Stabil (kontrol) |
| T2 | H1,H2 | SatuInbox | Nomor baru | Identik (BC) | Tanpa limit | Cold | Batch | Cepat suspend |
| T3 | H2,H4 | SatuInbox | Nomor baru | Bervariasi | Limit + jeda | Cold | Drip | Lebih tahan dari T2 |
| T4 | H3 | WA Web manual | Nomor baru | Identik (BC) | Manual | Cold | Batch | Bandingkan vs T2 |
| T5 | H3 | HP manual | Nomor baru | Identik (BC) | Manual | Cold | Batch | Bandingkan vs T2/T4 |
| T6 | H6 | SatuInbox | Nomor baru | Identik | Limit | Cold | Drip | Cek rasio delivered ke conversation |
| T7 | H5 | SatuInbox | Nomor baru | Bervariasi | Warm-up schedule | Warm-up bertahap | Drip | Bertahan lebih lama |
| T8 | H7 | SatuInbox | Nomor baru | Bervariasi | Limit + jeda | Cold | Drip | Beda config = beda hasil |

> Untuk G6, bedakan Broadcast List native WhatsApp dengan fan-out SatuInbox. Broadcast List native WhatsApp hanya diterima oleh penerima yang menyimpan nomor sender; ini bisa menjelaskan kasus 5 BC hanya 4 yang menjadi conversation.

---

## 6. Usulan Rate Limiting Outbound

Rate limit outbound sangat disarankan. Usulan parameter awal:

- Jeda antar pesan acak (jitter), mis. 8-40 detik.
- Batas per jam & per hari yang naik bertahap sesuai umur/warm-up nomor.
- Batas khusus untuk pesan ke nomor baru yang jauh lebih ketat daripada ke nomor dikenal.
- Drip, bukan batch.
- Presence sebagai variabel eksperimen: uji `sendPresenceUpdate('composing')` dan jeda mengetik pada T8, jangan diasumsikan efektif sebelum ada data.
- Hormati hasil `onWhatsApp()`; jangan kirim ke nomor invalid.
- Circuit breaker: jika terdeteksi error/disconnect tertentu, hentikan outbound otomatis untuk nomor itu.

### 6.1 Contoh Jadwal Warm-up Awal

| Hari | Maks pesan/hari | Maks ke nomor baru/hari |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1-2 | 10-20 | 0-5 |
| 3-7 | 20-40 | 5-10 |
| 8-14 | 40-80 | 10-20 |
| 15+ | 80-150+ | 20-40 |

> Angka ini hanya baseline konservatif dan wajib dikalibrasi dengan data eksperimen.

---

## 7. Spesifikasi Logging Suspend

Setiap disconnect/suspend harus dilog dengan konteks lengkap. Di Baileys, sinyal utama datang dari event `connection.update` melalui `lastDisconnect.error`, `output.statusCode`, atau `DisconnectReason`.

Field minimum yang perlu dicatat:

- `event_id`, `timestamp`
- `account_channel_id`
- `disconnect_reason`
- `status_code`
- `raw_error`
- `suspend_type`
- `last_actions`
- `recipient_hashes`
- `message_fingerprint`
- `msgs_sent_in_window`
- `msgs_to_new_numbers`
- `time_since_connect`
- `socket_config`

Catatan privacy:

- Hindari menyimpan nomor dan isi pesan mentah di log operasional.
- Gunakan hash/fingerprint untuk recipient dan konten.
- Simpan raw payload hanya untuk window investigasi terbatas.

---

## 8. Event Log Lifecycle Account Channel

### 8.1 Lifecycle Channel

| Event | Definisi |
| --- | --- |
| `created` | Record account channel dibuat di sistem. |
| `init` | Inisialisasi socket Baileys / persiapan auth state. |
| `scan` | QR/pairing code di-generate & proses scan. |
| `connected` | Koneksi berhasil (`connection = 'open'`). |
| `lifetime` | Durasi connected -> disconnected. |
| `disconnected` | Koneksi putus (`connection = 'close'`). |
| `suspended` | Terdeteksi dibatasi/suspend oleh WhatsApp. |

`disconnected` dan `suspended` harus dibedakan. Disconnect bisa terjadi karena restart, jaringan, atau session issue tanpa suspend.

### 8.2 Event Outbound Message

| Event | Definisi |
| --- | --- |
| `outbound_queued` | Pesan masuk antrean pengiriman. |
| `outbound_rate_limited` | Pesan ditahan oleh rate limiter. |
| `outbound_sent` | Pesan berhasil dikirim ke socket Baileys. |
| `outbound_delivered` | Ack delivered diterima jika tersedia. |
| `outbound_read` | Ack read diterima jika tersedia. |
| `outbound_failed` | Pengiriman gagal sebelum/selama proses kirim. |

### 8.3 Event Broadcast / Fan-out

| Event | Definisi |
| --- | --- |
| `broadcast.started` | Batch broadcast mulai dibuat/dijalankan. |
| `broadcast.recipient_queued` | Recipient masuk antrean broadcast. |
| `broadcast.recipient_sent` | Pesan broadcast terkirim ke recipient. |
| `broadcast.recipient_failed` | Pengiriman ke recipient gagal. |
| `broadcast.completed` | Batch selesai atau dihentikan. |

---

## 9. Metrik Keberhasilan

- Time-to-suspend.
- Suspend rate per skenario.
- Delivered-to-conversation ratio.
- Survival per warm-up tier.
- Perbandingan channel: SatuInbox vs WA Web vs HP pada pola identik.

---

## 10. Decision Gate Interpretasi Hasil

| Kondisi hasil riset | Interpretasi | Keputusan yang disarankan |
| --- | --- | --- |
| WA Web/HP manual juga suspend pada pola yang sama | Risiko berasal dari policy/behavior WhatsApp | Batasi cold outbound/broadcast; prioritaskan WhatsApp Business API resmi |
| Hanya SatuInbox/Baileys yang suspend | Risiko kemungkinan dari implementasi/session | Audit socket config, auth lifecycle, queue, rate limit, dan retry logic |
| T0 connect-only suspend | Masalah mungkin dari nomor, session, atau login | Jangan lanjut outbound; isolasi nomor dan ulangi dengan nomor pembanding |
| Rate limit + drip menurunkan suspend signifikan | Volume/rate adalah trigger dominan | Jadikan queue, jitter, dan circuit breaker sebagai default produksi |
| Delivered tinggi tapi conversation rendah | Masalah metrik/conversation atau aturan broadcast | Audit ack, definisi conversation, dan syarat kontak menyimpan sender |
| Suspend tetap tinggi meski guardrail diterapkan | Use case tidak cocok untuk Baileys unofficial | Hentikan use case outbound skala besar; migrasi ke channel resmi |

---

## 11. Risiko & Catatan Kepatuhan

Baileys tidak berafiliasi dengan WhatsApp dan tidak direkomendasikan untuk spam, bulk, atau automated messaging. Penggunaan unofficial berisiko melanggar Terms of Service WhatsApp, dan suspend/ban adalah konsekuensi yang melekat. Riset ini bertujuan meminimalkan risiko operasional dan memahami perilaku sistem, bukan menjamin kekebalan. Tim juga perlu mengevaluasi opsi WhatsApp Business API / Cloud API resmi untuk use case broadcast/notifikasi berskala.

---

## 12. Langkah Berikutnya

1. Siapkan nomor uji + kontak dummy yang dikendalikan tim.
2. Implementasikan logging suspend dan event log channel terlebih dulu.
3. Jalankan test matrix, satu variabel per waktu, termasuk uji manual WA Web/HP.
4. Kalibrasi rate limit & warm-up dari hasil eksperimen.
5. Review temuan memakai decision gate dan putuskan kebijakan outbound final.

---

allWorkPackages.description:
## Background
Traced directly from `conversation-service` auto-pull code (not from a pre-existing report). Three concrete gaps found and confirmed against source:

1. **Cron drains too slowly**: the 15-minute auto-pull cron assigns exactly one unassigned conversation per team per cycle, regardless of how many eligible agents are idle or how large the backlog is. A 100-conversation backlog behind 3 idle agents would take ~25 hours to clear.
2. **Self-pull has no capacity check**: `pullConversations` (the "give me conversations" self-pull endpoint) never checks `maxConversation` at all — a client-supplied `limit` is honored verbatim even if it exceeds the agent's remaining slots.
3. **Check-then-act race**: the auto-pull burst paths (login/close) and the single-conversation auto-pull path read "is there a free slot" and then assign with no locking, so two concurrent triggers for the same agent can both pass the slot check before either commits — allowing an agent to be handed more conversations than their configured `maxConversation`.

## Fix
- Cron now drains a team's backlog across all its eligible members each cycle, bounded by a new per-team safety cap (`AUTO_PULL_TEAM_BATCH_LIMIT`).
- Every assignment path that decides "does this agent have room" (self-pull, login/close burst, cron, and the existing single-new-conversation event trigger) does the final check inside a short-lived per-member Redis lock, immediately before the write.
- Self-pull's `limit` is clamped server-side to the agent's actual remaining slots.

## Scope
Implemented per `.claude/PRPs/plans/auto-pull-cron-team-distribution-and-slot-guard.plan.md` — see that plan for the full task breakdown, patterns mirrored, and test plan (14 new tests in `conversation.service.spec.ts`, 5 new tests in a new `auto-pull-cron.service.spec.ts`).

Retroactively filed — implementation was underway before a ticket existed for this work.

# QA notes :

# **Recap Incident Report**

## **Incident:**

##  `**GET /conversation**` 

## **dan**

##  `**GET /conversation/count**` 

## **pending / melambat pada konteks v2.7.0**

##   

## **1\. Ringkasan singkat**

Setelah investigasi awal, masalah **bukan terlihat berasal dari perubahan langsung pada query list conversation** antara v2.6.1 dan v2.7.0. Perbandingan code menunjukkan pipeline utama `/conversation` **tidak berubah secara signifikan**.

Indikasi saat ini mengarah ke kombinasi:

1.  **refetch / invalidation storm di FE**
    
2.  **latency backend, terutama di** `**/conversation/count**`
    
3.  kemungkinan **write contention** dari perubahan side-effect v2.7.0 (mention/LID/Baileys), bukan perubahan query list itu sendiri.
    

## **2\. Gejala yang dilaporkan**

Dari observasi incident:

*   request `GET /conversation` dan `GET /conversation/count` terlihat **pending lama**
    
*   behavior ini muncul di halaman conversation/list
    
*   pola yang terlihat lebih mirip **storm** daripada 1 request lambat tunggal
    
*   target investigasi saat ini: apakah bottleneck utamanya di:
    
    *   FE refetch storm
        
    *   BE read latency
        
    *   write contention dari inbound processing
        
    *   atau gabungan semuanya
        

## **3\. Kronologi investigasi**

### **Tahap 1 — Compare v2.6.1 vs v2.7.0**

Dilakukan perbandingan source code FE dan BE.

### **Hasil compare**

**Tidak ditemukan perubahan langsung** pada jalur utama query list conversation:

*   `getPaginatedConversation`
    
*   `buildConversationPipeline`
    
*   `buildAtlasSearchPipelineStage`
    
*   `buildLookupPipeline`
    
*   `buildLatestMessageReplyPipeline`
    
*   FE `getConversations()` dan query key juga tetap
    

### **Kesimpulan tahap ini**

Masalah **kemungkinan bukan karena query** `**/conversation**` **diubah**, tetapi dari **side-effect perubahan lain di v2.7.0**.

## **4\. Perubahan besar yang ditemukan di v2.7.0**

### **Backend**

Perubahan yang relevan:

*   **Global Search** baru
    
*   **WhatsApp mention / @all**
    
*   `unreadMentionCount` di conversation
    
*   `lid` pada contact info
    
*   `assignSource` pada participant info
    
*   `memberLids` / update `memberContactInfo`
    
*   upgrade **Baileys**
    
*   logic resolusi LID / structured payload baru
    
*   tambahan beban write dan processing inbound message
    

### **Frontend**

Perubahan yang relevan:

*   Global Search modal
    
*   mention badge di ConversationCard
    
*   `useUpdateLatestMessage` sekarang hitung `hasAccountChannelMention`
    
*   render message type lebih banyak
    
*   ada peluang refetch / rerender makin berat saat traffic message ramai
    

## **5\. Hipotesis awal yang sempat dibentuk**

Hipotesis awal ada 5:

1.  payload bloat response `/conversation`
    
2.  write churn dari mention/LID logic
    
3.  Global Search interference
    
4.  FE rerender / invalidation overhead
    
5.  perubahan perilaku event dari Baileys

allWorkPackages.description:
# Change Intake Brief: New External Channel Add-on — TikTok / Tokopedia > **Artifact Type:** Change Intake Brief > **Source Request / BRD:** Current chat — brainstorming requirement before BRD > **Artifact Path:** `Assessments/cross-domain/new-external-channel-add-on/new-external-channel-add-on-change-intake-brief.md` > **Version:** `v1.0` > **Previous Version:** `none` > **Rules Applied:** `Rules/requirements-lifecycle-rule.md`, `Rules/workflow-rule.md`, `Rules/impact-analysis-rule.md`, `Rules/structure-rule.md` > **Supporting Context:** `Memory/global-memory.md`, `Memory/reference-index.md`, `Memory/CLAUDE-fe.md`, `Memory/CLAUDE-be.md`, multi-agent brainstorming/review output from current session > **Tanggal Intake:** 2026-07-30 > **Owner / Author:** Dany Christian > **Engineering Lead:** Naftal Yunior > **Status:** Draft — Hold Needs Discovery before BRD ## 0\. Ringkasan Update Brief * Initial Phase 0 brief dibuat untuk request penambahan channel baru SatuInbox dari TikTok / Tokopedia sebelum BRD. * Scope awal dipisah menjadi: TikTok Shop Chat, Tokopedia Buyer-Seller Chat, dan TikTok DM/Social discovery track. * Routing decision: `SPLIT_REQUEST` + `HOLD_NEEDS_DISCOVERY`, karena API/partner access dan capability matrix belum verified. ## 1\. Request Snapshot **Request Summary:** SatuInbox ingin menambah channel baru dari platform TikTok dan Tokopedia. User meminta brainstorming requirement generic terlebih dahulu, melihat area requirement apa saja yang perlu disiapkan sebelum dibuat BRD. **Business Problem:** Customer support / seller operations perlu mengelola percakapan marketplace/social dari TikTok dan Tokopedia di SatuInbox, bukan berpindah platform satu per satu. **Target User / Role / Stakeholder:** * Seller / merchant user yang menghubungkan toko/platform ke SatuInbox. * Agent customer support yang membalas chat buyer/customer. * Supervisor / team lead yang memantau assignment, SLA, dan channel workload. * Admin / owner yang mengelola connection, billing/add-on, dan channel health. * Engineering / support internal yang memonitor webhook, token, retry, dan failure. **Expected Outcome:** * SatuInbox punya baseline requirement untuk external channel add-on. * TikTok Shop Chat dan Tokopedia Buyer-Seller Chat dipahami sebagai commerce chat yang bisa reuse UI shell, tetapi tidak boleh disamakan di integration contract. * TikTok DM/Social diperlakukan sebagai scope terpisah sampai API feasibility jelas. * BRD berikutnya tidak membawa assumption platform yang belum verified. **Urgency / Why Now:** Discovery diperlukan sebelum BRD agar scope tidak melebar, estimate tidak keliru, dan dependency partner/API access terdeteksi lebih awal. ## 2\. Change Classification ### Classification Rationale * Request mencampur beberapa channel dan beberapa platform API dalam satu kebutuhan besar. * TikTok Shop Chat dan Tokopedia Buyer-Seller Chat sama-sama commerce-chat secara product surface, tetapi beda auth, webhook, event payload, rate limit, identity, media capability, dan support model. * TikTok DM/Social adalah social-inbox use case, bukan marketplace commerce chat. Feasibility API perlu dibuktikan dulu. * Scope menyentuh shared entity dan pipeline penting: `Platform`, `Channel`, `AccountChannel`, contact identity, conversation room, webhook ingestion, outbound sending, billing add-on, observability, QA regression. ## 3\. Current State Verification ### 3.1 PRD Status ### 3.2 Implementation Status ### 3.3 Related Sources * `Memory/global-memory.md`: Conversation Room capability matrix note, channel/account-channel capability dependency, chat list/channel filters, contact currently phone-oriented baseline. * `Memory/reference-index.md`: no direct TikTok/Tokopedia reference listed. * `Memory/CLAUDE-fe.md`: FE settings channels path, conversation route, Socket.IO, API hooks/state management. * `Memory/CLAUDE-be.md`: BE channel-service, conversation-service, RabbitMQ, gRPC, API Gateway, media-service, payment-service, existing per-channel service pattern. ## 4\. Scope Boundary ### 4.1 In Scope — Phase 0 Discovery * Confirm API/partner feasibility for: * TikTok Shop Chat * Tokopedia Buyer-Seller Chat * TikTok DM/Social * Build capability matrix per platform: * inbound text * outbound text * image/media support * file support * read receipt * typing indicator * order context * webhook push * polling fallback * historical sync * outbound restriction / reply window * rate limit * Define common product shell: * Settings channel onboarding * Inbox list display/filter * Room chat render * Detail panel external context * capability-aware composer * Define integration backbone requirement: * platform registry / enum * account-channel connection state * adapter per platform * webhook normalization * idempotency * outbound status pipeline * token lifecycle * Define identity/thread model: * customer identity key * shop/store/account scope * external thread key * order-linked vs non-order conversation * Define operational readiness: * channel health dashboard * structured logs * retry/replay tooling * support runbook * Define QA matrix and rollout plan. ### 4.2 In Scope — Candidate Phase 1 Product Recommended candidate after discovery: 1. **Shared External Channel Foundation** * platform registry * connection state machine * webhook normalization * capability gating * observability baseline 2. **TikTok Shop Chat Add-on** * commerce chat only * inbound/outbound text * basic media if API supports * basic order context if API provides 3. **Tokopedia Buyer-Seller Chat Add-on** * commerce chat only * inbound/outbound text * basic media/file if API supports * basic order link/context if API provides ### 4.3 Out of Scope — Until Separate Decision * TikTok DM/Social committed delivery, unless official API feasibility is confirmed. * Full order management / fulfillment / dispute handling. * Cross-platform contact merge between TikTok and Tokopedia. * Social listening, comment moderation, live chat/live commerce stream handling. * Broadcast/bulk messaging for marketplace/social channels. * Bot/automation triggers specific to dispute, seller score, pickup reminder, product catalog, etc. * Deep analytics per marketplace beyond baseline conversation volume/SLA. * Scraping or non-compliant integration path. ### 4.4 Protected Existing Behavior * Existing WhatsApp / Instagram / Messenger / Email / Widget channel behavior must not regress. * Existing Conversation list filters, assignment, room status (`open`/`closed`), internal notes, search scope, and RBAC visibility must stay valid. * Existing Contact behavior must not auto-merge external platform identities incorrectly. * Existing media limits / room attachment behavior must stay channel-capability aware. * Existing billing/add-on flows must not be bypassed for paid channel activation. * Existing notification fan-out must not become company-wide noise for user-specific chat events. ## 5\. Early Impact Flags ### Early Blast-Radius Notes * **Direct modules:** Settings Channels, Conversation Inbox, Conversation Room, Conversation Detail, Channel Service, API Gateway, Conversation Service, Media Service, Notification Service, Payment/Add-on, Analytics. * **Indirect modules:** Contact/People identity, RBAC/visibility, Socket.IO, RabbitMQ consumers, audit logs, support/admin tools. * **High-risk dependency:** external platform API approval and capability matrix. Without this, BRD scope cannot be committed safely. ## 6\. Visual Scope Map













API feasible API not feasible New External Channel Add-on Shared External Channel Foundation Platform Registry / Capability Matrix AccountChannel Connection State Webhook Normalization + Idempotency Outbound Status Pipeline Observability + Support Tools TikTok Shop Chat Tokopedia Buyer-Seller Chat TikTok DM/Social Commerce Chat UI Reuse TikTok Shop Adapter Tokopedia Adapter Discovery Gate Separate Social Inbox Scope Hold / Do Not Commit ## 7\. Routing Decision ### Routing Rationale * Split is required because one request contains multiple platform products and risk profiles. * Hold is required because official API access, webhook model, auth model, and capability matrix are not verified yet. * BRD can start as discovery/business framing, but cannot be finalized until partner/API feasibility is confirmed. ## 8\. Recommended Scope Split ## 9\. Requirement Buckets For Future BRD ### 9.1 Business / Partnership Requirements * Confirm official API access path per platform. * Confirm partner approval / app review / production go-live requirement. * Confirm rate-limit tier and support SLA. * Confirm allowed use cases: inbox read, outbound reply, media, order context, automation/bot rules. * Confirm data retention/deletion policy from platform. ### 9.2 Onboarding / Connection Requirements * Connect platform from Settings > Channels/Add-on. * OAuth/authorization callback or platform-specific credential flow. * Multi-shop/store binding decision. * Connection status display and reconnect flow. * Disconnect flow with data retention behavior. ### 9.3 Conversation Product Requirements * Platform icon and channel filter. * Shop/store filter if multi-store is in scope. * Inbox preview and unread handling. * Room chat text/media rendering. * Capability-aware composer. * Basic order/context panel for commerce chat if platform provides. * Unsupported message fallback. ### 9.4 Backend / Integration Requirements * Adapter per platform. * Normalized inbound event contract. * Outbound command/status contract. * Webhook signature verification. * Idempotency / dedupe. * Token refresh / expiry / revoked handling. * Poll reconciliation if webhook delivery is incomplete. ### 9.5 Data Requirements * `platform + accountChannelId + externalCustomerId` as external identity baseline. * `platform + accountChannelId + externalThreadId` as thread baseline. * External order/context object kept separate from core message schema where practical. * Tokens/secrets encrypted at rest. * Raw payload retained only for limited debug window. ### 9.6 Ops / Observability Requirements * Webhook success/failure metrics. * Outbound success/failure metrics. * Token refresh failure metric. * Queue backlog / retry / dead-letter monitoring. * Last webhook/sync timestamp per account-channel. * Support tool for recent errors and safe replay. ### 9.7 QA Requirements * Connect/reconnect/disconnect flows. * Inbound message creation. * Outbound text/media success/failure. * Duplicate webhook prevention. * Out-of-order event handling. * Same buyer different shop/store. * Unsupported content fallback. * Feature flag / kill switch behavior. * Regression: conversation list, room, detail, assignment, notifications, billing/add-on. ## 10\. Blocking Questions & Decisions Needed ## 11\. Approval / Alignment Targets ## 12\. Downstream Reuse Map ## 13\. Readiness To Move Beyond Phase 0 ### Locked * Request is a new external channel add-on initiative. * TikTok Shop Chat and Tokopedia Buyer-Seller Chat should not be treated as the same technical integration. * TikTok DM/Social should be separate discovery track. * Shared foundation is needed before or alongside per-platform delivery. * Phase 0 artifact path is established in `Assessments/cross-domain/new-external-channel-add-on/`. ### Still Open * Official API/partner access for each platform. * Final capability matrix per platform. * Phase 1 sequencing. * Multi-shop/store scope. * Order context depth. * SLA/reporting/billing inclusion. ### Risk If Moving To BRD Now * BRD may overcommit TikTok DM/Social without API feasibility. * Estimate may undercount adapter complexity. * UI may assume unsupported media/actions. * Data model may accidentally merge external customer identities incorrectly. * Production support may lack webhook/token health visibility. ### Recommendation Proceed only to **discovery-backed BRD skeleton** or complete the blocking discovery first. Do not finalize implementation-ready BRD until OQ-01 through OQ-07 are answered. ## 14\. Change Log

allWorkPackages.subject: Ticket List - No Success/Error Feedback and Failed Chip Removal on Inline Update (Assignee & Tag)

### **Jam.dev Evidence**

*   Jam.dev Link: [https://jam.dev/c/22ded288-5067-43f6-87b4-883a36c8295b](https://jam.dev/c/22ded288-5067-43f6-87b4-883a36c8295b)
    

### **Description**

There are UX and functional issues in the **Ticket List inline update feature**, specifically when updating and **removing values via chips (X icon)** for **Assignee (Penanggung Jawab)** and **Tag (Penanda)**.

Currently, inline updates and chip removals provide **no success or error feedback**, and in some cases, **chip removal does not work at all**. Users must refresh the page to confirm whether changes were applied.

### **Steps to Reproduce**

1.  Navigate to the **Ticket List** page
    
2.  Focus on the **data table**
    
3.  Perform an **inline update** on:
    
    *   **Assignee (Penanggung Jawab)** column
        
    *   **Tag (Penanda)** column
        
4.  Try to **remove an assignee or tag** by clicking the **X icon** on the chip
    
5.  Observe the system response
    

### **Actual Result**

*   **Inline update (add/change)**:
    
    *   No **success popup/toast** when the update succeeds
        
    *   No **error popup/toast** when the update fails
        
*   **Chip removal (X icon)**:
    
    *   No **success or error feedback** is shown
        
    *   In some cases, the chip is **not removed**
        
    *   Users must **refresh the page** to verify the result
        
*   There is no clear indication whether the action was processed successfully
    

### **Expected Result**

*   For **inline updates (add/change)**:
    
    *   Show a **success popup/toast** when the update succeeds
        
    *   Show an **error popup/toast** when the update fails
        
    *   No page reload should be required
        
*   For **chip removal (X icon)**:
    
    *   The assignee or tag should be **removed successfully**
        
    *   A **success popup/toast** should be shown upon successful removal
        
    *   An **error popup/toast** should be shown if removal fails
        
*   The UI should always provide **clear feedback** for both add/update and remove actions
    

### **Affected Environment (Bug Found)**

*    \[ \]  Dev
    

*   [ ] Staging
*   [ ] Prod

### **Tested Environment**

*   [x] Dev
*   [ ] Staging
*   [ ] Prod [https://jam.dev/c/7867760e-f1d9-458b-b6ef-eb397809c120](https://jam.dev/c/7867760e-f1d9-458b-b6ef-eb397809c120) di penanda add dan edit tidak update langsung dengan yang ada detail seharusnya melakukan get data setelah keluar dari opsi dropdown dengan ditandai onblur

### **Additional Notes**

*   The issue may be caused by:
    
    *   Missing UI feedback handling for inline update and delete actions
        
    *   API responses not being reflected in the UI state
        
    *   Delete (remove) action not properly triggered on chip interaction
        
*   These issues impact:
    
    *   User confidence in inline editing
        
    *   Data accuracy
        
    *   Overall UX efficiency in Ticket List management

allWorkPackages.description:
# Description : * Data dari IT Support alasan banned kebanyakan karena * Ada beberapa broadcast ke kirim 1-2 kali dalam waktu bersamaan * Ada aktivitas copy paste cepat dari user user TLC
# **PRODUCT REQUIREMENT DOCUMENT** **Feature**: WhatsApp Web Outbound Anti-Ban Guard **Product Lead**: Dany Christian **Engineering Lead**: Naftal Yunior **Design Lead**: ## **1\. Revision History** ## **2\. Overview** ### **Scope Definition** ## **3\. Problem Statement** ## **4\. Objectives and Key Results** ## **5\. User Stories and Acceptance Criteria** ### **Admin / Authorized Log Viewer** ### **Operator / TLC User** ### **IT Support** ## **6\. Functional Requirements** ## **7\. Error Handling** ## **8\. Edge Cases** ## **9\. UI & UX Requirements** **UI copy (Bahasa Indonesia only):** * “Pesan serupa sudah sedang diproses.” * “Pesan yang sama masih sedang ditangani oleh sistem broadcast.” * “Pengiriman ulang manual dibatasi sementara. Tunggu hingga cooldown selesai.” * “Akun pengirim dibatasi. Pengiriman dihentikan sementara.” * “Status pengiriman sedang diverifikasi.” * “Terdapat indikasi duplikasi pengiriman broadcast. Sistem sedang menandai data investigasi.” ## **10\. Field & Validation** ## **11\. State Transition Model** ## **12\. Permission Matrix** Server-side enforcement is mandatory. UI hiding alone is not sufficient. ## **13\. API / Event Contract** Unknown fields in internal payloads SHOULD be ignored by consumers unless explicitly marked required. ## **14\. Detailed Backend Evaluation Flow** ### **14.1 Broadcast Protection Context Creation** When a system-managed broadcast creates or processes a recipient-level delivery attempt, backend creates or updates a **broadcast protection context** containing at minimum: * tenantId * channel * recipientFingerprint * optional conversationId * senderAccountId * broadcastJobId / broadcast reference * contentFingerprint / normalized text fingerprint * broadcast state (`QUEUED`, `PROCESSING`, `RETRYING`, `RECONCILIATION_PENDING`, `SENT_RECENT`, `FAILED_FINAL`) * recentProtectionUntil * dispatchCorrelationId * timestamps This context is the lookup source for later manual room-send evaluation. ### **14.2 Manual Room Send Intake** When FE submits a manual room send, backend receives: * core send payload (tenant, recipient, conversation, sender, text) * `dispatchSource = manual_room_send` * optional FE behavioral context when available: * `pasteDetected` * `sourceMessageAction` * `sourceMessageId` * `sourceMessageOrigin` * `sendFromCopiedMessage` ### **14.3 Normalization and Fingerprint** Backend normalizes text using canonical text normalization rules and produces a deterministic fingerprint. Normalization policy must be centrally shared across all validating services and workers. ### **14.4 Related Broadcast Lookup** Before dispatch, backend searches for a related broadcast protection context using priority: 1. same `conversationId` when available 2. otherwise same `recipientFingerprint` 3. constrained by same `tenantId` and same `channel` 4. optional stronger filter by `senderAccountId` where applicable 5. broadcast state still active or recent inside protection window ### **14.5 Evidence Evaluation** Backend evaluates evidence in this order: 1. **Strong FE-origin evidence** * `sourceMessageOrigin = broadcast` * or `sendFromCopiedMessage = true` * or `sourceMessageAction = copy_message` with broadcast-linked source 2. **Exact / normalized exact text match** against protected broadcast context 3. **Similarity suspicion only** for same-intent but non-exact message, if enabled as observe-only logic ### **14.6 Classifier Result** Backend assigns one classifier result: * `SYSTEM_BROADCAST_SEND` * `NORMAL_MANUAL_SEND` * `COPY_PASTE_BROADCAST_CONFIRMED` * `MANUAL_BROADCAST_RESEND_MATCHED` * `MANUAL_BROADCAST_RESEND_SUSPECTED` ### **14.7 Decisioning** Backend maps classifier + broadcast state + rollout mode to action: * allow * allow with warning * queue / delay * block ### **14.8 Trace Persistence** Every evaluated request persists: * classifier result * decision * reason code * related broadcast reference if any * correlation ID * dispatch source * FE behavior context presence / absence * evidence path used for decision ### **14.9 Existing-Code Adaptation Constraint** Implementation SHOULD be inserted into the existing send pipeline as a pre-dispatch evaluation layer, not as a separate end-user workflow. Existing FE send flow, worker dispatch flow, and audit logging flow should be reused wherever possible. ## **15\. Decision Rules** ### **15.1 Classifier Rules** ### **15.2 Action Rules** ### **15.3 Similar-Intent Rule** Phase 1 enforcement MUST remain limited to exact or normalized exact text comparison plus FE-origin copied-message evidence. Current-state architecture (verified) ### 2.1 The two outbound paths converge at one socket Both paths terminate at the same per-`channelAccountId` `BaileysService` instance and call `sock.sendMessage()`. **Manual (UI) room send** ``` FE → api-gateway (HTTP) → conversation-service (gRPC) → conversation-service outbound flow → WhatsAppWebAdapter.sendMessage() → RMQ .send(WHATSAPP_SEND_MESSAGE, MessageOutboundDto) ← request/response, firstValueFrom, NO client timeout → whatsapp app.controller @MessagePattern(WHATSAPP_SEND_MESSAGE) → SessionService.getSession(channelAccountId) → BaileysService.sendMessage() ``` - Adapter: [`apps/conversation-service/src/app/adapters/whatsapp-web.adapter.ts:45`](../backend/apps/conversation-service/src/app/adapters/whatsapp-web.adapter.ts#L45) — `clientWhatsappWebAsync.send(WHATSAPP_SEND_MESSAGE, payload)` wrapped in `firstValueFrom`. **No RxJS timeout** → an awaited send blocks until the whatsapp side replies. - DTO: `MessageOutboundDto` ([`libs/common/src/lib/dto/index.ts:342`](../backend/libs/common/src/lib/dto/index.ts#L342)) — carries `messageId`, `channelAccountId`, `clientContactId`, `platformType`, `type`, `content`, reply/threading fields, attachments. **No behavioral-context fields** (`pasteDetected`, `sourceMessageId`, `sourceMessageOrigin`, …) exist yet → FR-014 requires extending this DTO (or a sibling). **System broadcast send** ``` FE → api-gateway → broadcast-service (create campaign) → broadcast-service processors (broadcast.processor / broadcast-retry / broadcast-dlq) → Redis per-sender pacing at schedule time → BroadcastWhatsAppWebAdapter.sendBroadcastMessage() → RMQ .send(WHATSAPP_BROADCAST_MESSAGE, BroadcastMessageDto) → whatsapp app.controller @MessagePattern(WHATSAPP_BROADCAST_MESSAGE) → SessionService.getSession(channelAccountId) → BaileysService.sendBroadcastMessage() ``` - Adapter: [`apps/broadcast-service/src/app/adapters/whatsapp-web.adapter.ts:42`](../backend/apps/broadcast-service/src/app/adapters/whatsapp-web.adapter.ts#L42). - Broadcast state machine (existing): `BroadcastStatusEnum` = `RAW, TEXT_PROCESSING, TEXT_PROCESSED, PENDING, PROCESSING, RETRY, SCHEDULE, SENT, DELIVERED, FAILED, INVALID, CANCELED` (verified in [`apps/broadcast-service/src/app/constants/status.constant.ts`](../backend/apps/broadcast-service/src/app/constants/status.constant.ts)). Schemas: `broadcast.schema.ts`, `broadcast-batch.schema.ts`. Retry/DLQ processors already exist. - Broadcast pacing is computed **at schedule time in `broadcast-service` Redis and is blind to UI sends** — the core PRD problem (PS-001/PS-002). ### 2.2 RabbitMQ delivery semantics (verified) - Global prefetch default `RABBITMQ_PREFETCH=10` (`libs/common` rabbit-mq config). Up to 10 messages per consumer process concurrently. - The whatsapp consumer uses `createRabbitMQMicroservice` → **NestJS auto-ack (`noAck`)**: the broker considers the message delivered on receipt, so the whatsapp side is immune to `consumer_timeout` and head-of-line blocking from a slow send. - The conversation-service outbound consumer uses **manual ack** (`channel.ack`, retry-on-throw, prefetch 10). This is the real back-pressure point: a message held un-acked while awaiting a slow downstream is bounded by RabbitMQ `consumer_timeout` (~30 min default). This is why Phase 0 added a time-based admission cap (§4). ### 2.3 Audit / observability today (gap) - `audit-service` exposes a **single** gRPC method: `AuditService.LogEvent(LogEventRequest)` with fields `userId, action, resource, ipAddress, timestamp, metadata: map` (verified [`proto/audit.proto`](../backend/proto/audit.proto)). - This is **too thin** for the PRD: it has no first-class concept of `reasonCode`, `dispatchCorrelationId`, `recipientFingerprint`, `contentFingerprint`, `classifierResult`, `dispatchSource`, attempt lineage, or queryable filters. The PRD audit log (FR-029..031, §13 `GET /api/wa/outbound/anti-ban/logs`) needs a structured, indexed, queryable store with permission-scoped reads. - **Decision (§5):** the anti-ban capability owns its own rich audit/trace collection. The thin `audit-service.LogEvent` may optionally receive a coarse mirror event for the global activity feed, but is **not** the system of record for anti-ban traceability. ### 2.4 What does NOT exist yet (confirmed absent) - No idempotency-key store, no recipient-level distributed lock, no reconciliation state, no classifier, no broadcast-protection-context lookup, no sender safe-mode state machine, no `POST /api/wa/outbound/validate` endpoint, no anti-ban audit collection or dashboard. All of these are net-new. - No shared text-normalization / content-fingerprint utility in `libs/common` (Phase 0 computes a sha256 fingerprint locally inside the whatsapp service only — it must be lifted to `libs/common` per FR §14.3 "normalization policy must be centrally shared"). --- ## 3. Target architecture ### 3.1 Where the pre-dispatch validation layer lives The PRD's `POST /api/wa/outbound/validate` contract (§13) has **two producers** — the FE/manual room-send path *and* the broadcast worker — and one logical evaluator. Both producers live in different services that each own their own Mongo DB and must not cross-query (CLAUDE.md backend-architecture rule). Embedding the evaluator in `conversation-service` would force `broadcast-service` to cross-call it ad hoc and would split the audit/lock/protection-context stores across two domains. **Decision: introduce a dedicated `anti-ban-service` microservice** (follows the existing 20-service pattern: gRPC server + RMQ listener + own Mongo DB + mTLS). ``` ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐ manual room send ───► │ │ (conversation-svc) ───►│ anti-ban-service │ │ • idempotency / dedupe store (Mongo) │ broadcast worker ───►│ • recipient lock (Redis TTL) │ (broadcast-svc) ───►│ • broadcast protection context (Mongo) │ │ • classifier + policy engine │ api-gateway REST ───►│ • outbound_attempt state machine │ /validate, /logs ───►│ • anti-ban audit/trace store (Mongo) │ │ • sender safe-mode state │ └──────────────────┬──────────────────────┘ │ decision: allow / warning / queue / block ▼ dispatch proceeds → whatsapp service → BaileysService (Phase 0 throttle + dedup) → socket ``` - **gRPC method**: `AntiBanService.ValidateOutbound(ValidateOutboundRequest) → ValidateOutboundResponse` (sync, called pre-dispatch by both conversation-service and broadcast-service). - **gRPC method**: `AntiBanService.QueryAuditLogs(...)` (for api-gateway `GET /api/wa/outbound/anti-ban/logs`). - **RMQ events** (async, fire-and-forget per PRD §13): `wa.broadcast.protection_context.updated`, `wa.outbound.validation.result`, `wa.broadcast.dispatch.trace.recorded`, `wa.sender.safe_mode.changed`, `wa.outbound.reconciliation.updated`. The broadcast worker emits protection-context updates as it processes recipients; anti-ban-service consumes them to keep the lookup table fresh (PRD §14.1). - **api-gateway** adds two HTTP routes that proxy to the new gRPC client: `POST /open-api|/api/wa/outbound/validate` and `GET /api/wa/outbound/anti-ban/logs` (guarded; see §6.11). ### 3.2 Defense-in-depth: two independent layers | Layer | Where | Guarantees | Status | |---|---|---|---| | **L1 — Pre-dispatch guard** | `anti-ban-service` (new) | Idempotency, recipient lock, classifier+policy decision (allow/warn/queue/block), reconciliation, audit, safe mode. The *decision* layer. | **To build (Phases 1A–1D)** | | **L2 — Socket-level throttle** | `whatsapp` `BaileysService` | One send at a time per sender, randomized 3–8s gap, UI-preempts-broadcast, in-service dedup, time-based admission cap. The *execution* safety net. | **DONE (Phase 0)** | L2 stays even after L1 ships: it protects against bugs, flag-off states, and any future producer that forgets to call L1. L1 makes the *policy* decision; L2 makes the *physical send* safe. --- ## 4. Phase 0 — shipped (socket-level throttle + dedup) Implemented and verified (15/15 unit tests, build green, lint clean). Layering `controller → service → repository → schema`, repositories extend `TenantRepository`. ### 6.2 Outbound identity & dedupe — FR-001..004 - Compute `idempotencyKey` (§5.1) in `ValidateOutbound`. On match within `dedupeWindowSeconds` (default 120, §10) → state `SUPPRESSED_DUPLICATE`, link `winnerAttemptId`, return duplicate-safe `allow=false, reasonCode=DUPLICATE_SUPPRESSED`. EH-001 copy: *"Pesan serupa sudah sedang diproses."* - Covers both manual and broadcast (FR-003) because both call `ValidateOutbound` with their respective `outboundSource`. ### 6.3 Recipient concurrency control — FR-005..007 - Acquire `recipient_lock` (§5.3) before transitioning to `LOCKED`. On failure → back off / resolve as duplicate (FR-006, EH-002). TTL + crash recovery via PX expiry + re-evaluate-before-dispatch (FR-007, EH-008). Resolution states `CONFIRMED_SENT|CONFIRMED_FAILED|UNRESOLVED_TIMEOUT` (FR-010). Maintain attempt↔retry↔final linkage (FR-011). Emit `wa.outbound.reconciliation.updated`. - Integration point: the whatsapp service must report send ack/uncertainty back. Today the send result (`ISendMessageResult` with `key.id`) is the success signal; "unknown" = adapter timeout/socket error. Add a thin reconciliation callback (RMQ event) from the dispatch caller. ### 6.5 FE behavioral context intake — FR-014..016 - Extend the outbound contract with an **optional** `behaviorContext { pasteDetected, sourceMessageAction, sourceMessageId, sourceMessageOrigin, sendFromCopiedMessage }`. Add to `MessageOutboundDto` (or a wrapping `OutboundValidateDto`) with all fields `@IsOptional()`. Backend-managed; **no tenant-facing settings page** (FR-021). - `monitor_only` mode → always allow + log (AR-006). Modes: `monitor_only|warning_only|queue_only|strict` (§10), default `monitor_only`. - Cooldown via `operatorCooldownSeconds`/`manualBroadcastResendWindowSeconds` (FR-023, EH-005, reason `COOLDOWN_ACTIVE`). - Never expose internal formulas to operators (FR-034) — return only a user-safe Bahasa message + reason code. ### 6.8 Sender account safety — FR-024..026 - On restriction/eligibility-exceeded/safe-mode signal → stop or downgrade (FR-024, EH-006/EH-007). Server still enforces idempotency if bypassed (FR-013). FE work is in `frontend/apps/omnichannel` conversation room send button; all copy via next-intl (`id` + `en`). Out of scope for the backend phases but tracked here for completeness. ### 6.10 Traceability & audit — FR-027..031, FR-036 - Persist `dispatchCorrelationId`, dispatch source, classifier, attempt lineage across every path (FR-027). Distinguish `system_broadcast | manual_room_send | retry/reconciliation | duplicate-suspected` (FR-028). - Log **every** delayed/queued/blocked/suppressed/retried/reconciled/duplicate-suspected/safe-mode event with a machine-readable reason code (FR-029). Audit-log read requires an explicit *anti-ban log access* permission (Admin, Super Admin, IT Support, or granted users — read-only). Operators see only their own user-facing warnings, never classifier internals (FR-034). Wire guards from `libs/security`/`common`; resolve permission via `auth-service`. --- ## 7. Build order (phases & sprints) | Phase | Deliverable | Key FRs | Exit criteria | |---|---|---|---| | **0** ✅ | Socket-level throttle + in-service dedup (whatsapp) | partial FR-001/002, anti-burst | Shipped: 15/15 tests, build+lint green | | **1A** | `anti-ban-service` skeleton + shared enums/normalizer in libs/common + `ValidateOutbound` gRPC + idempotency/dedupe + recipient lock + audit store + `monitor_only` (allow+log only) + api-gateway `/validate` & `/logs` proxy | FR-001..007, FR-029..031, FR-032/033 | In `monitor_only`, every manual+broadcast send produces an audit row with idempotency key & correlation id; zero delivery behavior change; p95 validate ≤100ms (PRD §20) | | **1B** | Broadcast protection context (consume `wa.broadcast.protection_context.updated` from broadcast-service) + classifier + FE behavioral context intake (DTO extension) | FR-014..020 | Classifier result persisted with evidence path for every protected resend; FE context optional & backward-compatible | | **1C** | Enforcement engine (`warning_only`→`queue_only`→`strict`) + cooldown + sender safe-mode integration with channel-service | FR-021..026, FR-034 | Protected resend yields deterministic allow/warn/queue/block per §15; safe-mode stop ≤5s; Bahasa user copy only | | **1D** | Reconciliation state machine + duplicate-investigation lineage + dashboard read views (Admin/Support) + observability metrics/alerts | FR-008..011, FR-027/028, FR-035/036 | 0 blind resend while `RECONCILIATION_PENDING`; duplicate-suspected incidents fully traceable end-to-end | | **FE** | Conversation room submit-lock + warning/block toasts + audit log table | FR-012/013, §9 | Repeat-submit disabled; warnings localized (`id`/`en`); audit table permission-gated | Within each phase follow the repo TDD + code-review workflow; ≥80% coverage on new service logic. --- ## 9. Non-functional & risk notes (PRD §20–21) - **Performance:** `ValidateOutbound` p95 ≤100ms excluding WA dispatch. Mongo lookups must be indexed (idempotencyKey unique, protection-context compound key, audit query fields). Redis lock op is sub-ms. - **Availability/safety:** anti-ban failure must degrade safely and must **not** amplify duplicates (PRD §20). If `anti-ban-service` is down and flag is on, the caller's fallback policy in `monitor_only` should **fail-open to send** (do not block legitimate traffic) while L2 still guarantees socket safety; in `strict` it should fail-closed only for protected-resend-suspect paths. Make this explicit and configurable. - **Idempotency under retry:** all retry paths must route through the identity layer (PRD §21 risk) — audit any worker that bypasses it. - **Privacy/retention:** store masked recipient + content fingerprint only; no raw text; audit/trace ≥12 months; locks TTL-short (PRD §17). - **audit-service gap:** current `LogEvent` map cannot hold structured anti-ban data → anti-ban-service owns its store; optional coarse mirror to audit-service only. - **mTLS:** new service needs certs in `backend/certs/`; gRPC won't start without them. --- ## 10. Open questions carried from PRD §25 1. Final normalization policy for exact-text comparison (whitespace/case fold rules) — must be locked before 1B since it defines the fingerprint. 2. Exact protection window after the latest system-managed broadcast attempt (`recentProtectionUntil` duration). 3. Precedence rule when FE evidence conflicts with content-match-only evidence (EC-008) — define deterministic order before 1C. 4. In-flight behavior when sender safe mode activates mid-queue (drain vs hard-stop). 5. Whether tenant isolation needs an explicit additional FR beyond current security framing. --- ## 11. File/Reference index | What | Where | |---|---| | Source PRD | [`prd/prd-whatsapp-web-outbound-anti-ban.md`](../prd/prd-whatsapp-web-outbound-anti-ban.md) | | Phase 0 plan | [`.claude/plans/whatsapp-per-sender-outbound-throttle.md`](../.claude/plans/whatsapp-per-sender-outbound-throttle.md) | | Phase 0 summary | [`summary/whatsapp-per-sender-outbound-throttle.md`](../summary/whatsapp-per-sender-outbound-throttle.md) | | Manual send adapter | `backend/apps/conversation-service/src/app/adapters/whatsapp-web.adapter.ts` | | Broadcast send adapter | `backend/apps/broadcast-service/src/app/adapters/whatsapp-web.adapter.ts` | | Outbound DTO | `backend/libs/common/src/lib/dto/index.ts:342` (MessageOutboundDto) | | Broadcast states | `backend/apps/broadcast-service/src/app/constants/status.constant.ts` | | Audit proto (thin) | `backend/proto/audit.proto` | | Phase 0 throttle/dedup | `backend/apps/whatsapp/src/app/services/outbound-send-queue.ts`, `outbound-deduplicator.ts`, `baileys.service.ts` | | Add-a-service recipe | `CLAUDE.md` → Recipes / `.claude/rules/backend-architecture.md` |

allWorkPackages.subject: [Mobile] - Search Autocomplete/Filtering Does Not Return Result for Partial Keyword Match
allWorkPackages.description:
**Jamdev :** [**https://app.betterbugs.io/session/6a1506f2247a3e53fa31531c**](https://app.betterbugs.io/session/6a1506f2247a3e53fa31531c)

**Description : The search function fails to display data when the user enters a partial keyword. Matching results only appear after the user has entered almost the entire keyword, causing inconsistent search behavior.**

**more record related :**

Sample existing data: salahudin

*   Input salahud → no result displayed
    
*   Input salahudi → matching result displayed
    

Sample esixting data: nayaka

*   input naya → noresult displayed
    
*   input nayak →  matching result displayed
    

**Steps :**

1.  Open the search feature
    
2.  Search for existing data using keyword salahudin
    
3.  Input partial keyword salahud
    
4.  Observe that no result is displayed
    
5.  Continue typing until salahudi
    

**Actual : The system does not display data results for incomplete keyword input and only displays results after the keyword input is almost complete.**

**Expectation : System should return matching results for partial keyword input without requiring users to enter nearly the entire keyword.**  
  

**Used Account : all role**  
  

**Path :**

**Env bug found :** ~~**Dev/Staging**~~**/Prod**

**Env Test : Dev/Staging/Prod**

allWorkPackages.subject: CRUD Roles and RBAC Refine
allWorkPackages.description: PRD: [https://docs.google.com/document/d/1i1H3r4OCqQUd9cmSZtkEVHqjcMFtXlF4xGeH6\_Z4eE0/edit?tab=t.wrj9hluvl2lj](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1i1H3r4OCqQUd9cmSZtkEVHqjcMFtXlF4xGeH6_Z4eE0/edit?tab=t.wrj9hluvl2lj) Design: [https://www.figma.com/design/RAAuLaQKUufWMWWEm0kMb9/-V2--Satuinbox-Web-Specs?node-id=4586-155863&t=NVJnjsFZgCxC5df8-4](https://www.figma.com/design/RAAuLaQKUufWMWWEm0kMb9/-V2--Satuinbox-Web-Specs?node-id=4586-155863&t=NVJnjsFZgCxC5df8-4) Test Case : [Test Case](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1DooGN1VwcOTyPZwW5djykQD-idCQzsDmG3qkKSMJ-a8/edit?gid=298284840#gid=298284840) Test Case V2: [Test Case v2](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/18CWHt0-hKFknVHRK72asp1Dyu8M4nhnQxpAMfrRZ10c/edit?gid=1594143781#gid=1594143781) QA notes : 📊 Impact Analysis per Service ## 1\. People Service → **Impact: 5 (CRITICAL)** ### Kenapa tinggi: People Service jadi **source of truth untuk RBAC**. ### Area terdampak: * **Role** * CRUD role (create, edit, duplicate, delete) * Default role logic (Admin, Supervisor, Agent) * Permission schema (nested JSON, dependency rules) * **Member** * Relasi `member → roleId` * Update massal saat role berubah * **User** * Data privacy (masking phone/email) * **Team** * Relasi team ↔ member ↔ role ### Risiko: * Data inconsistency (role update tidak propagate) * Broken relation (role dihapus tapi masih dipakai) * Migration issue (existing data belum punya role) ### Kesimpulan: 👉 Ini core dari RBAC → semua logic berat ada di sini ## 2\. Auth Service → **Impact: 5 (CRITICAL)** ### Kenapa tinggi: Auth menentukan **enforcement permission saat runtime** ### Area terdampak: * Generate permission ke: * JWT / session / cache * Validasi: * endpoint access * module access * Sync dengan People Service ### Risiko: * Permission mismatch (UI vs backend) * Cache stale (role sudah update tapi token lama masih aktif) * Security hole (akses tetap terbuka) ### Edge penting: * Apakah permission di: * embed di token ❗ * atau fetch realtime ❗ 👉 Ini sangat menentukan behavior sistem ## 3\. Conversation Service → **Impact: 4 (HIGH)** ### Kenapa tinggi: Conversation heavily bergantung pada permission: * Inbox access * Assign / claim chat * Visibility (assigned / team / all) ### Area terdampak: * Filtering conversation by role * Action: * reply * assign * close * UI visibility ### Risiko: * User lihat chat yang tidak seharusnya * Tidak bisa akses chat yang harusnya bisa * Broken flow assign/claim ## 4\. Ticket Service → **Impact: 4 (HIGH)** ### Kenapa tinggi: Mirip dengan conversation tapi lebih kompleks karena: * Ada dependency rules (claim ticket, queue, dll) ### Area terdampak: * Ticket visibility * Action: * claim * resolve * reassign * Dependency logic enforcement ### Risiko: * Invalid action allowed (security issue) * Dependency rule tidak konsisten * Workflow ticket rusak ## 5\. Management Settings → **Impact: 4 (HIGH)** ### Kenapa: Ini adalah **entry point UI untuk RBAC** ### Area terdampak: * Role Settings Page * Permission UI (grouping, toggle, dependency) * Bulk action (batasi semua) ### Risiko: * UI tidak sync dengan backend * State permission salah kirim * Dependency tidak tergambar dengan benar ## 6\. Team (inside People Service but worth isolating) → **Impact: 3 (MEDIUM)** ### Kenapa: * Team hanya relasi ke member → role indirectly ### Area terdampak: * Filtering member by role * Team assignment behavior ### Risiko: * Role change tidak reflect ke team behavior # 📊 Ringkasan Skala Impact # Cross-Service Risk (Paling Bahaya) ## 1\. Permission Sync Issue * Role diubah di People Service * Auth masih pakai cache lama * User dapat akses yang salah **Mitigation:** * Token invalidation / short TTL * Versioning permission ## 2\. Broken Dependency Rules * UI valid → backend invalid * atau sebaliknya **Mitigation:** * Centralize dependency validation (backend only as source of truth) ## 3\. Partial Update (sering kejadian) * Role update sukses * Tapi member / auth tidak update **Mitigation:** * Event-driven (publish role updated) * Retry mechanism ## 4\. Delete Role Issue * Role dihapus * Member masih refer role lama **Mitigation:** * Hard validation sebelum delete * Force reassignment addtional : ## Middleware Impact Analysis →**Impact: 5 (CRITICAL)** ## ## Peran Middleware di RBAC Middleware berfungsi untuk: * Decode token * Inject user context (role, permission) * Validasi akses (authorization) * (Optional) fetch permission dari Auth / cache 👉 Artinya: Semua request ke Conversation, Ticket, dll lewat sini dulu # AREA TERDAMPAK ## 1\. Authorization Logic → **HIGH IMPACT** ### Sebelum RBAC: * Biasanya cuma: * authenticated / tidak ### Setelah RBAC: * Harus cek: * module enabled * action allowed * visibility scope

allWorkPackages.subject: NEW CHANNEL ADD ONS - SHOPEE
allWorkPackages.description:
# **PRODUCT REQUIREMENT DOCUMENT**

**Feature**: Omnichannel Inbox — Shopee Channel Add-On  
**Product Manager**: Dany Christian  
**Engineering Lead**: Naftal Yunior  
**Design Lead**: TBD  
**Contributors**: Engineering Team, QA Team, Design Team  
**Version**: v1.0  
**TRD**: TBD

---

## **1. Revision History**

| Version | Date | Author | Changes |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| v1.0 | 2026-06-17 | PRD Analysis → PRD | Initial PRD for Shopee Channel Add-On Phase 1 (Core Inbox) using existing SatuInbox omnichannel backbone. |

---

## **2. Overview**

| Item | Description |
| ----- | ----- |
| Purpose | Menambahkan Shopee sebagai channel add-on baru agar percakapan buyer–seller dapat masuk ke SatuInbox, diproses oleh agent dari unified inbox, dan mengikuti lifecycle conversation existing. |
| Scope | **Phase 1 only**: onboarding koneksi akun/toko Shopee, inbound text message, outbound text reply, sinkronisasi status dasar jika tersedia, filter channel, audit, dan observability. |
| Key Capabilities | Aktivasi Shopee sebagai add-on, koneksi akun/toko Shopee, inbound webhook processing, conversation/contact resolution, outbound reply dari room, channel filter `Shopee`, analytics dasar by platform, dan kontrol RBAC existing. |
| Outcome | Tenant dapat menangani chat Shopee langsung dari SatuInbox tanpa membuat integrasi manual di luar platform. |

### **Scope Definition**

| In Scope | Out of Scope |
| ----- | ----- |
| Aktivasi Shopee sebagai add-on platform baru. | Sinkronisasi order, refund, return, shipping, dan catalog. |
| Koneksi satu atau lebih akun/toko Shopee per tenant sesuai model account-channel existing. | Broadcast massal ke Shopee. |
| Inbound text message Shopee ke Conversation Inbox. | AI semantic matching atau auto merge lintas channel. |
| Outbound text reply dari Conversation Room ke Shopee. | Attachment image, file, voice note, sticker, atau rich message pada Phase 1. |
| Penyimpanan metadata channel, buyer identity, thread identity, dan external message id. | Template message khusus Shopee. |
| Status dasar `sent` / `failed` dan callback tambahan bila API Shopee mendukung. | Ticket auto-creation khusus Shopee. |
| Filter dan analytics dasar by platform `Shopee`. | Dashboard operasional Shopee khusus di luar analytics existing. |
| Audit trail untuk connect, disconnect, inbound, outbound, dan failure penting. | Import histori percakapan lama Shopee. |

### **Phase Boundary**

Phase 1 sengaja dibatasi ke **Core Inbox** agar integrasi dapat dirilis dengan aman menggunakan arsitektur platform existing. Jika capability resmi Shopee untuk attachment, order context, atau status lanjutan telah tervalidasi, perubahan tersebut harus masuk sebagai patch/addendum PRD terpisah, bukan ekspansi diam-diam di tengah sprint.

---

## **3. Problem Statement**

| ID | Problem | Impact |
| ----- | ----- | ----- |
| PS-001 | Tenant yang berjualan di Shopee harus berpindah antara Seller Center dan SatuInbox untuk menangani chat pelanggan. | Waktu respons lebih lambat dan konteks kerja agent terpecah. |
| PS-002 | Stack omnichannel SatuInbox sudah mendukung beberapa channel, tetapi belum memiliki integrasi Shopee. | Tenant tidak bisa menggunakan satu inbox untuk semua channel utama. |
| PS-003 | Channel marketplace tidak selalu memiliki identitas pelanggan berbasis nomor telepon. | Risiko duplikasi contact dan conversation tinggi jika identity model tidak dirancang khusus. |
| PS-004 | Webhook marketplace cenderung retryable, bursty, dan tidak selalu berurutan. | Tanpa idempotency dan ordering guard, duplicate message dan status drift dapat terjadi. |
| PS-005 | FE dan BE saat ini memiliki extension point generik untuk add-on channel, tetapi belum ada kontrak implementasi Shopee. | Tanpa PRD yang jelas, blast radius lintas channel, analytics, dan inbox behavior sulit dikontrol. |

---

## **4. Objectives and Key Results**

| Objective | Key Result |
| ----- | ----- |
| Menghadirkan Shopee ke unified inbox SatuInbox. | 100% tenant pilot dapat menerima dan membalas chat Shopee dari inbox tanpa keluar dari SatuInbox. |
| Mengurangi fragmentasi penanganan percakapan marketplace. | ≥90% inbound Shopee valid berhasil dipetakan ke conversation yang benar dalam ≤30 detik. |
| Menjaga stabilitas backbone omnichannel existing. | 0 regresi P0 pada WhatsApp API, Instagram, Messenger, Email, dan Widget selama rollout pilot. |
| Menjamin integrasi aman di bawah retry dan duplicate webhook. | 0 duplicate conversation akibat retry webhook pada skenario idempotent yang tervalidasi QA. |
| Menyediakan dasar reusable untuk capability Shopee lanjutan. | Phase 2 dapat menambah attachment/order context tanpa mengganti model platform/channel/account-channel existing. |

---

## **5. User Stories and Acceptance Criteria**

| ID | Priority | User Story | Acceptance Criteria |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| US-001 | P0 | As an Admin, I want to connect a Shopee account/shop as a new add-on channel so that tenant dapat menerima chat Shopee di SatuInbox. | 1. Given tenant memiliki akses pengelolaan add-on, When Admin mengaktifkan Shopee dan menyelesaikan flow koneksi, Then system membuat account channel Shopee baru dalam scope tenant yang benar. 2. Given koneksi berhasil, When halaman settings dimuat ulang, Then account channel Shopee tampil dengan status terhubung. 3. Given kredensial atau otorisasi tidak valid, When proses koneksi gagal, Then system tidak membuat account channel aktif dan menampilkan alasan kegagalan yang aman. |
| US-002 | P0 | As an Agent, I want inbound Shopee messages to appear in Omnichannel Inbox so that I can handle them from the same workspace as channel lain. | 1. Given webhook inbound Shopee valid diterima, When buyer mengirim pesan baru, Then system membuat atau memperbarui conversation Shopee di inbox tenant yang benar. 2. Given buyer yang sama mengirim pesan lanjutan pada thread yang sama, When webhook diproses, Then system menambahkan message ke conversation Shopee yang sama. 3. Given webhook inbound adalah duplikat retry, When event diproses ulang, Then system tidak membuat duplicate conversation atau duplicate message. |
| US-003 | P0 | As an Agent, I want to reply to Shopee customers from Conversation Room so that I do not need to open Seller Center separately. | 1. Given conversation Shopee terbuka dan user memiliki permission kirim pesan, When Agent mengirim balasan text, Then system mengirim pesan ke Shopee dan menyimpan outbound message di timeline conversation. 2. Given pengiriman outbound gagal, When system menerima failure dari provider atau timeout final, Then message ditandai gagal dan agent melihat state kegagalan yang jelas. 3. Given user tidak memiliki izin kirim pesan, When room dibuka, Then composer Shopee tampil nonaktif atau tidak tersedia sesuai RBAC. |
| US-004 | P0 | As an Agent, I want Shopee conversations to be identifiable and filterable as a separate channel so that I can triage marketplace traffic quickly. | 1. Given channel Shopee aktif, When inbox dimuat, Then conversation Shopee membawa label channel `Shopee`. 2. Given user memfilter berdasarkan channel, When memilih `Shopee`, Then hanya conversation Shopee yang terlihat sesuai visibility scope user. 3. Given analytics by platform dimuat, When data Shopee tersedia, Then data Shopee ikut dihitung sebagai platform terpisah. |
| US-005 | P0 | As an Admin or Supervisor, I want Shopee account connection health to be visible so that operational issues bisa ditindaklanjuti cepat. | 1. Given account channel Shopee terhubung, When token/session masih valid, Then status tampil sebagai terhubung. 2. Given otorisasi kedaluwarsa atau koneksi diputus, When health check atau callback status diterima, Then status account channel berubah menjadi terputus dan audit event tercatat. 3. Given reconnect diperlukan, When Admin membuka settings channel, Then system menampilkan CTA untuk hubungkan ulang. |
| US-006 | P1 | As a Supervisor, I want Shopee events to be auditable so that inbound/outbound failure dan reconnect bisa ditelusuri. | 1. Given connect/disconnect/inbound/outbound/failure event terjadi, When event selesai diproses, Then audit trail tersimpan dengan actor, tenant, account channel, dan timestamp. 2. Given webhook ditolak karena invalid signature, When event ditolak, Then security/audit log mencatat penolakan tanpa menyimpan secret sensitif. |
| US-007 | P1 | As a Product and Engineering team, I want Shopee integration to reuse existing platform backbone so that future marketplace channels dapat mengikuti pola yang sama. | 1. Given platform Shopee ditambahkan, When system memproses add-on activation, Then flow tetap menggunakan model `Platform` → `Channel` → `AccountChannel` existing. 2. Given service Shopee membutuhkan komunikasi dengan service lain, When kontrak internal dibuat, Then komunikasi mengikuti gRPC/RabbitMQ pattern existing dan tidak bypass API architecture. |

---

## **6. Functional Requirements**

### **6.1 Platform Registration and Add-On Activation**

| Category | Requirements |
| ----- | ----- |
| Platform Backbone | FR-001 [P0]: System MUST register Shopee as a new platform with internal code `shopee`. FR-002 [P0]: Platform Shopee MUST be marked as `isAddOns = true`. FR-003 [P0]: System MUST create Shopee channel entities using the existing `Platform` → `Channel` → `AccountChannel` model. FR-004 [P0]: Activation of Shopee as add-on MUST reuse existing add-on commercial flow and quota validation where applicable. |

### **6.2 Account Onboarding and Credential Lifecycle**

| Category | Requirements |
| ----- | ----- |
| Connection Setup | FR-005 [P0]: System MUST provide one settings flow to connect a Shopee account/shop into tenant scope. FR-006 [P0]: System MUST store Shopee credentials or authorization artifacts securely in encrypted form. FR-007 [P0]: System MUST bind every Shopee account connection to exactly one `accountChannelId`. FR-008 [P0]: One tenant MAY connect multiple Shopee account channels if quota and permission allow. |
| Connection Status | FR-009 [P0]: System MUST expose connection health for each Shopee account channel. FR-010 [P0]: System MUST support explicit disconnect and reconnect actions for authorized users. FR-011 [P0]: If credential validity expires or provider revokes access, system MUST mark the account channel as disconnected or invalid and block outbound send until recovery. |

### **6.3 Inbound Webhook Intake**

| Category | Requirements |
| ----- | ----- |
| Webhook Validation | FR-012 [P0]: System MUST validate tenant-safe authenticity of every Shopee webhook before processing business data. FR-013 [P0]: Invalid or unverifiable webhook payload MUST be rejected and MUST NOT create or mutate conversation/message data. FR-014 [P0]: System MUST persist a safe processing trace for accepted and rejected webhook events. |
| Inbound Parsing | FR-015 [P0]: System MUST parse inbound Shopee text messages into normalized internal message payloads. FR-016 [P0]: System MUST extract and store provider identifiers at minimum for shop/account, buyer/contact, thread/session, event, and message. FR-017 [P0]: System MUST store provider raw payload only in a safe diagnostic shape when needed, without secrets or unnecessary sensitive fields. |

### **6.4 Contact and Conversation Resolution**

| Category | Requirements |
| ----- | ----- |
| Contact Identity | FR-018 [P0]: System MUST resolve Shopee customer identity using channel-scoped external identity, not by assuming phone number availability. FR-019 [P0]: System MUST use `channelId + referenceId` compatible identity behavior for client contact creation or reuse. FR-020 [P0]: `referenceId` for Shopee MUST be stable per buyer identity within the connected Shopee account/shop scope. FR-021 [P0]: If a safe stable buyer identifier is unavailable, system MUST NOT guess identity from display name alone. |
| Conversation Resolution | FR-022 [P0]: System MUST resolve inbound Shopee messages to one active conversation using tenant, account channel, contact identity, and provider thread identity. FR-023 [P0]: If no matching active conversation exists, system MUST create a new open conversation with platform `Shopee`. FR-024 [P0]: If a matching Shopee conversation exists for the same thread, system MUST append the message to that conversation. FR-025 [P0]: System MUST store provider identifiers required for deterministic thread resolution on subsequent inbound events. FR-026 [P0]: System MUST keep canonical conversation status model `open` / `closed` and MUST NOT introduce a Shopee-specific conversation status taxonomy. |

### **6.5 Message Persistence and Timeline**

| Category | Requirements |
| ----- | ----- |
| Message Model | FR-027 [P0]: Every inbound and outbound Shopee message MUST store `externalMessageId` when provided by provider. FR-028 [P0]: Every Shopee message MUST store provider metadata needed for troubleshooting and status reconciliation. FR-029 [P0]: Phase 1 MUST support text messages only. FR-030 [P0]: Unsupported Shopee message types in Phase 1 MUST NOT break webhook processing for supported text messages. FR-031 [P1]: Unsupported inbound message types SHOULD be represented as safe placeholder system entries or ignored with audit visibility according to final design decision. |

### **6.6 Outbound Reply**

| Category | Requirements |
| ----- | ----- |
| Send Flow | FR-032 [P0]: Authorized users MUST be able to send outbound text replies from Conversation Room to Shopee. FR-033 [P0]: Outbound reply MUST use the connected Shopee account channel associated with the conversation or a deterministic sender resolution rule. FR-034 [P0]: System MUST persist outbound message in the conversation timeline before or during send processing with a pending/send-in-progress state if such status exists in current architecture. FR-035 [P0]: Final outbound result MUST be reconciled to success or failed state. |
| Send Guard | FR-036 [P0]: System MUST block outbound Shopee reply when account channel is disconnected, invalid, or lacks required authorization. FR-037 [P0]: System MUST block unsupported outbound content types in Phase 1. FR-038 [P0]: System MUST NOT silently fallback to another platform/account when Shopee sender resolution fails. |

### **6.7 Status Synchronization**

| Category | Requirements |
| ----- | ----- |
| Status Events | FR-039 [P0]: If Shopee exposes message delivery lifecycle callbacks, system MUST map them to internal status updates for the matching message. FR-040 [P0]: If provider does not expose a given status level, system MUST NOT fabricate it. FR-041 [P0]: Status callbacks received out of order MUST be reconciled deterministically and MUST NOT regress a more terminal state to a weaker earlier state without explicit rule. |

### **6.8 Inbox, Filter, and UI Surface**

| Category | Requirements |
| ----- | ----- |
| Chat List | FR-042 [P0]: Shopee conversations MUST appear in Omnichannel Inbox with platform/channel label `Shopee`. FR-043 [P0]: Shopee conversations MUST respect existing visibility scope and inbox filter behavior. FR-044 [P0]: Channel filter and analytics grouping MUST include Shopee as a first-class platform. |
| Room Behavior | FR-045 [P0]: If Shopee does not require custom rendering in Phase 1, the default conversation bubble and default text input MAY be reused. FR-046 [P1]: If Shopee requires platform-specific visual treatment later, implementation MUST use existing FE platform registry extension points rather than hardcoding conditional logic in shared room components. |

### **6.9 Permissions and RBAC**

| Category | Requirements |
| ----- | ----- |

| Category | Requirements |
| ----- | ----- |
| Audit | FR-052 [P0]: System MUST audit connect, reconnect, disconnect, credential/auth failure, inbound accepted, inbound rejected, outbound success, and outbound failure events. FR-053 [P0]: Audit entries MUST include actor when user-triggered and service source when system-triggered. |
| Analytics | FR-054 [P0]: Shopee conversations MUST be included in platform-level conversation analytics. FR-055 [P1]: Shopee account/channel health metrics SHOULD be observable for support and rollout monitoring. |
| Recovery | FR-056 [P0]: Webhook retry and outbound retry behavior MUST be idempotent. FR-057 [P0]: Transient downstream failure MUST NOT create duplicate conversation or duplicate message artifacts on retry. |
