## **7. Error Handling**

| ID | Type | Handling | UI/UX |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| EH-001 | Validation | Aktivasi add-on ditolak jika tenant tidak memiliki quota/add-on entitlement yang cukup. | Tampilkan pesan kegagalan aktivasi yang jelas. |
| EH-002 | Connection | Koneksi akun Shopee gagal karena otorisasi atau kredensial tidak valid. | Tampilkan `Gagal menghubungkan akun Shopee` tanpa membocorkan secret. |
| EH-003 | Security | Webhook Shopee gagal diverifikasi. | Jangan buat/mutasi conversation. Catat security log. |
| EH-004 | Duplicate | Webhook retry dengan event/message yang sama diterima ulang. | System mengabaikan duplikat secara idempotent. Tidak ada duplicate message. |
| EH-005 | Mapping | Buyer identity tidak dapat diresolusikan secara aman. | Event ditahan atau dicatat sebagai failed processing; jangan tebak contact dari display name. |
| EH-006 | Mapping | Thread identity tidak cukup untuk menentukan conversation target. | System membuat conversation baru hanya jika aturan minimum aman terpenuhi; jika tidak, event masuk exception handling internal. |
| EH-007 | Outbound | Account channel Shopee sedang disconnected atau invalid saat agent mengirim balasan. | Composer diblok atau send ditolak dengan `Akun Shopee tidak terhubung`. |
| EH-008 | Outbound | Provider menerima request tetapi status final tidak kembali tepat waktu. | Message masuk state pending/unknown sesuai implementasi status existing dan dipantau retry/reconcile. |
| EH-009 | Outbound | Provider mengembalikan kegagalan final saat kirim pesan. | Message ditandai gagal dan user melihat `Pesan gagal dikirim ke Shopee`. |
| EH-010 | Permission | User tanpa hak settings mencoba connect/disconnect/reconnect Shopee. | Tampilkan `Akses ditolak`. |
| EH-011 | Permission | User tanpa izin kirim pesan membuka conversation Shopee. | Composer disembunyikan atau dinonaktifkan sesuai pola existing. |
| EH-012 | Unsupported Capability | Webhook inbound membawa tipe pesan yang belum didukung di Phase 1. | Jangan merusak pipeline text. Catat unsupported event untuk observability. |
| EH-013 | Partial Failure | Contact berhasil direuse tetapi create message gagal di service downstream. | Retry aman secara idempotent tanpa membuat contact/conversation duplikat. |
| EH-014 | Status Sync | Status callback datang sebelum outbound message record lengkap tersedia. | Buffer/retry reconcile internal hingga record tersedia atau timeout observability tercapai. |

| ID | Scenario | Expected Behavior | UI/UX |

| EC-001 | Satu buyer mengirim ulang webhook yang sama karena retry provider. | Tidak ada duplicate conversation atau duplicate message. | Tidak ada perubahan visual ganda. |
| EC-002 | Satu tenant menghubungkan lebih dari satu shop Shopee. | Setiap shop menjadi account channel terpisah dalam tenant yang sama. | User dapat membedakan shop dari nama account channel. |

| EC-005 | Provider mengirim status callback lebih dulu daripada message payload utama. | Callback tidak boleh membuat artifact yatim permanen. | Tidak ada pesan bayangan di UI. |

| EC-008 | Provider menolak pesan karena policy/limit yang tidak terpenuhi. | Message ditandai gagal dengan reason ter-normalisasi. | UI menampilkan error aman tanpa raw provider secret. |
| EC-009 | Unsupported non-text inbound masuk bersamaan dengan text inbound pada thread yang sama. | Text inbound tetap diproses normal; unsupported item dicatat sesuai policy. | Timeline tidak rusak. |
| EC-010 | User kehilangan permission saat halaman room masih terbuka. | Aksi kirim berikutnya wajib divalidasi server-side dan ditolak bila tidak lagi berhak. | Composer dinonaktifkan setelah refresh state. |

## **11. State Transition Model**

| Entity | Current State | Action / Trigger | Next State | Allowed Roles | Guard Conditions | Side Effects | Audit Event |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| Shopee Account Channel | `inactive` | Admin activates and completes valid connect flow | `connected` | Admin / Supervisor with settings permission | Add-on entitlement valid, auth success, tenant valid | Create/update account channel, store encrypted auth artifact, enable webhook route binding | `shopee_account_connected` |
| Shopee Account Channel | `connected` | User-triggered disconnect | `disconnected` | Admin / Supervisor with settings permission | Account exists and belongs to tenant | Block outbound send, preserve historical data, revoke/unbind provider session if applicable | `shopee_account_disconnected` |
| Shopee Account Channel | `connected` | Provider revoke / auth expiry / health failure | `disconnected` | System | Failure validated by callback/health rule | Mark account unusable for outbound until reconnect | `shopee_account_invalidated` |
| Shopee Account Channel | `disconnected` | Authorized reconnect succeeds | `connected` | Admin / Supervisor with settings permission | Re-auth success | Refresh encrypted auth artifact, restore outbound ability | `shopee_account_reconnected` |
| Conversation | none | Valid inbound Shopee text for new thread | `open` | System | Webhook valid, identity resolvable, thread not mapped | Create contact if needed, create conversation, create message | `shopee_inbound_message_created` |
| Conversation | `open` | Valid inbound Shopee text for existing thread | `open` | System | Same tenant, same thread resolution match | Append message, update chat list latest activity | `shopee_inbound_message_appended` |
| Conversation | `open` | Agent sends outbound Shopee text successfully | `open` | Agent / Supervisor / Admin with send permission | Account channel connected, sender resolved, message type supported | Persist outbound message, sync status | `shopee_outbound_message_sent` |
| Conversation | `open` | Agent sends outbound Shopee text and final provider failure occurs | `open` | Agent / Supervisor / Admin with send permission | Same as above | Persist failed state, expose failure reason | `shopee_outbound_message_failed` |
| Conversation | `closed` | Valid inbound Shopee text hits mapped closed thread | `open` or new `open` conversation per backend-approved reopen policy | System | Must follow canonical conversation policy; no Shopee-specific status model | Reopen or create new conversation according to approved rule | `shopee_closed_thread_reengaged` |

**Note:** Phase 1 tidak menambah status conversation baru. Canonical status tetap `open` / `closed`.

| Shopee Status Update | `shopee.message.status` | Shopee Service | Conversation Service / Socket / Analytics | External message id + normalized status + timestamps | Internal ack | message not found, stale callback | Must be tolerant of out-of-order callbacks. |
| Shopee Account Health Update | `shopee.account.health` | Shopee Service | Channel Service / Settings UI / Audit | `accountChannelId`, health state, reason | Internal ack | account missing | Used for disconnected / expired auth indicators. |

## **14. Non-Functional Requirements**

| Category | Requirement |
| ----- | ----- |
| Performance | P95 accepted inbound Shopee webhook processing to normalized internal event dispatch under 3 seconds excluding provider latency. |
| Performance | P95 conversation/message creation after valid inbound under 30 seconds end-to-end. |
| Reliability | Duplicate webhook retries must be idempotent and must not create duplicate conversation/message artifacts. |
| Reliability | Outbound send flow must support safe retry or reconciliation without double-send side effects. |
| Security | All Shopee credentials, tokens, or secret materials must be encrypted at rest. |
| Security | All webhook validation must be tenant-safe and must reject unverifiable payloads. |
| Privacy | Stored payloads and logs must avoid unnecessary PII duplication and must not store raw secrets. |
| Observability | System must emit logs/metrics for connect, disconnect, inbound accepted, inbound rejected, outbound success, outbound failure, duplicate webhook, and auth expiry. |
| Localization | User-facing UI copy must be Bahasa Indonesia. |
| Compatibility | Existing non-Shopee channels must continue working without requiring their payload contracts to change. |

## **15. Dependencies & Risks**

| Dependency or Risk | Owner | Impact | Mitigation |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| Official Shopee auth model and messaging contract | Product / Engineering | Build cannot finalize without official integration contract. | Lock during technical spike before implementation starts. |
| Stable buyer/thread identity from provider | Engineering | Wrong mapping creates duplicate or misrouted conversations. | Use channel-scoped external identity and deterministic thread keys only. |
| Existing add-on quota/billing flow | Product / Engineering | Activation may fail or behave inconsistently without quota policy. | Reuse current add-on commercial model and document quota clearly. |
| Existing inbox RBAC and filter behavior | Engineering / QA | Shopee results may leak or disappear incorrectly. | Regression test all visibility scopes. |
| Provider retry and ordering behavior | Engineering | Duplicate or out-of-order events may corrupt message state. | Enforce idempotency, ordering guards, and observability. |
| Unsupported message capabilities | Product / Engineering | User expectation mismatch if media appears partially supported. | Lock Phase 1 to text-only and expose unsupported capability clearly. |
| Analytics schema alignment | Engineering / Data | Platform reports may become inconsistent. | Add Shopee to platform enum and analytics grouping before pilot. |
| Support and operations readiness | Support / Ops | Reconnect or failure triage may be slow at launch. | Provide audit trail, health state, and rollout runbook. |

## **19. Concurrency, Rate Limit & Idempotency**

| Scenario | Risk | Required Behavior | Validation |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| Provider retries webhook event | Duplicate conversation/message creation | System MUST deduplicate using provider event id, external message id, or deterministic idempotency key | QA replay same webhook payload multiple times |
| Double-click outbound send | Double-send to Shopee | System MUST enforce outbound idempotency/correlation guard for the same pending client action | QA rapid-click send button |
| Out-of-order status callbacks | Message state regression | System MUST reconcile status transitions deterministically and MUST NOT downgrade terminal state incorrectly | QA send callbacks in reverse order |
| Parallel token refresh / reconnect | Race condition on auth artifact | System MUST serialize or safely coordinate refresh/update for the same account channel | QA concurrent reconnect simulation |
| Inbound while account health toggles | Misroute or reject valid messages | Inbound processing MUST use deterministic account resolution and not corrupt conversation state | QA webhook during reconnect/disconnect |
| Downstream partial failure after contact reuse | Duplicate entity on retry | Retry MUST be safe and entity creation MUST be idempotent | QA forced failure after contact resolution |
| Provider rate limit | Burst outbound failure | System SHOULD normalize provider rate-limit failures and prevent uncontrolled retry storm | QA mocked rate-limit response |

allWorkPackages.subject: Performance degradation in GET /api/ticket and POST /api/ticket under concurrent load
allWorkPackages.description: ## Performance Issue Report: Ticket API Degrades Under Concurrent Load #### Summary #### [Report file](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1V8FoaLYK555QX6A5_PPL3N6jCARKEaoA?usp=sharing) The Ticket API experiences severe performance degradation under concurrent load. Both **GET \`/api/ticket\`**and **POST \`/api/ticket\`** become progressively slower as virtual users increase. At **200 VUS,** the service effectively collapses with a **78.3% request failure rate**. Because GET and POST degrade almost identically, the bottleneck is likely shared infrastructure (database connection pool, server resources, or application event loop) rather than the asynchronous RabbitMQ publishing process. ### Environment ### Test Results ### Expected Behavior The system should satisfy the PRD performance requirement: \- **P95 latency < 2,000 ms** \- Stable response under expected concurrent load \- Minimal request failures ### Actual Behavior \- Response time increases dramatically after 100 VUs. \- At 200 VUs, most requests fail. \- Both GET and POST exhibit nearly identical latency patterns. \- API becomes effectively unavailable during high concurrency. ### Performance Threshold ### Result: ❌ Failed ### Suspected Root Cause The behavior suggests that the bottleneck is shared between both endpoints rather than isolated to the ticket creation flow. Possible causes include: \- Database connection pool exhaustion \- Blocking database queries \- API event loop saturation \- CPU or memory contention \- Thread/worker starvation RabbitMQ is **unlikely to be the primary bottleneck,** because GET requests _which do not publish messages_ degrade almost identically to POST requests. ### Steps to Reproduce \`\`\`bash cd test-result/test-script/ \# Smoke test k6 run --vus 1 --iterations 5 ticket-agent-prelogin-stress.js \# Stress test k6 run ticket-agent-prelogin-stress.js \`\`\` ### Observations \- Smoke test performs normally. \- Performance begins degrading significantly around 100 VUs. \- At 200 VUs the service reaches an unstable state. \- Similar latency between GET and POST indicates a shared backend bottleneck. ### Impact High. Under moderate-to-high concurrent traffic, users may experience: \- Extremely slow ticket loading \- Failed ticket creation \- Request timeouts \- Overall API unavailability ### Recommendation Recommended areas for investigation: 1\. Inspect database connection pool utilization. 2\. Profile slow SQL queries. 3\. Measure API worker/event-loop utilization. 4\. Review connection pool configuration. 5\. Monitor CPU, memory, and I/O during stress testing. 6\. Validate whether synchronous operations block request processing. ### Attached Artifacts \- k6 summary output \- HTML performance report \- Test script (\`ticket-agent-prelogin-stress.js\`)

For example, an invoice created on **26 June 2026** is not displayed when filtering with: However, the same invoice appears immediately when the end date is extended by one day: This issue occurs only in **Invoice History**. allWorkPackages.subject: Settings - Subscription - Top Up History Row Is Not Clickable and Does Not Display Transaction Details, Inconsistent with Invoice History
allWorkPackages.description: ## **Environment** **Environment** : DEV **Module** : Settings → Subscription → Top Up **Feature** : Top Up History ## **Description** There is an inconsistency between the **Invoice History** and **Top Up History** interaction. In the **Invoice** tab, users can click an invoice record to open a detail modal containing complete invoice information. However, in the **Top Up** tab, transaction records are displayed in a similar table layout, but clicking a transaction row does not perform any action or display transaction details. This inconsistent interaction may confuse users because both tables represent billing/payment history, yet provide different behaviors. ## **Steps to Reproduce** 1. Navigate to **Settings → Subscription(Langganan) → Invoice**. 2. Click any invoice record. 3. Observe that the invoice detail modal is displayed. 4. Navigate to **Settings → Subscription(Langganan) → Top Up**. 5. Click any Top Up History record. 6. Observe the system behavior. ## **Actual Result** * Invoice History records can be opened to display detailed information. * Top Up History records cannot be opened. * Clicking a Top Up transaction produces no action. * Users cannot view detailed information about a Top Up transaction. ## **Expected Result** For a consistent user experience, Top Up History should provide transaction details similar to Invoice History, or another clear interaction that allows users to view information such as: * Payment reference * Payment method * Status * Amount * Transaction date * Additional payment details (if available) ## **Impact** * Creates inconsistent interaction patterns within the Billing module. * Users may assume the feature is broken because clicking the transaction does nothing. * Makes it difficult to review Top Up transaction details after payment. * May increase support requests when users need transaction information. ## **Evidence** [**JamDev**](https://jam.dev/c/302515db-e6ae-48da-b6e0-3fa783d24fc6) **Invoice History** * Clicking an invoice opens the detail modal. **Top Up History** * Clicking a transaction does not trigger any action. Screenshots: * Invoice Detail Modal * Top Up History Table ## **Additional Notes** ⚠️ **Need Product Confirmation** The current PRD explicitly defines an **Invoice Detail** page/modal but does not clearly specify whether **Top Up History** should also provide a detail view. If the product expectation is that Top Up History should behave similarly to Invoice History, this should be treated as a UI/UX inconsistency and enhancement/bug. If the current behavior is intentional, consider adding a visual indication (e.g., remove hover/click affordance) so users do not expect the rows to be interactive.

allWorkPackages.subject: Settings - Invoice - Unable to Open Payment Method Selection Modal from “Bayar Tagihan” Button
allWorkPackages.description: ## **Environment** Environment : DEV (Observed on account: **aprizaladm01**) Module     : Settings → Subscription → Invoice Feature     : Invoice Payment username : aprizaladm01 password: Asdqwe12@ ## **Description** The **Pay Invoice** action does not always open the payment method selection modal. During testing, clicking **Bayar Tagihan** on a pending invoice should display a payment method selection modal (e.g. Bank Transfer, Credit Card, E-Wallet, QRIS, Virtual Account). However, on the **aprizaladm01** account in the DEV environment, the modal does not appear after clicking **Bayar Tagihan**. The issue could not be reproduced on another DEV account (e.g. **noel**) and was not observed in the Production environment. ## **Steps to Reproduce** 1. Login using account **aprizaladm01** in the DEV environment. 2. Navigate to **Settings → Subscription → Invoice**. 3. Ensure there is at least one invoice with **Pending** status. 4. Click **Bayar Tagihan**. 5. Observe the system behavior. ## **Actual Result** * Clicking **Bayar Tagihan** does not display the payment method selection modal. * User cannot proceed to select a payment method. * Invoice payment process cannot be continued. ## **Expected Result** * Clicking **Bayar Tagihan** should display the payment method selection modal. * Users should be able to choose a payment method and continue the payment process. ## **Impact** * Users are unable to continue the invoice payment process. * Pending invoices cannot be paid from the application. * May prevent subscription activation or renewal if experienced by customers. ## **Evidence** Jam.dev : [_(attach recording)_](https://dev-v2.satuinbox.com/id/settings/subscriptions/billing?tab=invoice) Screenshot  Expected Result Actual Result  ## **Additional Notes** **Observed Behavior** * Reproduced consistently using account **aprizaladm01** in the DEV environment. * Could **not** be reproduced using another DEV account (different company , e.g. **noel**). * Could **not** be reproduced in the Production environment. **Possible Investigation** * Verify whether the issue is related to account-specific billing data, invoice state, organization data, or frontend conditions that prevent the payment modal from opening. * Compare the invoice payload and payment initialization request between **aprizaladm01** and another account where the payment modal works correctly.

allWorkPackages.subject: Settings - Subscriptions - Top Up - Pending invoice does not provide “Bayar Tagihan” button action, preventing users from continuing payment
allWorkPackages.description: ## **Environment** Environment : PROD & DEV Module     : Settings → Subscription → Top Up Feature     : Top Up History / Pending Transaction ## **Description** Pending Top Up transactions do not provide a payment continuation action (e.g. **Pay** button), making it impossible for users to continue an unfinished payment. During testing, a Top Up transaction with **Pending** status is displayed in the Top Up History table, but no payment action is available. Clicking the row also does not open any payment detail or payment continuation modal. As a result, users who have an unfinished Top Up transaction cannot resume or complete the payment from the application. ## **Steps to Reproduce** 1. Navigate to **Settings → Subscription → Top Up**. 2. Create a Top Up transaction. 3. Leave the payment in **Pending** status. 4. Return to the **Top Up History** page. 5. Observe the Pending transaction. ## **Actual Result** * Pending Top Up transaction is displayed without any payment action. * No **Pay** button is available. * Clicking the Pending transaction does not open a payment detail or payment continuation modal. * Users cannot resume the pending payment from the Top Up History. ## **Expected Result** * Pending Top Up transactions should provide a payment continuation action (e.g. **Pay** button). * Clicking the payment action should reopen the payment flow or payment detail page. * Users should be able to continue and complete the pending payment without creating a new Top Up transaction. ## **Impact** * Users cannot continue unfinished Top Up payments. * Users may need to create duplicate Top Up transactions. * Creates confusion because Pending transactions remain visible but cannot be acted upon. * May reduce payment completion rate. ## **Evidence** Jam.dev : [_(attach recording)_](https://dev-v2.satuinbox.com/id/settings/subscriptions/billing?tab=top-up) Screenshot  ## **Additional Notes ⚠️** **Need Product Confirmation** The current PRD explicitly defines the **“Bayar Sekarang”** action for unpaid **Invoice** records, but does not clearly specify whether **Pending Top Up** transactions should also provide a payment continuation action. If Pending Top Up transactions are expected to behave similarly to unpaid invoices, this should be treated as a bug. Otherwise, product confirmation is required to clarify the intended behavior.

allWorkPackages.subject: Settings - Subscriptions - Top up Token  - Unable to Proceed with QRIS Payment After Selecting Payment Method
allWorkPackages.description: ## Environment Environment : PROD & DEV Module     : Settings → Subscription → Top up Feature     : Invoice Payment / Payment Gateway (QRIS) ## Description Users are unable to proceed with payment after selecting **QRIS** as the payment method from an unpaid invoice. During testing, clicking **Pay Invoice** and choosing **QRIS** does not redirect the user to the QRIS payment flow. The payment process fails, preventing users from completing the transaction. This issue blocks the payment workflow and prevents subscription invoices from being paid using the QRIS payment method. ## Steps to Reproduce 1. Navigate to **Settings → Subscription → Top Up.** 2. Click Top Up token 3. Select **QRIS** as the payment method. 4. Continue the payment process. 5. Observe the system behavior. ## **Actual Result** * QRIS payment flow does not open successfully. * User cannot continue the payment process. * Payment request fails. * Subscription payment cannot be completed. * QR Code not display ## **Expected Result** * QRIS payment should be created successfully. * User should be redirected to the QRIS payment page or QR code. * Payment gateway should return a valid payment session. * Users should be able to complete the payment normally. ## **Impact** * Users cannot pay subscription invoices using QRIS. * Subscription payment workflow is blocked. * May lead to failed subscription activation or renewal. * Directly impacts the payment experience. ## **Evidence** **Jam.dev:** [](https://dev-v2.satuinbox.com/id/settings/subscriptions/billing?tab=top-up) https://dev-v2.satuinbox.com/id/settings/subscriptions/billing?tab=top-up ScreenShoot: ## Additional Notes Possible observations: * Payment request appears to fail before the payment gateway returns a valid QRIS session. * Need confirmation whether this issue originates from the backend payment service, payment gateway integration, or QRIS provider response. * Please review the payment request and response logs for the QRIS payment creation endpoint.

allWorkPackages.subject: Whatsapp Group Conversation - Long Messages Are Fully Rendered Without Truncation in WhatsApp Group Conversation
allWorkPackages.description: ## **Description** There is a conversation rendering issue in **WhatsApp Group Conversation** when a message contains a very large amount of text or mentions. Messages with excessive content are fully rendered without any truncation, collapse, or expandable mechanism. As a result, a single message can occupy a large portion of the conversation area and significantly impact readability and navigation. This behavior becomes more noticeable when users send messages containing a high number of mentions, causing the conversation timeline to become difficult to browse. ## **Steps to Reproduce** 1. Open a WhatsApp Group Conversation. 2. Create a message containing a very large amount of text or mentions (e.g. dozens or hundreds of mentions). 3. Send the message. 4. Observe the rendered message bubble in the conversation timeline. ## **Actual Result** * The entire message content is rendered immediately. * Message bubble becomes excessively tall. * No truncation or collapse mechanism is applied. * Users must scroll extensively to navigate past the message. * Conversation readability is reduced. ## **Expected Result** * Long messages should be displayed using an appropriate truncation or expandable mechanism. * Users should be able to expand the full content when needed. * Conversation timeline should remain readable and easy to navigate. * Excessively long messages should not dominate the conversation viewport. ## **Affected Environment (Bug Found)** * Dev ✅ * Staging * Prod ## **Tested Environment** * Dev * Staging * Prod ## **Additional Notes** Example scenarios: * Messages containing hundreds of mentions. * Messages with extremely long text content. * Messages generated from bulk tagging activities. ### **Impact** * Reduces conversation readability. * Makes timeline navigation difficult. * Increases scrolling effort for agents. * May affect productivity when reviewing conversation history. * Creates inconsistent user experience compared to common messaging applications that apply message truncation or expandable views for very long content.

allWorkPackages.subject: Leads - New Prospect - WhatsApp Number Field Allows Non-Numeric Input Before Save Sanitization

_**The WhatsApp Number field currently accepts alphabetic and other non-numeric characters during input.**_

JamDev: https://dev-v2.satuinbox.com/id/leads

During testing, users are able to enter arbitrary text into the WhatsApp Number field without receiving validation feedback. However, when the prospect is saved, the system automatically sanitizes the value and retains only the numeric portion.

This behavior may be intended, but it creates ambiguity because the field appears to accept invalid input while typing.

**Steps to Reproduce:**  
1\. Open Leads page.  
2\. Click "Tambah Prospek".  
3\. Select WhatsApp Web or WhatsApp API as Channel Source.  
4\. Enter a value containing alphabetic characters.

Example:  
abc08123456789xyz

5\. Save the prospect.

**Actual Result:**  
\- Non-numeric characters can be entered into the field.  
\- No validation message is displayed.  
\- System sanitizes the value during save.

**Expected Result:**  
Behavior should be clarified:  
\- Either restrict input to numeric characters only, OR  
\- Allow free input but provide validation feedback before save.

**Impact:**  
Minor UX / Validation inconsistency.  
Users may assume any entered value is valid because the field accepts non-numeric characters without warning.

**Please confirm the intended behavior for WhatsApp Number field:**

**1\. Hard Restriction**

   - Only numeric characters can be entered.

**2\. Soft Validation**

\- Any characters may be entered.

\- Validation message appears before save.

**3\. Sanitization Only (Current Behavior)**

\- Any characters may be entered.

\- System automatically removes invalid characters during save.  
  
Environment : DEV (dev-v2.satuinbox.com)  
Module      : Leads  
Feature     : Add New Prospect

allWorkPackages.subject: Ticket Conversation Room - Outbound Message Can Still Be Sent After Parent Conversation Is Closed
allWorkPackages.description:
# **Summary**

Ticket Conversation Room still allows outbound message after parent conversation is closed.

Message appears successfully in Ticket Conversation Room UI, but message is not delivered to customer device nor sender WhatsApp device.

Potential Fake Success behavior.

# **Environment**

*   Module: Ticket Conversation Room
    
*   Channel: WhatsApp
    
*   Environment: \[DEV\]
    
*   Recording: Attached
    

# **Preconditions**

1.  Active WhatsApp conversation exists.
    
2.  Ticket is linked to the conversation.
    
3.  Agent has access to Ticket Conversation Room.
    

# **Steps to Reproduce**

1.  Open active conversation.
    
2.  Create/Open linked ticket.
    
3.  Click **Tutup** on parent conversation.
    
4.  Open Ticket Conversation Room.
    
5.  Send a message from composer.
    

# **Actual Result**

*   Composer remains enabled.
    
*   Message can be sent.
    
*   Message appears in Ticket Conversation Room.
    
*   No error is shown.
    
*   Message is NOT received by customer.
    
*   Message is NOT visible on sender WhatsApp device.
    

# **Expected Result**

After parent conversation is closed:

Option A (Preferred)

*   Ticket Conversation Room composer should become disabled.
    
*   Agent should not be able to send outbound messages.
    
*   System should display information that the parent conversation has been closed.
    

Option B

*   If outbound messaging from Ticket Conversation Room is intentionally supported after parent conversation closure, then the message must be delivered through the actual WhatsApp channel and reflected on both sender and recipient sides.
    

System should not show successful outbound message when delivery is impossible.

# **Impact**

*   Agent assumes customer received the message.
    
*   Follow-up may be missed.
    
*   UI state differs from actual channel state.
    
*   Creates potential Fake Success scenario.
    

# **PRD Analysis**

### **Multi-Ticket Drafts from Single Chat Bubble**

FR-010

System MUST link every created ticket to the selected conversation and selected message reference as linked context.

Observation:  
Ticket is defined as linked context, not an independent communication channel.

### **Conversation Ownership**

Across existing Conversation-related PRDs:

*   Conversation acts as primary communication object.
    
*   Ticket acts as related operational object.
    

Potential gap:

No explicit rule found regarding outbound messaging behavior after parent conversation is closed.

Business clarification may be required.

# **Questions for Product / Engineering**

1.  Should Ticket Conversation Room inherit Closed state from parent conversation?
    
2.  Should composer be disabled when parent conversation status is Closed?
    
3.  If messaging is allowed after closure, where should outbound message be delivered?
    

# **Evidence**

*   JamDev: https://jam.dev/c/7ae1822b-47a9-48c1-bde5-d6adb18fd1bf

allWorkPackages.subject: Notification Search Missing Trim Validation & Pagination Metadata Not Updating After Filter
allWorkPackages.description:
## Jam.dev Evidence

Jam.dev Link: [https://app.betterbugs.io/session/6a0a726c247a3e53fa2f5e2d](https://app.betterbugs.io/session/6a0a726c247a3e53fa2f5e2d)

## Description

There are two issues in the Notification search functionality.

### Issue 1 – Missing Trim Validation on Search Input

The search input does not trim whitespace at the beginning or end of the keyword.

Examples:

```text
<space>369
369<space>
```

Because of this, existing data cannot be found even though the keyword itself is valid.

### Issue 2 – Pagination Metadata Not Updating After Search Filter

In the Updates tab, after entering a valid search keyword and the data becomes filtered correctly, the following metadata does not update:

*   Limit
    
*   Pagination page
    
*   Total count
    

The pagination state still shows old/unfiltered values even after the search results are filtered.

## Steps to Reproduce

### Scenario 1 – Trim Validation

1.  Navigate to Notification
    
2.  Select Primary or Updates tab
    
3.  Input search keyword with leading/trailing spaces
    
    *   Example:
        

```text
<space>369
369<space>
```

1.  Observe the search result
    

### Scenario 2 – Pagination/Total Not Updated

1.  Navigate to Notification
    
2.  Select Updates tab
    
3.  Input valid search keyword
    
4.  Observe:
    
    *   Filtered result
        
    *   Pagination page
        
    *   Limit
        
    *   Total count
        

## Actual Result

### Issue 1

*   Search fails when keyword contains leading/trailing spaces
    
*   Existing data is not found
    

### Issue 2

*   Filtered data appears correctly
    
*   Pagination page does not update
    
*   Limit value remains stale
    
*   Total count does not follow filtered data
    

## Expected Result

### Issue 1

*   Search input should automatically trim leading/trailing whitespace
    
*   Valid data should still be found despite extra spaces
    

### Issue 2

*   Pagination metadata should refresh after filtering/searching
    
*   Limit, page, and total count should follow filtered results
    
*   UI state should remain synchronized with filtered data
    

## Affected Environment (Bug Found)

*   [x] Dev
*   [ ] Staging
*   [x] Prod

## Tested Environment

*   [ ] Dev
*   [ ] Staging
*   [ ] Prod

## Additional Notes

Possible Root Causes:

*   Missing `.trim()` validation before executing search query
    
*   Pagination state not recalculated after filtered response
    
*   Total count still using unfiltered dataset
    
*   Search result and pagination metadata use different state sources
    

Impact:

*   Search usability becomes inconsistent
    
*   Users may think data does not exist
    
*   Pagination information becomes misleading
    
*   Poor UX during notification filtering

allWorkPackages.description:
### **Jam.dev Evidence**

Jam.dev Link: [https://app.betterbugs.io/session/69f16b51b1ac0d1fedf1a4e8](https://app.betterbugs.io/session/69f16b51b1ac0d1fedf1a4e8)

### **Description**

There are multiple issues within the **Notification** feature related to interaction behavior and missing reminders:

1.  **Incorrect behavior in “Updates” section**  
    Clicking the **mark-as-read indicator** incorrectly triggers navigation (redirect). This should not happen.
    
2.  **Incorrect behavior in “Primary” section**  
    Clicking a notification item does not trigger navigation, whereas it should redirect to the related content.
    
3.  **Missing reminder notification**  
    There is no notification reminder for payment schedules **before D-3 (3 days before due date)**, which is expected to be present.
    

### **Steps to Reproduce**

1.  Click on the **Notification** menu
    
2.  Go to **Updates** tab:
    
    *   Click on the **read indicator / mark-as-read area**
        
3.  Observe behavior (unexpected redirect)
    
4.  Go to **Primary** tab:
    
    *   Click on a notification item in the list
        
5.  Observe behavior (no navigation occurs)
    
6.  Check reminder notifications:
    
    *   Look for payment reminder notifications before **D-3 due date**
        

### **Actual Result**

*   **Updates tab:**
    
    *   Clicking the read indicator triggers navigation (should not happen)
        
*   **Primary tab:**
    
    *   Clicking notification item does **not** navigate anywhere (should navigate)
        
*   **Reminder:**
    
    *   No notification appears for payment reminder before D-3 due date
        

### **Expected Result**

*   **Updates tab:**
    
    *   Clicking read indicator should **only mark as read**, without navigation
        
    *   Navigation should only happen when clicking the notification item itself
        
*   **Primary tab:**
    
    *   Clicking notification item should **navigate to the related page**
        
    *   Read indicator should behave like Updates (no navigation)
        
*   **Reminder:**
    
    *   System should generate notification **at least D-3 before payment due date**
        

### **Affected Environment (Bug Found)**

*   [x] Dev
*   [ ] Staging
*   [x] Prod

### **Tested Environment**

*   [ ] Dev
*   [ ] Staging
*   [ ] Prod

### **Additional Notes**

**Possible Root Causes:**

*   Event handler overlap between click area (mark-as-read vs item click)
    
*   Incorrect binding of navigation logic in Primary tab
    
*   Missing conditional trigger or scheduler for payment reminder notifications
    
*   Notification schema or cron job not properly configured
    

**Impact:**

*   Poor user experience due to incorrect interaction behavior
    
*   Users may accidentally navigate when only intending to mark as read
    
*   Important notifications (payment reminders) are missed
    
*   Risk of late payments due to lack of reminder system

allWorkPackages.subject: Pricing Email Blast
allWorkPackages.description:
## Deskripsi

Menentukan dan menetapkan pricing untuk fitur Email Blast di SatuInbox.

## Objective

Membuat struktur pricing yang kompetitif dan profitable untuk layanan Email Blast.

## Scope Pekerjaan

### 1. Riset Pricing Kompetitor
- [ ] Survey harga email blast dari kompetitor (Mailchimp, SendGrid, dll)
- [ ] Analisis fitur yang ditawarkan kompetitor
- [ ] Identifikasi unique value proposition SatuInbox

### 2. Cost Analysis
- [ ] Hitung biaya operasional per email (infrastructure, SMTP provider, dll)
- [ ] Estimasi cost untuk berbagai volume email:
  - Small: 1,000 - 10,000 emails/bulan
  - Medium: 10,000 - 100,000 emails/bulan
  - Large: 100,000+ emails/bulan
- [ ] Calculate margin target

### 3. Pricing Model Design
- [ ] Tentukan pricing tiers (Basic, Professional, Enterprise)
- [ ] Define quota per tier:
  - Jumlah email per bulan
  - Jumlah contact list
  - Advanced features (segmentation, automation, analytics)
- [ ] Pay-as-you-go vs Subscription model

### 4. Pricing Table
Create pricing table dengan format:

| Tier | Price/month | Email Quota | Contact List | Features |
|------|-------------|-------------|--------------|----------|
| Basic | Rp X | X emails | X contacts | Basic features |
| Professional | Rp Y | Y emails | Y contacts | + Advanced segmentation |
| Enterprise | Custom | Unlimited | Unlimited | Full features + support |

### 5. Additional Charges
- [ ] Overage pricing (jika melebihi quota)
- [ ] Additional contact list pricing
- [ ] Premium features (dedicated IP, custom domain)

## Deliverables

- [ ] Pricing comparison sheet (competitor analysis)
- [ ] Cost breakdown spreadsheet
- [ ] Final pricing recommendation
- [ ] Pricing table for marketing material
- [ ] Documentation untuk sales team

## Considerations

**Faktor yang perlu dipertimbangkan:**
- Market positioning (premium vs affordable)
- Customer segment (SME vs Enterprise)
- Competitor pricing
- Infrastructure cost + profit margin
- Scalability untuk volume besar
- Flexibility untuk custom pricing

**Questions to Answer:**
- Apakah ada minimum commitment (monthly/yearly)?
- Apakah ada free tier untuk trial?
- Bagaimana handle customer yang mau upgrade/downgrade?
- Pricing untuk API access?

## Success Criteria

- [ ] Pricing model sudah final dan approved
- [ ] Cost analysis menunjukkan margin yang healthy
- [ ] Kompetitif dengan market rate
- [ ] Sales team sudah briefed tentang pricing
- [ ] Pricing documentation ready untuk customer

allWorkPackages.description:
### **Jam.dev Evidence**

*   Jam.dev Link: [https://jam.dev/c/27b0f3a5-1e74-4815-8d6f-81272f1e13c6](https://jam.dev/c/27b0f3a5-1e74-4815-8d6f-81272f1e13c6)
    

## **Description**

There are multiple functional and UX issues in **Settings → Organization → Members**, affecting **member management actions, password generation behavior, and search state persistence**.

These issues allow unintended self-edit actions, restrict password usability, prevent member deletion, and cause inconsistent UI state when navigating between tabs.

# **Issue 1 – Logged-in User Can Edit Their Own Account**

### **Actual Result**

*   The currently authenticated user **appears in the member list**
    
*   The user can perform actions on their own account, such as:
    
    *   **Change password**
        
    *   Other edit actions
        

### **Expected Result**

*   The **currently authenticated user should not appear in the editable member list**
    
*   Users should **not be able to modify their own account from the members management table**
    

# **Issue 3 – Delete Member Action Does Not Work**

### **Actual Result**

*   Clicking **Delete Member** produces **no effect**
    
*   Member is **not removed**
    
*   No success or error feedback is shown
    

### **Expected Result**

*   Clicking **Delete Member** should:
    
    *   Open a **confirmation modal**
        
    *   Allow user to confirm deletion
        
*   After confirmation:
    
    *   Member should be **deleted successfully**
        
    *   A **success toast** should appear
        
*   If deletion fails:
    
    *   An **error toast** should appear
        

# **Issue 4 – Search State Does Not Reset After Navigating Away**

### **Actual Result**

*   When searching by **team member name or alias**:
    
    *   Search results appear correctly
        
*   After navigating to another menu/tab and returning to **Members**:
    
    *   The **previous search state remains**
        
    *   Results are still filtered
        

This also occurs in the **Invited Members tab (Diundang)**.

### **Expected Result**

*   When leaving and returning to the **Members** page:
    
    *   The search input should **reset to default**
        
    *   The member list should **reload the full data**
        

## **Steps to Reproduce**

1.  Navigate to **Settings → Organization → Members**
    
2.  Perform the following tests:
    
    *   Try editing the currently logged-in account
        
    *   Attempt to manually enter a password when changing a member password
        
    *   Try deleting a member
        
    *   Use the search input to search by team member or alias
        
3.  Navigate to another menu
    
4.  Return to **Members**
    
5.  Observe the search state
    
6.  Repeat the same test in the **Invited (Diundang)** tab

*   [ ] Staging
*   [x] Prod

## **Tested Environment**

*   [ ] Dev
*   [ ] Staging
*   [ ] Prod

## **Additional Notes**

Possible root causes:

*   Self-user filtering not implemented in member list query
    
*   Password input component restricted to generated values
    
*   Delete API action not connected to UI handler
    
*   Search state stored globally and not reset on navigation
    

Impact:

*   Security and access control concerns
    
*   Poor usability for password management
    
*   Broken member deletion functionality

allWorkPackages.subject: Settings-Subscription-Payment- Voucher State Not Reset When Changing Package in Manage Package
