allWorkPackages.subject: Global Search Suggestion - When trying to filter conversation by relation not working
allWorkPackages.description: # 🐞 Bug Report ## Summary When a user attempts to filter conversations using the "Filter berdasarkan Relasi" (Filter by Relation) feature, the filter does not apply. The conversation list remains unchanged regardless of which relation label filter is selected, it was no records are filtered in or out. This affects the relation label quick-filter capability defined in the PRD, which allows users to narrow their view to records sharing a specific system relation label (for example, all conversations tagged with `AWB • JNE123456789` or in the example jamdev is `Order ID • P, masup?` ). The filter is selectable in the UI, but selecting it produces no change to the displayed conversation list, rendering the feature non-functional. ## Environment ## Steps to Reproduce 1. Log in as an Admin or Agent with access to conversations that have relation labels applied. 2. Navigate to the **Conversation List** page. 3. Locate and open the **"Filter berdasarkan Relasi"** (Filter by Relation) control. 4. Select a system relation label from the available filter options (for example, `AWB • JNE123456789`). 5. Observe the conversation list. 6. Try selecting a different relation label or clearing the filter. 7. Observe the list again. ## Actual Result * The conversation list does not change after selecting a relation label filter. * All conversations remain visible regardless of the selected filter. * The filter UI appears to accept the selection (visually indicates a filter is active), but no filtering logic executes. * Clearing the filter also produces no visible change to the list. ## Expected Result * Selecting a relation label filter should narrow the conversation list to display **only** conversations that carry the selected system relation label. * Selecting a different label should re-filter the list accordingly. * Clearing the filter should restore the full, unfiltered conversation list. * The filter control should be visually distinct from manual tag filters (per FR-024). ## Impact ## Evidence ## Initial Observation * The "Filter berdasarkan Relasi" control is visible and interactive in the Conversation List UI. * Selecting a relation label filter updates the UI state (appears selected), but no API request appears to be triggered. * The conversation list does not re-render or re-sort. * No error message, loading state, or visual feedback indicates that filtering was attempted. * The behavior is consistent across multiple relation labels — none trigger filtering. ## Possible Root Cause Possible affected areas: * Frontend — Conversation List filter component * Frontend — Filter state to API query parameter mapping * Backend — Conversation list endpoint (filter parameter handling) * Backend — Relation label query/index The filter selection may not be wired to the conversation list's data-fetching logic. Either: * The frontend does not dispatch a request with the selected relation label as a query parameter when the filter changes. * The backend conversation list endpoint does not accept or process a relation label filter parameter. * The relation label field is not indexed or queryable at the database level. ## Recommendation  1. Verify the frontend filter component dispatches the selected relation label value as a query parameter (for example, `?relationLabel=rel.awb.jne123456789`) when the filter changes. 2. Confirm the backend Conversation List API endpoint accepts and processes the relation label filter parameter. 3. Check whether the relation label data is indexed or queryable in the database — if it is stored separately from the conversation document, a join or indexed lookup may be required. 4. After fixing, test with multiple relation labels and verify filter clearing works. 5. Coordinate with PRD FR-023 and FR-024 to ensure the filter is visually separated from manual tag filters and supports exact-value matching for high-confidence identifiers. ## Additional Notes * **Related PRD**: Ticket #2228 — "Global Search - improvement autotag after search" (Actionable Shared Attribute Search & System Relation Labels) * **Related Requirement**: FR-023 \[P1\] — Search or downstream surfaces SHOULD support quick filtering by system relation label value. * **Related Requirement**: FR-024 \[P1\] — System relation filters MUST be visually separated from manual tags. * **Related Requirement**: FR-025 \[P1\] — Exact-value search for relation labels SHOULD be supported for high-confidence identifiers like AWB and Order ID. * **Success Metric**: PRD §18 — "Relation filter reuse rate ≥ 20% of applied relation labels reused via filter shortcut within 30 days" — unmeasurable while this bug exists. * **Precondition**: At least one conversation in the list has a system relation label applied (via "Beri Tag Relasi Otomatis" from Global Search). * This bug was discovered during manual testing of the relation label quick-filter feature.

allWorkPackages.subject: Notification - Incorrect Time Display in Notification Description (Using UTC Instead of Local Time)
allWorkPackages.description: **Jam.dev Evidence** ## **Description** There is a time display issue in the **notification description** for **subscription updates**. When a user performs an action such as **upgrading a subscription (Manage Package)**, the notification description displays the timestamp using **UTC time**, instead of the **local time zone**. This results in incorrect or confusing time information for users. ## **Steps to Reproduce** 1. Navigate to **Settings → Subscription → Payments → Manage Package** 2. Perform an **upgrade** (or any package change) 3. Complete the payment process 4. Go to **Notifications** 5. Focus on the **notification description** related to the subscription update 6. Compare the displayed time with the system/local time ## **Actual Result** * Notification description shows time in **UTC format** * The displayed time does **not match the user’s local time** * Time is inconsistent with other UI elements (e.g., timestamps near punctuation or labels) ## **Expected Result** * Notification time should: * Use the **same time standard as the rest of the application (local time)** * Match the time format displayed in other UI components * Time should be: * Accurate and consistent * Easily understandable by users without timezone confusion ## **Affected Environment (Bug Found)** * \[x\]  Dev * [ ] Staging * [ ] Prod ## **Tested Environment** * [ ] Dev * [ ] Staging * [ ] Prod ## **Additional Notes** Possible root causes: * Backend returning UTC timestamp without conversion * Frontend not converting UTC to local timezone * Inconsistent date formatting across components Impact: * Confusing notification timestamps * Inconsistent UX across the application * Potential misunderstanding of event timing

allWorkPackages.subject: WhatsApp Group Messages - From Certain Participants Are Not Displayed in SatuInbox and Reply Context Is Missing
allWorkPackages.description: Overview An anomaly was found in WhatsApp Group conversations where messages from certain participants are successfully delivered and visible in the native WhatsApp application (mobile/web), but those messages do not appear in the SatuInbox Group Conversation. Additionally, when another participant replies to the missing message from WhatsApp Mobile/Web, the reply message is received in SatuInbox, but the reply context is missing. The message is displayed as a normal message instead of a reply message. here are the jamdev record: [https://dev-v2.satuinbox.com/id/conversation/channel?channel=whatsapp\_web\_group](https://dev-v2.satuinbox.com/id/conversation/channel?channel=whatsapp_web_group) This creates a conversation inconsistency between WhatsApp and SatuInbox and may cause agents to lose context when handling group discussions. Steps to Reproduce 1. Open a WhatsApp Group connected to SatuInbox. 2. Send a message from Participant A through WhatsApp Mobile/Web. 3. Verify that the message is visible in WhatsApp. 4. Open the same group conversation in SatuInbox. 5. Observe that the message from Participant A does not appear in the conversation timeline. 6. From WhatsApp Mobile/Web, reply to the missing message using another participant account. 7. Check the group conversation in SatuInbox. Actual Result * Certain participant messages are not displayed in SatuInbox Group Conversation. * Reply messages referencing the missing message are displayed as regular messages. * Reply context (quoted message / reply reference) is not rendered. * Conversation history becomes inconsistent compared to native WhatsApp. Expected Result * All group messages visible in WhatsApp should be synchronized and displayed in SatuInbox. * Reply messages should preserve and display their original reply context. * Conversation timeline in SatuInbox should remain consistent with WhatsApp Group history. Impact * Agents may miss important messages from specific participants. * Reply relationships between messages are lost. * Group conversation context becomes incomplete and difficult to follow. * Potential indication of message synchronization or message metadata processing issue for specific group participants. Additional Notes * All the number that can't send message is already register before and current status was "Disconnected" * The typing indicator was show, but the message was not show. Based on initial observation, the issue appears related to messages that never arrive or are not persisted in SatuInbox. As a result, when another message references the missing message, the reply metadata cannot be resolved and the reply context is lost.

allWorkPackages.subject: Ticket List - KPI Card Counter Not Synced During Real-Time Ticket List Pagination Update
allWorkPackages.description: ### **Jam.dev Evidence** https://app.betterbugs.io/session/6a0284177f4f22a836c0c9c9 ### **Description** There is a synchronization issue in the **Ticket List → KPI Card** section during concurrent activity between two users. In this scenario: * **User 1** is only navigating through ticket list pagination * **User 2** is actively creating new ticket data When User 2 creates a new ticket and the latest ticket data is updated successfully, User 1 experiences inconsistent KPI Card values during pagination changes. The ticket list data updates correctly and shows the latest tickets, but the KPI Card counters are not updated accordingly. The KPI Card values only follow the currently displayed pagination data instead of reflecting the latest real-time total. ### **Steps to Reproduce** #### **User Setup** * User 1 = Admin * User 2 = Admin #### **Scenario** 1. Login as \*\*User 1 ->\*\*alt web1 2. Navigate to **Ticket List** 3. Move between pagination pages: * Example: page 25 → page 26 4. Login as **User 2 -> alt web incognito** 5. Navigate to **Ticket List** 6. Create a new ticket 7. Submit the ticket successfully 8. Return to **User 1** 9. Continue pagination navigation and observe: * Ticket list data * KPI Card counters ### **Actual Result** **User1** * Ticket list displays the latest updated ticket data * KPI Card counters are not updated consistently * Data total between ticket list and KPI Card becomes inconsistent ### **Expected Result** **User1** * KPI Card counters should update dynamically and stay synchronized with the latest ticket data * Both ticket list data and KPI Card counters should reflect the same real-time state ### **Affected Environment (Bug Found)** * [x] Dev * [ ] Staging * [ ] Prod ### **Tested Environment** * [x] Dev masih sama harus reload baru update with same number * [ ] Staging * [ ] Prod ### **Additional Notes** **Possible Root Causes:** * KPI Card state is tied to paginated data response instead of global/latest ticket totals * Missing re-fetch or websocket refresh for KPI Card during concurrent updates * Pagination API response overwrites KPI Card state with stale values * Race condition between pagination request and latest ticket update request **Impact:** * KPI metrics become unreliable during active usage * Users see inconsistent ticket statistics * Real-time dashboard accuracy is reduced * Confusing experience for teams monitoring ticket activity

allWorkPackages.subject: Analitycs - report offline - Offline Report Status Not Updating on Pagination or Navigation
allWorkPackages.description:
### **Jam.dev Evidence**

Jam.dev Link: [https://app.betterbugs.io/session/69f1a356065d02218caea4de](https://app.betterbugs.io/session/69f1a356065d02218caea4de)

### **Description**

There is an issue in the **Offline Report → Request Report** page where the report status does not update dynamically after submission.

After creating a report, the initial status is shown as **“On Progress”**. However, when the user navigates between pages (next/previous pagination) or switches menus and returns, the status remains unchanged.

The status only updates correctly after performing a **manual page reload**.

### **Steps to Reproduce**

1.  Navigate to **Analytics → Offline Report**
    
2.  Go to **Request Report**
    
3.  Select:
    
    *   Start Date
        
    *   End Date
        
4.  Click **Submit**
    
5.  Observe the initial status (**On Progress**)
    
6.  Perform one of the following actions:
    
    *   Click **Next Page** or **Previous Page**
        
    *   Navigate to another menu, then return to **Offline Report**
        
7.  Observe the report status
    

### **Actual Result**

*   Status remains **“On Progress”** even after navigation or pagination
    
*   Status does not update automatically
    
*   Status only updates after **manual page refresh (reload)**
    

### **Expected Result**

*   Status should update automatically when:
    
    *   Navigating between pages (pagination)
        
    *   Switching menus and returning
        
*   No manual refresh should be required
    
*   UI should reflect the latest status from backend in real-time or near real-time
    

### **Affected Environment (Bug Found)**

*   [x] Dev
*   [ ] Staging
*   [ ] Prod

### **Tested Environment**

*   [ ] Dev
*   [ ] Staging
*   [ ] Prod

### **Additional Notes**

**Possible Root Causes:**

*   Frontend is caching old data and not re-fetching on navigation
    
*   Missing API re-call on pagination or page revisit
    
*   No polling / refresh mechanism for status updates
    
*   State management not triggering re-render with updated data
    

**Impact:**

*   Users see outdated report status
    
*   Confusing user experience (report appears stuck in “On Progress”)
    
*   Users may think report generation failed or is delayed
    
*   Reduces trust in system responsiveness

allWorkPackages.description: # **PRODUCT REQUIREMENT DOCUMENT** **Feature**: Global Search — Unified Conversation & Ticket Search PRD docs link : [https://docs.google.com/document/d/1CLptCF8uXKaKjHmpoxL5TRGwR1nSVrtj7\_m4ieP2pyA/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.8tqz7kgusy92](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1CLptCF8uXKaKjHmpoxL5TRGwR1nSVrtj7_m4ieP2pyA/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.8tqz7kgusy92) figma link : [https://www.figma.com/design/RAAuLaQKUufWMWWEm0kMb9/-V2--Satuinbox-Web-Specs?node-id=11679-35161&t=zm2NSsxoAsPqjXcX-1](https://www.figma.com/design/RAAuLaQKUufWMWWEm0kMb9/-V2--Satuinbox-Web-Specs?node-id=11679-35161&t=zm2NSsxoAsPqjXcX-1) **Product Manager**: Dany Christian **Engineering Lead**: Naftal Yunior **Design Lead**: TBD **Contributors**: Engineering Team, QA Team, Design Team **Version**: v1.0 **TRD**: — ## **1\. Revision History** ## **2\. Overview** ### **Scope Definition** ### **Roadmap Alignment** ## **3\. Problem Statement** ## **4\. Objectives and Key Results** ## **5\. User Stories and Acceptance Criteria** ## **6\. Functional Requirements** ### **Access and Entry Mode** ### **Search Scope and Matching** ### **Result Composition** ### **Ranking and Prioritization** ### **State Handling** ### **Roadmap Compatibility** ## **7\. Error Handling** ## **8\. Edge Cases** ## **9\. UI & UX Requirements** **All UI copy must be Bahasa Indonesia.** ## **10\. Field & Validation** ## **11\. Non-Functional Requirements** ## **12\. Dependencies & Risks** ## **13\. Permission Matrix** ## **14\. API / Event Contract** ## **15\. Analytics & Observability Plan** ## **16\. Success Metrics** ## **17\. Future Considerations** ## **18\. Limitations** ## **19\. Appendix** QA notes : # QA Assessment Report: Shared Attribute Discovery & Related Record Suggestions > **Assessment Type:** Type 1 — Feature Development Analysis + Type 3 — Interconnection Analysis **Source PRD / Source Input:** `PRD/Conversationv2/PRD - Global Search (Conversation + Ticket).md` **Assessment Artifact Path:** `Assessments/global-search/global-search/global-search-qa-assessment.md` **Version:** `v2.2` **Previous Version:** `Assessments/global-search/global-search/versions/global-search-qa-assessment-v2.1.md` **Rules Applied:** `Rules/qa-analysis-rule.md`, `Rules/impact-analysis-rule.md`, `Rules/prd-writing-rule.md`, `Rules/workflow-rule.md`, `Rules/structure-rule.md` **Reference Memory:** `Memory/global-memory.md`, `Memory/CLAUDE-be.md`, `Memory/CLAUDE-fe.md`, `Memory/comprehensive-undeveloped-features-analysis.md` **Tanggal Analisa:** 2026-06-15 **Status:** Draft ## 0\. Ringkasan Perubahan Analisa * **v1.0–v1.2:** fokus pada **generic Global Search** lintas Conversation + Ticket, termasuk message-body search, drawer UX, dan cross-collection search pipeline. * **v2.0:** feature direframe menjadi **shared-attribute discovery roadmap** berbasis identifier bisnis seperti `AWB`, `Order ID`, `Tracking Number`. * **v2.1:** UX surface diperjelas: hasil pencarian Phase 1 menggunakan **popup modal centered overlay** sebagai primary surface, bukan drawer. * **v2.2:** Diagram visual di Section 4 dikembalikan agar perbandingan **Current State vs Proposed State** lebih mudah dibaca. Diagram sekarang mencakup current fragmented state, phased target model, recommended delivery model, dan one-engine-many-consumers principle. * Generic search **bukan lagi tujuan utama**. Search sekarang diposisikan sebagai **Phase 1 discovery surface** untuk mendeteksi record terkait sebelum grouping/handling lanjutan. * Fase roadmap baru: * **Phase 1:** Global Search Suggestions lintas Ticket + Conversation berdasarkan shared attributes. * **Phase 2:** Automatic Ticket Tagging + grouped/related ticket visibility. * **Phase 3:** Automatic Conversation Tagging + related conversation visibility. * Revisi ini **mengurangi scope generic search** tetapi **meningkatkan interconnection risk** karena sekarang feature overlap langsung dengan PRD `Related Tickets and Ticket Merge Suggestion`, `Related Conversations Grouping`, dan `Conversation Custom Attributes`. ## 1\. Overview **Feature / Issue:** Shared Attribute Discovery & Related Record Suggestions **Objective:** Memungkinkan agent menemukan, menghubungkan, dan memahami tiket/percakapan yang berbagi business attribute yang sama (misalnya AWB, Order ID, Tracking Number) agar handling customer lebih konsisten, tidak duplikatif, dan lebih traceable. **Business Context:** * Saat ini identifier operasional seperti AWB atau Order ID tersebar di custom attributes, custom fields, atau message context. * Agent sering menangani kasus baru tanpa tahu bahwa ticket atau conversation lain dengan konteks bisnis yang sama sudah ada. * Satu customer journey bisa pecah ke banyak channel, banyak ticket, dan banyak conversation. * Workspace sudah punya arah fitur `Related Tickets` dan `Related Conversations`, tetapi discovery surface lintas domain belum ada. * Maka Global Search tidak lagi cukup didefinisikan sebagai pencarian generik; ia harus menjadi **entry point untuk relationship discovery**. **Scope In (reframed):** * Search lintas Ticket + Conversation berbasis shared business attributes. * Match explanation (`Matched by`, `Matched value`) untuk menjelaskan kenapa record muncul. * Suggestion surface untuk menemukan existing record sebelum user membuat atau menangani case baru. * Roadmap alignment menuju automatic tagging di Ticket dan Conversation. * Reuse dan sinkronisasi dengan PRD `Related Tickets and Ticket Merge Suggestion` serta `Related Conversations Grouping`. **Scope Out (untuk PRD ini):** * Generic free-text search sebagai core objective. * Full message history discovery sebagai fokus utama. * AI semantic search atau fuzzy matching. * Merge logic detail Ticket/Conversation di PRD ini. * Full implementation detail Phase 2 dan Phase 3 — harus dipatch di PRD domain masing-masing. ## 2\. Decision Summary ### 2.1 Final Decision **Decision Enum:** `PROCEED_WITH_CAUTION` **Decision Class:** `CONDITIONAL_GO` **Decision Statement:** > Arah baru ini valid dan lebih kuat secara bisnis dibanding generic global search, **asal** diposisikan sebagai roadmap bertahap, bukan satu feature monolitik. Phase 1 boleh lanjut sebagai discovery/search suggestions berbasis shared attributes. Phase 2 dan Phase 3 harus diperlakukan sebagai patch lanjutan ke PRD Ticket dan Conversation yang sudah ada, bukan ditumpuk sekaligus di PRD ini. ### 2.2 Required Actions Before Development * [ ] **Reframe PRD**: ubah Global Search menjadi **Phase 1: Shared Attribute Discovery** dengan objective yang attribute-centric, bukan generic search-centric. * [ ] **Define source of truth untuk shared attributes**: field mana saja yang boleh jadi match key lintas domain (`awb`, `order_id`, `tracking_number`, dll.). * [ ] **Putuskan lifecycle auto-tagging**: tag bersifat derived/system-generated atau persisted/manual-editable? * [ ] **Patch existing domain PRDs** untuk Phase 2 dan 3: * `PRD Ticket - Related Tickets and Ticket Merge Suggestion.md` * `PRD Ticket - Omnichannel Inbox - Related Conversations Grouping.md` * [ ] **Konfirmasi status implementasi Collections** pada Conversation Custom Attributes, karena phase ini mengandalkan attribute-level matching dan memory saat ini masih mencatat collections sebagai undeveloped. * [ ] **Putuskan exact-match normalization** untuk identifier (strip dash, uppercase, whitespace normalization, alias field mapping). ### 2.3 Key Blocking Reasons / Conditions * **Condition 1:** Jangan campur generic message-body search sebagai objective utama jika target bisnisnya adalah related-record discovery berbasis shared attributes. * **Condition 2:** Auto-tagging Ticket/Conversation tidak boleh didefinisikan samar — harus jelas source, trigger, update, removal, audit, dan manual override. * **Condition 3:** Related Tickets dan Related Conversations sudah punya PRD sendiri. PRD ini tidak boleh menduplikasi atau menimpa behavior domain tersebut tanpa patch eksplisit. * **Condition 4:** Jika shared-attribute registry belum jelas, hasil suggestion akan tidak konsisten antar domain. ### 2.4 Complexity and Risk Snapshot * **Complexity Level:** High * **Risk Level:** High * **Primary Impact Areas:** Search, Ticket, Conversation, Custom Attributes, Custom Fields, RBAC, UI/UX, Data Model, Observability ## 3\. Requirement Summary ### 3.1 Reframed Business Rules ### 3.2 Key Analysis Finding 1. **Arah baru lebih tepat secara bisnis** dibanding generic search, karena langsung meng-address duplicate handling dan fragmented customer context. 2. **PRD lama terlalu lebar** untuk objective baru: message-body search, generic ranking, dan broad result model akan menambah biaya tanpa langsung menyelesaikan shared-context problem. 3. **Phase 2 dan 3 bukan sekadar enhancement UI** — keduanya mengubah tagging model, related-record visibility, dan mungkin persistence/data model. 4. **Ada overlap kuat** dengan PRD existing: * Related Tickets and Merge * Related Conversations Grouping * Conversation Custom Attributes 5. **Roadmap ini harus menjaga satu engine matching** agar tidak lahir tiga versi logic berbeda antara search, ticket, dan conversation. ### 3.3 Assumptions ### 3.4 Clarifications Needed ## 4\. Current State vs Proposed State ### 4.1 Current State (As-Is) * Search lintas domain baru berada di level konsep generic global search. * Related Tickets belum developed. * Related Conversations belum developed. * Conversation Custom Attribute Collections masih dicatat undeveloped di memory. * Tidak ada consistent cross-domain shared-attribute discovery surface. * Tidak ada automatic tagging system untuk shared-attribute grouping. ```text ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ CURRENT STATE (AS-IS) │ ├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤ │ │ │ Customer issue / business context │ │ e.g. AWB-1234, Order-7788, Tracking XYZ │ │ │ │ │ ├──────────────────────┬──────────────────────┐ │ │ ▼ ▼ ▼ │ │ Conversation System Ticket System Agent Handling │ │ ┌──────────────────┐ ┌──────────────────┐ ┌───────────┐ │ │ │ custom attrs │ │ custom fields │ │ Agent must│ │ │ │ properties │ │ title/desc │ │ guess where│ │ │ │ messages │ │ replies │ │ to search │ │ │ └──────────────────┘ └──────────────────┘ └───────────┘ │ │ │ │ │ │ │ ❌ no shared discovery ❌ no shared discovery ❌ no │ │ ❌ no auto-tagging ❌ no auto-tagging unified │ │ ❌ related conversations ❌ related tickets context │ │ not implemented not implemented │ │ │ │ Result: fragmented case context, duplicate handling, low traceability│ │ │ └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` ### 4.2 Proposed State (To-Be) #### Phase 1 — Shared Attribute Global Search Suggestions User memasukkan identifier seperti `AWB-1234` → system mencari Ticket + Conversation yang memiliki attribute/value yang sama → hasil tampil sebagai suggestions dengan alasan match. #### Phase 2 — Automatic Ticket Tagging + Related Ticket Visibility Saat shared attribute terdeteksi di Ticket → system menghasilkan system-tag/derived-tag → Ticket Module menampilkan grouped/related ticket information berdasarkan tag dan/atau match key tersebut. #### Phase 3 — Automatic Conversation Tagging + Related Conversation Visibility Saat shared attribute terdeteksi di Conversation → system menghasilkan system-tag/derived-tag → Conversation Module menampilkan related conversation context dan navigasi terkait. ```text ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ PROPOSED STATE (TO-BE) │ ├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤ │ │ │ Shared business attribute │ │ e.g. AWB-1234 │ │ │ │ │ ▼ │ │ ┌──────────────────────────────┐ │ │ │ Shared Matching Engine │ │ │ │ - exact normalized match │ │ │ │ - same rules cross-domain │ │ │ │ - same explanation source │ │ │ └──────────────┬───────────────┘ │ │ │ │ │ ┌───────────────┼────────────────┬────────────────────────┐ │ │ ▼ ▼ ▼ ▼ │ │ Phase 1 Phase 2 Phase 3 Future │ │ Search Ticket Conversation Consumers │ │ Suggestions Auto-Tagging Auto-Tagging (analytics, │ │ + popup + grouped + related visibility audits, etc)│ │ results ticket context + navigation │ │ │ │ Output principle: │ │ matchedBy + matchedValue + RBAC-safe result + reusable logic │ │ │ └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` ### 4.3 Recommended Delivery Model ```text ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ RECOMMENDED DELIVERY MODEL │ ├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤ │ │ │ Phase 1: DISCOVERY │ │ Search popup / full-page fallback │ │ └─ goal: find related records before action │ │ │ │ Phase 2: TICKET ACTIONABILITY │ │ Patch Related Tickets PRD │ │ └─ goal: auto-tag + grouped/related ticket visibility │ │ │ │ Phase 3: CONVERSATION ACTIONABILITY │ │ Patch Related Conversations PRD │ │ └─ goal: auto-tag + related conversation visibility │ │ │ │ Rule: │ │ DO NOT build 3 separate matching logics. │ │ Build 1 shared engine, then phase consumers on top. │ │ │ └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` ### 4.4 Key Architectural Principle > **Satu engine matching, banyak consumer.** > > Matching logic shared-attribute harus menjadi satu reusable rule/service/pipeline yang dipakai oleh: > > 1. Global Search Suggestions > > 2. Ticket auto-tagging > > 3. Conversation auto-tagging > > 4. Related Ticket suggestions > > 5. Related Conversation suggestions > Jika tiap surface membuat logic matching sendiri, hasil relation akan saling bertentangan. ```text ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ ONE MATCHING ENGINE, MANY CONSUMERS │ ├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤ │ │ │ Shared Matching Engine │ │ (normalization + approved keys + ranking policy) │ │ │ │ │ ┌───────────────────────┼───────────────────────┐ │ │ ▼ ▼ ▼ │ │ Search Suggestions Ticket Auto-Tags Conversation Auto-Tags │ │ │ │ │ │ │ ▼ ▼ ▼ │ │ Related Search UI Related Ticket UX Related Conversation UX│ │ │ │ BAD PATTERN TO AVOID: │ │ Search logic A ≠ Ticket logic B ≠ Conversation logic C │ │ │ └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` ## 5\. Impact Analysis ## 6\. Dependency Analysis ### 6.1 Dependency Matrix ### 6.2 Shared Resources / Event Mapping Potential shared resources: * match key configuration / registry * search indexes for shared attributes * system tag generation logic * audit trail for derived-tag add/remove events * optional background backfill jobs Potential event surfaces (future): * `ticket.shared-attribute.detected` * `conversation.shared-attribute.detected` * `ticket.system-tag.updated` * `conversation.system-tag.updated` > Belum wajib di Phase 1, tetapi jika Phase 2/3 ingin near-real-time, event strategy harus dipikirkan dari awal. ## 7\. Risk Analysis ### 7.1 Risk Matrix ### 7.2 Worst-Case Scenarios 1. **Mismatch engine:** Search bilang related, tetapi Ticket/Conversation tidak menunjukkan relation yang sama. 2. **Tag drift:** Tag tetap ada meski AWB sudah berubah atau field dihapus. 3. **Spec fragmentation:** Search roadmap, Related Tickets PRD, dan Related Conversations PRD berkembang ke tiga model bisnis yang berbeda. ## 8\. Test Strategy ### 8.1 Functional Scope * Search by shared attribute (`AWB-1234`, `ORDER-88`, tracking number) * Suggestion results muncul lintas Ticket dan Conversation * `Matched by` dan `Matched value` akurat * Exact normalized match (dash/space/case variations) * No cross-tenant leakage * No out-of-scope role leakage * Ticket/Conversation tanpa match tidak muncul sebagai related suggestion ### 8.2 Regression Scope * Existing Ticket search relevance * Existing Conversation search behavior * Existing tag rendering in Ticket and Conversation * Existing Related Tickets PRD assumptions * Existing Related Conversations PRD assumptions * Existing Custom Attributes searchability ### 8.3 Integration Scope * Search ↔ shared attribute registry * Search ↔ ticket custom fields * Search ↔ conversation custom attributes * Future shared matcher ↔ ticket tagging * Future shared matcher ↔ conversation tagging ### 8.4 UAT / Business Validation * Agent menerima customer baru dengan AWB yang sama seperti case lama → system menyarankan ticket/conversation terkait. * Agent dapat memahami kenapa suggestion muncul tanpa membuka semuanya. * Supervisor dapat melihat grouping/related behavior konsisten di fase lanjutan. ### 8.5 Automation Candidates * Search exact normalized attribute match * Multi-result grouping suggestions lintas domain * RBAC-scoped suggestion list * Attribute change → tag recalculation (Phase 2/3) * Historical backfill job correctness (jika dipakai) ## 9\. Production Safety * **Rollback Strategy:** * Phase 1: disable shared-attribute suggestion popup via feature flag. * Phase 2/3: disable auto-tag generation independently per domain. * **Feature Toggle Requirement:** * `SHARED_ATTRIBUTE_DISCOVERY_ENABLED` * `TICKET_AUTO_ATTRIBUTE_TAGGING_ENABLED` * `CONVERSATION_AUTO_ATTRIBUTE_TAGGING_ENABLED` * **Backward Compatibility Notes:** * Existing manual tags harus tetap aman. * Related Ticket / Related Conversation flows existing tidak boleh broken jika auto-tag belum aktif. * **Staged Rollout Recommendation:** * Phase 1 search-only canary terlebih dahulu. * Phase 2 ticket tagging setelah accuracy cukup. * Phase 3 conversation tagging terakhir, karena overlap lebih tinggi dengan list/room/detail behavior. * **Monitoring / Alerting Needs:** * suggestion shown rate * suggestion click/open rate * false positive feedback rate * false negative escalation rate * system-tag generated/removed counts * **Logging / Audit Gaps:** * log matched attribute key * log matched value hash / masked value * log rule version / normalization version * log tag add/remove source = `system` ## 10\. Open Questions ## 11\. Recommendation ### 11.1 Recommendation Rationale Arah baru ini **lebih strategic** daripada generic global search karena langsung menyelesaikan duplicate handling dan business-context fragmentation. Namun, ini bukan lagi feature search biasa — ini adalah **cross-domain relationship discovery program**. Karena itu, feature tidak boleh dikerjakan sebagai satu PRD search generik dengan tambahan tagging di belakangnya. Ia harus dibangun sebagai: 1. **Phase 1 discovery surface** 2. **Phase 2 ticket actionability** 3. **Phase 3 conversation actionability** ### 11.2 Operational Recommendation ## 12\. Traceability Matrix ## 13\. Change Log \----------- QA notes : * conversation section, display conversation number at right side channel icon * when keyword related to detail conversation/ticket, create another section at bottom of every list, display related search result

allWorkPackages.subject: Update Messenger & Instagram Messaging Time Window Validation to < 24 Hours
allWorkPackages.description:
Update the messaging time window validation for both Messenger and Instagram APIs to ensure outbound messages are sent only when the last customer interaction occurred within the past **24 hours**.

### Requirements

*   Apply the validation to both **Messenger** and **Instagram** channels.
    
*   Allow message sending only if:
    
    *   `current_time - last_customer_message_time < 24 hours`
        
*   Block message sending when the last customer interaction is **24 hours or older**.
    
*   Display an appropriate error or warning when the time window has expired.
    
*   Ensure the validation is consistently enforced across all message sending flows.
    

### Acceptance Criteria

*   ✅ Messages are sent successfully when the last customer interaction is **less than 24 hours** ago.
    
*   ✅ Messages are blocked when the last customer interaction is **24 hours or more** ago.
    
*   ✅ The validation works for both Messenger and Instagram.
    
*   ✅ Users receive a clear notification when the 24-hour messaging window has expired.

allWorkPackages.subject: Handle all WhatsApp inbound message types (location, contact, poll, interactive, etc.)
allWorkPackages.description:
## Goal

Handle all meaningful WhatsApp inbound message possibilities from Baileys without dropping unsupported message types, starting with direct and group inbound flows.

## Current Problem

Inbound message extraction in `apps/whatsapp` only recognises a fixed set of Baileys raw message keys defined in `MESSAGE_TYPE` / `MESSAGE_TYPES` at `apps/whatsapp/src/app/constant/instance.constant.ts`. Any message whose raw Baileys type is not in that list causes `extractMessageData()` to return `null` and the message is silently dropped — it never reaches conversation-service.

**Types currently dropped:**

- `locationMessage`
- `liveLocationMessage`
- `contactMessage`
- `contactsArrayMessage`
- `pollCreationMessage` / `pollUpdateMessage`
- `buttonsMessage`
- `listMessage`
- `templateMessage`
- `interactiveMessage`
- `orderMessage`
- `productMessage`
- `reactionMessage` (explicitly ignored)

## Key Files

| File | Role |
|------|------|
| `apps/whatsapp/src/app/constant/instance.constant.ts` | `MESSAGE_TYPE` / `MESSAGE_TYPES` whitelist |
| `apps/whatsapp/src/app/services/whatsapp-message.service.ts` | `extractMessageData()` — main extraction entry |
| `apps/whatsapp/src/app/utils/baileys.util.ts` | `mapMessageType()` — raw type → internal enum |
| `apps/whatsapp/src/app/services/baileys.service.ts` | `buildBasePayload()` — emits `MessageInboundDto` |
| `libs/common/src/lib/enums/index.ts` | `MessageTypeEnum` — already has `LOCATION` and `CONTACT` |
| `apps/conversation-service/src/app/schemas/message.schema.ts` | `metaData` field already exists |

## Recommended Category Mapping

**Map to native internal types:**
- `locationMessage` / `liveLocationMessage` → `MessageTypeEnum.LOCATION`
- `contactMessage` / `contactsArrayMessage` → `MessageTypeEnum.CONTACT`

**Map to `MessageTypeEnum.UTILITY` (structured but not classic text/media):**
- `reactionMessage`, `pollCreationMessage`, `pollUpdateMessage`, `buttonsMessage`, `listMessage`, `templateMessage`, `interactiveMessage`, `orderMessage`, `productMessage`, unknown structured types

## Metadata Shape

Store compact, normalised payload under `metaData.whatsapp`:

```json
{
  "whatsapp": {
    "rawType": "locationMessage",
    "location": {
      "latitude": -6.2,
      "longitude": 106.8,
      "name": "Customer Pin",
      "address": "Jakarta"
    }
  }
}
```

## Readable Content Rules

- Location → `Location: <label or lat,lng>`
- Contact → `Contact: <display name>`
- Poll → `Poll: <question>`
- Reaction → `Reacted <emoji> to message`
- List/button/interactive → selected title or button text
- Order/product → compact product/amount summary
- Unknown structured → `Unsupported WhatsApp message: <rawType>`

## Pipeline Changes Required

1. Extend `MESSAGE_TYPE` / `MESSAGE_TYPES` constant
2. Add small extractor helpers: `extractLocationPayload()`, `extractContactPayload()`, `extractInteractivePayload()`, `extractPollPayload()`, `extractCommercePayload()`, `buildFallbackStructuredPayload()`
3. Add optional `metaData` to: `ExtractedMessageData`, `MessageInboundDto`, `CreateMessageDto`
4. Thread `metaData` through: `extractMessageData()` → `buildBasePayload()` → `handleBuildMessageDataCreation()` → `messageService.create()`
5. Never return `null` just because raw type is unknown — always produce a readable fallback

## Frontend (follow-up)

- `packages/constants/src/message.ts` — add `UTILITY` if used
- `ConversationChatroomBuble.tsx` — add renderers for `LOCATION`, `CONTACT`, `UTILITY`
- `TicketChatRoomBubble.tsx` — same

## Suggested Delivery Slices

**Slice 1 (highest value):** `locationMessage`, `liveLocationMessage`, `contactMessage`, `contactsArrayMessage`

**Slice 2:** `buttonsMessage`, `listMessage`, `interactiveMessage`, `templateMessage`

**Slice 3:** `pollCreationMessage`, `pollUpdateMessage`, `orderMessage`, `productMessage`, `reactionMessage`, generic fallback

## Verification

```bash
npx nx test whatsapp --testFile=whatsapp-message.service.spec
npx nx test conversation-service --testFile=inbound-message.processor.spec
npm run lint
# if frontend included:
npm run check-types
```

## References

See plan document: `.opencode/tasks/whatsapp-inbound-message-coverage-plan.md`

##### UI link : [https://www.figma.com/design/RAAuLaQKUufWMWWEm0kMb9/-V2--Satuinbox-Web-Specs?node-id=11944-107541&t=maM2yZmwk9HFkPSf-1](https://www.figma.com/design/RAAuLaQKUufWMWWEm0kMb9/-V2--Satuinbox-Web-Specs?node-id=11944-107541&t=maM2yZmwk9HFkPSf-1)
# Analysis — WhatsApp Special Message Types Display di SatuInbox ## Revision History ## 1\. Overview ## 2\. Gap Analysis — PRD vs Reality PRD Room v1.1 mendefinisikan tipe yang didukung: > _"Support: Text, images, audio, video, documents, voice notes. Max size: 100MB."_ Keempat tipe berikut **tidak ada di PRD manapun**: **Kritis:** Baileys di BE sudah decode semua tipe ini dari WhatsApp, tapi kemungkinan besar data tidak di-forward ke FE dalam format terstruktur — sehingga tampil sebagai pesan kosong atau `[unsupported]`. ## 3\. Requirement Analysis per Message Type ### 3A. Contact Card **WhatsApp Web menampilkan:** * Avatar/placeholder icon kontak * Nama kontak (bold) * Nomor telepon (satu atau lebih) * Tombol "View contact" **Functional Requirements:** **Data Model (dari Baileys** `**contactMessage**`**):** ```text displayName: string vcard: string // vCard format (RFC 6350) — parse untuk extract name + phone(s) ``` ### 3B. Poll **WhatsApp Web menampilkan:** * Icon poll + label "Poll" * Pertanyaan/judul poll (bold) * Tiap opsi: nama opsi + jumlah suara + progress bar persentase * Total votes count * Jika belum vote: opsi clickable (tidak relevan di SatuInbox) * Jika sudah vote: tampilan read-only dengan vote highlight **Functional Requirements:** **Data Model (dari Baileys):** ```text pollCreationMessage: name: string // Judul poll options: [{optionName: string}] // Daftar opsi selectableOptionsCount: number // 1 = single vote, >1 = multi vote pollUpdateMessage: pollCreationMessageKey: {id} // Reference ke poll asli vote: {selectedOptions: [{name: string}]} // Opsi yang dipilih voter ``` **⚠️ Complexity Note:** Poll vote tracking membutuhkan aggregasi di BE. Setiap `pollUpdateMessage` adalah delta vote dari satu user, bukan snapshot total. BE perlu meng-aggregate votes dan forward sebagai poll state ke FE — bukan raw event. ### 3C. Event **WhatsApp Web menampilkan:** * Icon kalender * Nama event (bold) * Tanggal dan waktu (formatted) * Lokasi (jika ada) * Deskripsi (jika ada) * Tombol CTA "See Event" / "RSVP" **Functional Requirements:** **Data Model (dari Baileys** `**eventMessage**`**):** ```text name: string description?: string location?: {name?: string} startAt: timestamp endAt?: timestamp isCanceled: boolean ``` ### 3D. Shared Link (Link Preview) **WhatsApp Web menampilkan:** * Thumbnail/OG image (jika tersedia) * Domain/site name * Judul halaman (bold) * Deskripsi singkat * URL yang bisa diklik **Functional Requirements:** **Data Model (dari Baileys** `**extendedTextMessage**`**):** ```text text: string // Pesan teks asli matchedText: string // URL yang terdeteksi canonicalUrl: string // URL final (setelah redirect) title?: string // OG title description?: string // OG description jpegThumbnail?: bytes // Thumbnail image (base64) ``` **Catatan:** Baileys fetch OG metadata saat pesan masuk — BE tinggal forward data ini ke FE. FE tidak perlu fetch OG metadata sendiri. ## 4\. Impact Analysis ### 4.1 Module Impact ### 4.2 API / Data Contract Impact BE harus extend message payload: ```typescript // Existing type MessageType = 'text' | 'image' | 'video' | 'audio' | 'document' | 'voice_note' // NEW — tambahkan: type MessageType = ... | 'contact_card' | 'poll' | 'event' | 'link_preview' interface ContactCardPayload { displayName: string; phones: string[]; vcard: string; // raw vCard string } interface PollPayload { pollId: string; question: string; options: { name: string; voteCount: number }[]; totalVotes: number; selectableCount: number; } interface EventPayload { name: string; startAt: string; // ISO timestamp endAt?: string; location?: string; description?: string; isCanceled: boolean; } interface LinkPreviewPayload { text: string; url: string; title?: string; description?: string; thumbnailUrl?: string; } ``` ### 4.3 Frontend Component Architecture ```text ConversationChatRoom └── MessageBubble (router by messageType) ├── TextBubble (existing) ├── ImageBubble (existing) ├── VideoBubble (existing) ├── AudioBubble (existing) ├── DocumentBubble (existing) ├── ContactCardBubble (NEW) ← vCard display ├── PollBubble (NEW) ← read-only + live vote count ├── EventBubble (NEW) ← event info card ├── LinkPreviewBubble (NEW) ← OG preview card └── UnsupportedBubble (NEW) ← fallback "Pesan tidak didukung" ``` ### 4.4 UI/UX Requirements ### 4.5 Backend (Baileys) Impact ### 4.6 Performance Impact ## 5\. Risk Analysis ## 6\. Open Questions — Wajib Dijawab PM/Engineering ## 7\. Scope Proposal ### Phase 1 — In Scope (MVP) ### Phase 1 — Out of Scope (defer ke Phase 2) * Agent vote pada poll * Agent RSVP pada event * Save contact dari bubble ke SatuInbox Contact DB (OQ-1) * Real-time poll vote update via socket (simplify: static load saja di Phase 1) * Security proxy untuk link preview * Tampilkan nama voter (OQ-2) * Outbound pengiriman Contact / Poll / Event dari agent ## 8\. Traceability Matrix ## 9\. Recommendation **Verdict: Conditional Go** **Kondisi sebelum development:** 1. **BE harus konfirmasi** apakah data 4 tipe ini sudah masuk ke message schema yang dikirim ke FE — jika belum, BE harus dikerjakan lebih dulu 2. **PM harus jawab OQ-1 dan OQ-2** — keduanya mengubah scope secara signifikan 3. **Poll vote aggregation** harus didesain dengan hati-hati di BE (Redis counter per `pollId`) sebelum FE implement 4. **Fallback "Pesan tidak didukung"** wajib ada di Day 1 — tipe yang belum dihandle tidak boleh tampil blank atau crash **Prioritas pengerjaan yang disarankan:** **Severity keseluruhan: HIGH** Agent tidak bisa memahami konteks percakapan jika pesan-pesan ini tampil sebagai blank atau unsupported. Ini langsung berdampak ke kualitas customer service.

allWorkPackages.subject: Broadcast - Broadcast Can Be Sent Successfully Even When Token Balance Is Rp 0
allWorkPackages.description:
### **Jam.dev Evidence**

*   Jam.dev Link: [https://jam.dev/c/99376898-fcb6-4349-b6ed-5b4dd34e7c4f](https://jam.dev/c/99376898-fcb6-4349-b6ed-5b4dd34e7c4f)
    

## **Description**

There is a validation issue in the **broadcast sending process** where users can successfully send a broadcast message even when their **token balance is Rp 0**.

The system should prevent users from initiating a broadcast when they do not have sufficient tokens. Instead, the broadcast currently proceeds and results in a **success status**, which is incorrect behavior.

## **Steps to Reproduce**

1.  Navigate to **Settings → Subscription → Payments**
    
2.  Open the **Token** tab
    
3.  Ensure the **token balance is Rp 0**
    
4.  Navigate to the **Broadcast** menu
    
5.  Click **Create Broadcast**
    
6.  Fill out the broadcast form
    
7.  Send the broadcast
    

## **Actual Result**

*   Broadcast is **successfully sent**
    
*   Status appears as **Success**
    
*   System allows sending messages even though the **token balance is Rp 0**
    

## **Expected Result**

*   When **token balance = Rp 0**:
    
    *   Broadcast should **not be allowed**
        
    *   The system should block the action before sending
        
*   Users should see a clear message such as:
    
    *   **“Insufficient token balance to send broadcast.”**
        
*   Broadcast should be **prevented at the validation stage**, not after message processing begins
    

## **Tested Result**

**username Dev : haltev12**

**pass : Asdqwe12@**

## **Affected Environment (Bug Found)**

*    \[x\]  Dev
    

*   [ ] Staging
*   [ ] Prod

## **Tested Environment**

*   [ ] Dev
*   [ ] Staging
*   [ ] Prod

## **Additional Notes**

Possible root causes:

*   Missing token balance validation before broadcast execution
    
*   Broadcast API not verifying token availability
    
*   Token deduction logic executed only after message sending
    

Impact:

*   Users can send broadcasts without available tokens
    
*   Billing and token usage become inconsistent
    
*   Potential system misuse and inaccurate accounting

allWorkPackages.subject: Analitycs - Report Offline - Offline Report Visibility Not Restricted by Role (Supervisor vs Admin)
allWorkPackages.description:
### **Jam.dev Evidence**

Jam.dev Link: [https://app.betterbugs.io/session/69f1b2fd065d02218caea78c](https://app.betterbugs.io/session/69f1b2fd065d02218caea78c)

### **Description**

There is an issue in **Analytics → Offline Report** related to **role-based access control (RBAC)**.

Currently, **supervisors can see reports created by other supervisors**, which should not be allowed. Report visibility should be restricted so that:

*   **Supervisors** can only see:
    
    *   Their own reports
        
    *   Reports created by **Admin**
        
*   **Supervisors should NOT see reports created by other supervisors**
    
*   **Admin** can see all reports (this part is already working correctly)
    

## **Scenario 1 – Supervisor A Creates Report (Visible to Supervisor B)**

### **Steps to Reproduce**

1.  Login as **Supervisor A**
    
2.  Navigate to **Analytics → Offline Report**
    
3.  Create a report
    
4.  Login as **Supervisor B**
    
5.  Navigate to **Analytics → Offline Report**
    

### **Actual Result**

*   Supervisor B **can see** the report created by Supervisor A
    

### **Expected Result**

*   Supervisor B **should NOT see** the report created by Supervisor A
    

## **Scenario 2 – Supervisor B Creates Report (Visible to Supervisor A)**

### **Steps to Reproduce**

1.  Login as **Supervisor B**
    
2.  Navigate to **Analytics → Offline Report**
    
3.  Create a report
    
4.  Login as **Supervisor A**
    
5.  Navigate to **Analytics → Offline Report**
    

### **Actual Result**

*   Supervisor A **can see** the report created by Supervisor B
    

### **Expected Result**

*   Supervisor A **should NOT see** the report created by Supervisor B
    

## **Scenario 3 – Admin Visibility (Correct Behavior)**

### **Steps to Reproduce**

1.  Login as **Admin**
    
2.  Navigate to **Analytics → Offline Report**
    
3.  Observe reports created by:
    
    *   Admin
        
    *   Supervisor A
        
    *   Supervisor B
        

### **Actual Result**

*   Admin **can see all reports** ✔️
    
*   Supervisors **can see reports created by Admin** ✔️
    

### **Expected Result**

*   Behavior is correct and should remain unchanged
    

### **Affected Environment (Bug Found)**

*   [x] Dev
*   [ ] Staging
*   [ ] Prod

### **Tested Environment**

*   [x] Dev
*   [ ] Staging
*   [ ] Prod

### **Additional Notes**

**Possible Root Causes:**

*   Missing RBAC filtering on backend query (no restriction by creator or role)
    
*   API returns all reports within the same organization without role-based filtering
    
*   Frontend does not filter data based on user role
    
*   Missing ownership validation (created\_by field not enforced)
    

**Impact:**

*   Data privacy issue between supervisors
    
*   Unauthorized visibility of reports
    
*   Potential sensitive data exposure
    
*   Violates role-based access control expectations
    

**Note : this is for on organization same**

allWorkPackages.subject: Analitycs - Report Offline - Missing Rate Limit on Offline Report Creation
allWorkPackages.description:
### **Jam.dev Evidence**

Jam.dev Link: [https://app.betterbugs.io/session/69f1a6a0065d02218caea581](https://app.betterbugs.io/session/69f1a6a0065d02218caea581)

### **Description**

There is an issue in **Analytics → Offline Report** where users are able to create more than the allowed number of reports within a one-hour period.

Currently, the system does not enforce the expected **rate limit of 10 offline report requests per organization per hour**, allowing users to exceed this limit without any restriction.

### **Steps to Reproduce**

1.  Navigate to **Analytics → Offline Report**
    
2.  Click **Create Report / Request Report**
    
3.  Submit report requests repeatedly (more than 10 times within one hour)
    
4.  Observe the system behavior after exceeding 10 requests
    

### **Actual Result**

*   Users can create **more than 10 reports within one hour**
    
*   No restriction or error message is triggered
    
*   All requests are successfully processed
    

### **Expected Result**

*   System should enforce a **rate limit of 10 report requests per organization per hour**
    
*   When the limit is exceeded:
    
    *   Show an error message such as:
        
        > **"You have reached the maximum number of report requests (10 per hour). Please try again later."**
        
    *   Prevent additional report creation beyond the limit

allWorkPackages.subject: Analitycs - report offline - Deleted Agent Still Used in Offline Report Request
allWorkPackages.description:
### **Jam.dev Evidence**

Jam.dev Link: [https://app.betterbugs.io/session/69f18785b1ac0d1fedf1a6ea](https://app.betterbugs.io/session/69f18785b1ac0d1fedf1a6ea)

### **Description**

There is an issue in the **Offline Report request flow** where a previously selected agent remains valid even after being deleted.

When a user selects an agent, then deletes that agent from **Settings → Member**, and proceeds to submit the report request, the system still successfully generates the offline report. This behavior is incorrect.

The system should validate whether the selected agent still exists before allowing submission.

### **Steps to Reproduce**

1.  Navigate to **Analytics → Offline Report**
    
2.  Click **Create Report / Request Report (Side Hustle)**
    
3.  Select an **Agent** from the list
    
4.  Without refreshing the page:
    
    *   Go to **Settings → Member**
        
    *   Select the same agent
        
    *   Click the **three dots menu**
        
    *   Click **Delete**
        
    *   Confirm deletion
        
5.  Return to the **Offline Report modal**
    
6.  Click **Submit / Send**
    

### **Actual Result**

*   Report is successfully created
    
*   No validation error is shown
    
*   Deleted agent is still accepted in the request
    

### **Expected Result**

*   System should validate agent existence before submission
    
*   If the agent has been deleted:
    
    *   Show error message:
        
        > **"The selected agent is no longer valid. Please reload the page."**
        
    *   Prevent report submission
        
    *   No offline report should be created
        

### **Affected Environment (Bug Found)**

*   [x] Dev
*   [ ] Staging
*   [ ] Prod

### **Tested Environment**

*   [x] Dev
*   [ ] Staging
*   [ ] Prod

### **Additional Notes**

**Possible Root Causes:**

*   Frontend is using stale/cached agent data
    
*   Backend does not re-validate agent ID on submission
    
*   Missing referential integrity check in report creation API
    
*   No sync between member deletion and active modal state
    

**Impact:**

*   Invalid data used in reports
    
*   Data integrity issues in analytics
    
*   Confusing and unreliable system behavior
    
*   Potential reporting inaccuracies

allWorkPackages.subject: Improve SLA with Reminder and Paused Config
allWorkPackages.description:
PRD: * Conversation Settings SLA: [https://docs.google.com/document/d/1i1H3r4OCqQUd9cmSZtkEVHqjcMFtXlF4xGeH6\_Z4eE0/edit?tab=t.hi1tf9t8f28c](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1i1H3r4OCqQUd9cmSZtkEVHqjcMFtXlF4xGeH6_Z4eE0/edit?tab=t.hi1tf9t8f28c) Design [https://www.figma.com/design/RAAuLaQKUufWMWWEm0kMb9/-V2--Satuinbox-Web-Specs?node-id=526-10517&t=ep8f8ltPgCivJQeA-11](https://www.figma.com/design/RAAuLaQKUufWMWWEm0kMb9/-V2--Satuinbox-Web-Specs?node-id=526-10517&t=ep8f8ltPgCivJQeA-11) * Ticket Type SLA: [https://docs.google.com/document/d/1i1H3r4OCqQUd9cmSZtkEVHqjcMFtXlF4xGeH6\_Z4eE0/edit?tab=t.dwq2tquodh61](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1i1H3r4OCqQUd9cmSZtkEVHqjcMFtXlF4xGeH6_Z4eE0/edit?tab=t.dwq2tquodh61) Design [https://www.figma.com/design/RAAuLaQKUufWMWWEm0kMb9/-V2--Satuinbox-Web-Specs?node-id=2962-158687&t=HhbS6xsu3WjlxTpL-11](https://www.figma.com/design/RAAuLaQKUufWMWWEm0kMb9/-V2--Satuinbox-Web-Specs?node-id=2962-158687&t=HhbS6xsu3WjlxTpL-11)
## 1) Configuration Requirements (Settings) ### 1.1 Conversation Settings → Default SLA **SLA metrics (existing):** * **FRT** duration * **TTC** duration **Add per metric:** * `Reminder (minutes before deadline)` — optional, **single value** **Add global pause toggle (simple):** * `Pause SLA when status = Waiting on Customer` (checkbox) * Applies to **both** FRT and TTC * Default: **ON** (recommended) _or_ keep as OFF if you want backward-compatible; pick one and lock. **Validation:** * If reminder set: `0 < reminder < duration` ### 1.2 Ticket Type Settings **Add section "SLA Metrics" (new):** * **FRT**: duration + reminder * **TTC**: duration + reminder **Add global pause toggle (simple):** * `Pause SLA when status = Waiting on Customer` (checkbox) * Applies to **FRT + TTC + all Stage SLAs** * Default: **ON** **Stages (existing):** * Per stage: * Stage SLA duration (existing) * Stage reminder (optional, single value) **Validation:** * Reminder must be `< duration` per metric/stage * If stage has no duration → reminder disabled ## 2) Runtime Behavior Requirements ### 2.1 Shared reminder rule (single reminder per metric) For each metric: FRT, TTC, each Stage SLA * Trigger reminder once when `remaining_time <= reminder_offset` * Trigger breach once when `now > deadline` * Dedupe by `(entity_id, metric, stage_id?, cycle_id, type)` ### 2.2 Pause behavior (simple) **Conversation** * If checkbox ON and status becomes **Waiting on Customer** → pause timers (FRT/TTC) * When status leaves Waiting on Customer → resume timers **Ticket** * Same: pause/resume based on **ticket status = Waiting on Customer** * Applies globally (FRT/TTC + Stage accumulation) ### 2.3 Ticket stage SLA accumulation * Stage time = sum of intervals ticket berada di stage tsb **while not paused** * Re-enter stage → accumulate (no reset) ### 2.4 Both can trigger * Stage SLA reminder/breach independent dari FRT/TTC reminder/breach ## 3) Notification Requirements ### 3.1 Recipients * **Supervisor + Assignee** * If unassigned → supervisor only ### 3.2 Surfaces * **In-app notification** * Warning for reminder, Critical for breach * **Dashboard** * Red badge + "SLA Breached" card * (Optional) Amber badge/card "SLA At Risk" for reminders (recommended but can be P1 if you want ultra-lean) ## 4) Edge Cases (must) * Pause crossing reminder moment: * If paused before reminder time, reminder fires **after resume** if still applicable. * Config change: * If duration/reminder updated, avoid double reminder/breach for same cycle (use cycle\_id + dedupe). * Reassign/team change: * Deadline carry over; supervisor recipients follow current team scope. ## 5) Non-goals (keep lean) * Multiple reminders per metric * Per-stage pause config * External channels (email/push) --- ## Analisis Impact & Test Cases ### Area Terdampak Feature ini menyentuh banyak area sekaligus: **Settings / Konfigurasi** - Conversation Settings → SLA: tambah field Reminder per FRT & TTC + toggle Pause SLA when Waiting on Customer - Ticket Type Settings: tambah section SLA Metrics baru (FRT+TTC+Reminder) + toggle pause + reminder per stage **Runtime Engine** - SLA Timer Conversation: pause/resume berdasarkan status `Waiting on Customer` - SLA Timer Ticket: pause/resume berlaku untuk FRT + TTC + semua Stage SLA - Stage SLA Accumulation: waktu di-accumulate, tidak reset saat re-enter stage, tidak dihitung saat paused - Reminder trigger: fire 1x saat `remaining_time <= reminder_offset`, dedupe by `(entity_id, metric, stage_id, cycle_id, type)` - Breach trigger: fire 1x saat `now > deadline` **Notifikasi** - In-app Notification: Warning (reminder) & Critical (breach) ke Supervisor + Assignee - Dashboard: Red badge "SLA Breached" + (optional) Amber "SLA At Risk" **Catatan Relation:** Terkait langsung dengan #1626 (conversation in ticket not 1:1) — pastikan mapping conversation di ticket sudah benar sebelum testing SLA Ticket, karena jika mapping salah, Stage SLA accumulation bisa tidak akurat. --- ### Test Cases #### A. Settings UI - **A1** — Input reminder FRT/TTC di Conversation Settings tersimpan dan tampil kembali - **A2** — Input reminder harus `> 0` dan `< duration` — validasi error jika dilanggar - **A3** — Toggle "Pause SLA when Waiting on Customer" bisa diaktifkan/nonaktifkan dan tersimpan - **A4** — Ticket Type Settings: section SLA Metrics muncul dengan field FRT, TTC, dan Reminder masing-masing - **A5** — Per-stage reminder tersimpan dan disabled jika stage tidak punya duration - **A6** — Toggle pause di Ticket Type Settings berlaku untuk FRT + TTC + semua Stage #### B. Pause / Resume Behavior - **B1** — Conversation status → `Waiting on Customer` → SLA timer berhenti (FRT & TTC) - **B2** — Status keluar dari `Waiting on Customer` → timer lanjut dari posisi terakhir (bukan reset) - **B3** — Pause toggle OFF → status `Waiting on Customer` tidak mempengaruhi timer - **B4** — Ticket status `Waiting on Customer` → pause berlaku untuk FRT, TTC, dan semua Stage SLA - **B5** — Stage SLA tidak dihitung selama ticket dalam status pause - **B6** — Re-enter stage setelah pause → waktu diakumulasi, tidak reset #### C. Reminder - **C1** — Reminder hanya fire **1 kali** saat `remaining_time <= offset` - **C2** — Reminder tidak fire ulang jika config diubah di tengah jalan (dedupe cycle\_id) - **C3** — Reminder FRT dan TTC independent — salah satu fire tidak mempengaruhi yang lain - **C4** — Stage SLA reminder fire independent dari FRT/TTC reminder - **C5** — Jika SLA di-pause sebelum waktu reminder, reminder harus fire **setelah resume** jika masih applicable #### D. Breach - **D1** — Breach fire **1 kali** saat `now > deadline` - **D2** — Breach tidak fire ulang meski assignee diganti atau config diupdate - **D3** — Deadline tetap carry over saat conversation/ticket di-reassign ke agent/team lain #### E. Notifikasi - **E1** — Reminder → notif in-app type **Warning** diterima Supervisor + Assignee - **E2** — Breach → notif in-app type **Critical** diterima Supervisor + Assignee - **E3** — Jika tidak ada assignee → notif hanya ke Supervisor - **E4** — Dashboard menampilkan badge merah "SLA Breached" saat breach terjadi - **E5** — (Jika diimplementasi) Badge amber "SLA At Risk" muncul saat reminder aktif #### F. Edge Cases Kritis - **F1** — Pause terjadi tepat saat window reminder → reminder fire setelah resume - **F2** — Config duration/reminder diubah setelah SLA berjalan → tidak ada double reminder/breach di cycle yang sama - **F3** — Reassign conversation ke team lain → deadline tidak berubah, supervisor recipient mengikuti team baru - **F4** — Ticket kembali ke stage yang sudah pernah dimasuki → waktu stage diakumulasi, bukan reset - **F5** — Stage tidak punya duration → field reminder disabled, tidak bisa diisi #### G. Regression (pastikan tidak rusak) - **G1** — SLA existing (tanpa reminder) tetap berjalan normal - **G2** — Conversation SLA yang sudah breach sebelum feature ini tidak double-breach - **G3** — Ticket tanpa Ticket Type yang punya SLA tidak terpengaruh - **G4** — Notif SLA lama tidak muncul ganda setelah deploy

QA notes :

🎯 1. Core Decision: Dual SLA Mode  
✅ Tambahkan SLA Mode (Global Setting)  
SLA Mode:  
\- Queue-centric  
\- Agent-centric  
🔵 2. Behavior Summary (Clear & Non-Ambiguous)  
🟦 MODE A: Queue-Centric (Customer-Oriented)  
SLA START:  
\- Saat message pertama (inbound/outbound)

FRT:  
\- Start: creation  
\- End: first agent reply  
\- Includes HOLD + ASSIGNED

TTC:  
\- Start: assignment  
\- End: resolved/closed

HOLD:  
\- FRT: RUNNING  
\- TTC: NOT STARTED

Reminder:  
\- HOLD → Supervisor only  
\- ASSIGNED → Assignee + Supervisor

Use Case:  
\- Customer support (fast response critical)  
\- High-volume queue  
🟩 MODE B: Agent-Centric (Agent Performance-Oriented)  
SLA START:  
\- Saat conversation di-assign ke agent

FRT:  
\- Start: assignment  
\- End: first agent reply

TTC:  
\- Start: assignment  
\- End: resolved/closed

HOLD:  
\- No SLA running

Reminder:  
\- Only after assignment

Use Case:  
\- Internal support / B2B  
\- Fair agent performance measurement  
⚠️ 3. Rules That MUST Be Shared (Non-Negotiable)

Ini tidak boleh beda antara mode:

1\. Deadline Invariance  
Assignment TIDAK BOLEH mengubah deadline SLA  
2\. Reminder Once Only  
1 reminder per metric per cycle (no re-trigger)  
3\. Snapshot Rule  
SLA config di-snapshot saat SLA start  
Perubahan config tidak affect active cycle  
4\. Recipient Resolution  
Recipient ditentukan saat trigger, bukan saat schedule  
🔴 4. Critical Differences (biar tidak salah implement)  
Aspect    Queue-Centric    Agent-Centric  
SLA start    Creation    Assignment  
HOLD state    SLA running    No SLA  
Pre-assignment visibility    Yes    No  
Risk area    Queue bottleneck    Agent performance  
Possible breach sebelum assign    Yes    No  
Dashboard complexity    High    Low  
⚠️ 5. Hidden Risk (ini yang sering ke-skip)

Kalau kamu kasih 2 mode:

❗ Reporting jadi tricky

Contoh:

Workspace A pakai Queue-centric  
Workspace B pakai Agent-centric

👉 “FRT 60 min” artinya beda

✅ Solusi:

Tambahkan label di semua report:

SLA Mode: Queue-centric

👉 supaya tidak misleading

⚠️ 6. UX Requirement (WAJIB kalau dual mode)

Kalau tidak ditampilkan → user bakal bingung total

Tambahkan di UI:  
1\. SLA Mode Selector  
Mode SLA:  
( ) Berbasis Antrian (Queue-centric)  
( ) Berbasis Agen (Agent-centric)  
2\. Dynamic Helper Text

Kalau Queue-centric:

FRT dihitung sejak percakapan diterima,  
termasuk saat menunggu penugasan agen

Kalau Agent-centric:

FRT dihitung sejak percakapan ditugaskan ke agen  
3\. Warning saat switch mode  
Mengubah mode SLA hanya berlaku untuk percakapan baru  
🔧 7. Engineering Impact (biar kamu kebayang effort)

Kalau dual mode:

Harus support:  
2 SLA start strategies  
2 reminder trigger paths  
2 dashboard logic  
2 interpretation layer

👉 tapi core engine bisa sama (state machine tetap)

🧪 8. QA Impact

Test matrix jadi:

\[Queue-centric\] × \[Agent-centric\]

Semua scenario harus di-test di dua mode:

HOLD behavior  
Reminder  
Breach  
Assignment  
Reassignment

👉 test case jadi ±2x lipat

🚀 9. Simplified Final Spec (siap masuk PRD)

Kalau dirangkum:

🔹 SLA Mode Configuration  
FR-XXX: SLA Mode

System MUST allow selecting SLA mode:  
\- Queue-centric  
\- Agent-centric

This setting applies at workspace level  
🔹 SLA Start Rule  
IF Queue-centric:  
 SLA starts at conversation creation

IF Agent-centric:  
 SLA starts at first assignment  
🔹 HOLD Behavior  
IF Queue-centric:  
 HOLD → SLA running

IF Agent-centric:  
 HOLD → SLA not started  
🔹 FRT Behavior  
Queue-centric:  
 creation → first reply

Agent-centric:  
 assignment → first reply  
🔹 TTC Behavior (Same for both)  
assignment → resolved  
💡 Final Insight (penting banget)

Dengan dual mode ini:

👉 Produk kamu jadi fleksibel

Tapi juga:

👉 Kamu harus memaksa clarity di UI & reporting

Kalau tidak:

user akan salah interpretasi SLA  
dan bilang sistem “bug” padahal beda mode

allWorkPackages.subject: Analytics Data Pipeline Refactor (Precomputed Analytics Store)
allWorkPackages.description: ## **1\. Objective** Improve analytics performance and scalability by replacing heavy real-time aggregation (Redash-based) with a precomputed analytics system, while maintaining acceptable data freshness (≤3 hours). ## **2\. Scope** ### In Scope * Analytics Pages: * Conversation * Ticket * Responsiveness * Member Performance * Broadcast (analytics only) ### Out of Scope * Real-time analytics system * UI redesign * Broadcast operational monitoring (real-time execution layer) ## **3\. Key Principles** ## **4\. Functional Requirements** ### **FR-001 — Precomputed Analytics Engine** * System MUST replace real-time aggregation with precomputed analytics. * System MUST NOT rely on Redash for analytics queries. ### **FR-002 — Batch Processing** * System MUST run aggregation jobs every **3 hours**. * System MUST support scheduled execution. ### **FR-003 — Incremental Processing** * System MUST process only new events since last successful run. ### **FR-004 — Rolling Recompute Window** * System MUST recompute data for the last **6 hours** in every run to handle late-arriving events. ### **FR-005 — Progressive Data Loading** * System MUST prioritize loading **above-the-fold metrics (top KPI cards)**. * System MUST defer loading of: * Charts * Tables * Secondary sections * Tabs * Deferred sections MUST load asynchronously. ### **FR-006 — Endpoint Separation** * System MUST split analytics endpoints: * `/summary` → KPI metrics (fast response) * `/details` → charts, breakdowns * System MUST avoid single heavy endpoint. ### **FR-007 — Performance Requirement** * KPI section MUST load in **< 2 seconds (P95)**. * Full page MUST NOT exceed **5 seconds total load (including async sections)**. * System MUST NOT block UI rendering while waiting for all data. ### **FR-008 — Analytics Coverage** System MUST support metrics for: #### Conversation Analytics * Total conversations * Closed conversations * Reopened conversations * Replied conversations * Total replies sent * Total unassigned conversations * Total screenshots * Closed with screenshot * Closed without screenshot * Conversations by time * Conversations by channel * Replies by time * Frequently used tags #### Ticket Analytics * Total tickets * Unassigned tickets * Closed tickets * Unsolved tickets * Reopened tickets * One-touch tickets (% and count) * SLA achieved (%) * SLA breached (count) * Tickets within SLA * Tickets created per hour * Tickets created per day of week * First response time distribution * Requestor wait time distribution * Avg replies per ticket * Tickets solved over time #### Responsiveness Analytics * Average response time * Average first response time (FRT) * Average time to close (TTC) * FRT In SLA (count & %) * FRT Over SLA (count & %) * TTC In SLA (count & %) * TTC Over SLA (count & %) * Response time trend * FRT trend * TTC trend #### Member Performance * Agent status (Online / Offline / Away) * Avg CSAT * Avg NPS * Login count * Avg time to close * Avg reply time * Closed conversations * Total login time * Total away time * AUX durations (aggregated) * Last activity timestamp #### Broadcast Analytics (Precomputed Only) * Total broadcast * Successful broadcast * Scheduled broadcast * Pending broadcast * Failed broadcast * Invalid numbers ### **FR-009 — Broadcast Real-time Exception** * System MUST use real-time data for: * Broadcast history * Campaign execution status * System MUST NOT apply precomputed delay to broadcast monitoring. ### **FR-010 — Multi-Tenant Isolation** * System MUST enforce strict tenant isolation at server level. * System MUST ensure no cross-tenant data exposure. * All analytics queries MUST be scoped by tenant context. ### **FR-011 — Data Retention** * System MUST follow retention policy based on business package. ### **FR-012 — Data Freshness Indicator** * System MUST display: * “Last updated at” timestamp * Refresh frequency (e.g. every 3 hours) ### **FR-013 — Metric Consistency (Contract Lock)** * System MUST define fixed calculation logic for: * FRT * ART * TTC * Metrics MUST be consistent across all analytics pages. ### **FR-014 — Failure Handling** #### Aggregation Failure * System MUST fallback to last available data * System SHOULD log failure and trigger alert #### Partial Load * KPI MUST still load even if charts fail * Charts failure MUST NOT block page #### Empty State * System MUST show empty state for no data (not error) ### **FR-015 — Backfill Requirement** * System MUST support historical backfill (minimum 30–90 days before go-live) ### **FR-016 — Observability** * System MUST track: * Aggregation job duration * Job success/failure * Last run timestamp ### **FR-017 — Filter Constraints (Performance Control)** * System SHOULD limit: * Maximum date range ( ≤90 days) * Maximum multi-agent selection (≤10 agents) * System MUST prevent queries that degrade performance. ### **FR-018 — Scalability** * System MUST handle increasing data volume and tenant growth without major redesign. * System SHOULD allow future tenant-level isolation for high-load tenants. ## **5\. Non-Functional Requirements** ## **6\. Notes** ### Trade-offs (Accepted) * Data is **not real-time** * Delay up to 3 hours is acceptable * Accuracy prioritized over immediacy ## **7\. Output** This design: * Eliminates current bottleneck (Redash + heavy query) * Ensures fast UX via progressive loading * Keeps system lean (no overengineering)

allWorkPackages.subject: Settings-Subs-Payment-Cannot Pay Invoice When Total Payment Amount Is Rp 0
allWorkPackages.description:
*   ### **Jam.dev Evidence**
    
*   Jam.dev Link: [https://jam.dev/c/c1ea36f5-14d3-4575-9062-03d30ad4173d](https://jam.dev/c/c1ea36f5-14d3-4575-9062-03d30ad4173d)
    
*   Jam.dev Link: [https://jam.dev/c/2cdc7c25-0fd6-4282-b73e-e54afc2776c0](https://jam.dev/c/2cdc7c25-0fd6-4282-b73e-e54afc2776c0)
    

## **Description**

There is an issue in **Settings → Subscription → Payments → Invoice → Pay Invoice** when the **total invoice amount becomes Rp 0** (e.g., due to voucher discounts).

When the total payment amount is **Rp 0**, clicking **Pay Invoice** does **not trigger any payment action** and the **payment modal from the payment API does not appear**.

As a result, users cannot complete the payment flow, even though the invoice should be processed as a successful transaction.

Additionally, when vouchers are applied (e.g., **one-time-use vouchers per account**), the voucher quota may still be consumed, even though the payment flow does not complete successfully.

## **Steps to Reproduce**

1.  Navigate to **Settings → Subscription → Payments**
    
2.  Go to the **Invoice** tab
    
3.  Apply a **voucher** that reduces the invoice total to **Rp 0**
    
4.  Click **Pay Invoice**
    
5.  Observe the system behavior
    

## **Actual Result**

*   Clicking **Pay Invoice** does **nothing**
    
*   No **payment modal** appears
    
*   Invoice cannot be processed
    
*   Voucher usage may still be consumed due to its **one-time-use rule**
    

## **Expected Result**

When the invoice total becomes **Rp 0**, the system should still allow the user to complete the transaction:

**Option 1 – Auto Success Flow**

*   [x] Clicking **Pay Invoice** should:
    *   Immediately mark the invoice as **Paid / Success**
        
    *   Show a **success modal or toast notification**
        

**Option 2 – Zero Payment Flow**

*   [x] The system should still trigger the **payment flow with Rp 0**
*   [x] Payment API modal appears
*   [x] Payment completes successfully

Additionally:

*   [x] Voucher usage should only be **finalized after successful payment**
*   [x] Voucher quota should **not be consumed if the transaction fails**

## **Affected Environment (Bug Found)**

*    \[ \]  Dev
    

*   [ ] Staging
*   [ ] Prod

## **Tested Environment**

*   [x] Dev [https://jam.dev/c/177195d2-3e97-4e28-be0c-f0de6d44b2ee](https://jam.dev/c/177195d2-3e97-4e28-be0c-f0de6d44b2ee)
*   [ ] Staging
*   [ ] Prod

## **Additional Notes**

Possible root causes:

*   Payment flow does not handle **zero-value transactions**
    
*   Frontend blocks payment modal when amount = 0
    
*   Voucher lifecycle logic not synchronized with payment success
    

Impact:

*   Users cannot complete invoice payments when discounts reduce total to Rp 0
    
*   Voucher usage may be incorrectly consumed
    
*   Billing flow becomes inconsistent
