allWorkPackages.subject: Settings-Subscription-payment- Applied Voucher Does Not Immediately Deduct Current Invoice Total (Billing)
allWorkPackages.description:
### **Jam.dev Evidence**

*   Jam.dev Link: https://jam.dev/c/1344478c-37b6-43fa-ae91-3517a57e7945
    

### **Description**

There is a calculation and billing logic issue after applying a **voucher** in **Settings → Subscription → Payments → Manage Package**.

After a voucher is successfully applied, the **Total Invoice for the current billing period** does **not update immediately**. The discount is not reflected in the current invoice before payment, even though the voucher has already been validated and applied.

This causes the displayed total billing amount to be incorrect and does not reflect the actual benefit of the voucher.

### **Steps to Reproduce**

1.  Navigate to **Settings → Subscription → Payments → Manage Package**
    
2.  Select an eligible subscription plan
    
3.  Apply a valid voucher (e.g. `FREE6MONTHS` or percentage discount voucher)
    
4.  Observe the **Total Invoice for the current month** before proceeding to payment
    

### **Actual Result**

*   Voucher is marked as **applied**
    
*   **Total invoice amount does not change**
    
*   Discount is **not deducted immediately**
    
*   Users cannot see the real payable amount before completing payment
    

### **Expected Result**

After a voucher is applied, the **Total Invoice for the current billing period** should be **recalculated and updated automatically**, based on the voucher type and its terms & conditions.

#### **Expected Voucher Behavior Rules**

**1\. Free-Month / Duration-Based Voucher (e.g.** `**FREE6MONTHS**`**)**

*   [x] The invoice total should be reduced by the value of:
    *   **6 months subscription price**
        
    *   Plus any additional SKB benefits (e.g. WhatsApp quota, add-ons, etc.)
        
*   [x] Voucher should only be applicable if:
    *   The selected plan duration is **exactly 6 months**, or
        
    *   Meets the **minimum required duration (≥ 6 months)**, depending on SKB
        
*   [x] The discount amount should be reflected **immediately** in the invoice total

**2\. Percentage Discount Voucher**

*   [x] Discount should be calculated as:
    *   `Current Invoice Total × Discount Percentage`
        
*   [x] Example:
    *   10% discount → `Total Invoice − (10% × Total Invoice)`
        
*   [x] If a **maximum discount cap** is defined:
    *   Example: _10% up to IDR 450,000_
        
    *   If calculated discount exceeds the cap, the discount should be limited to **IDR 450,000**
        
*   [x] The final invoice total should be:
    *   `Invoice Total − Applied Discount`
        

**3\. Voucher with Minimum Requirements**

*   [x] Voucher should only be applicable if:
    *   Minimum plan duration is met
        
    *   Minimum plan type or minimum price is met
        
*   [x] If both **minimum and maximum rules** exist:
    *   Voucher should follow those boundaries strictly
        

### **Affected Environment (Bug Found)**

*    Dev
    
*   Staging
    
*   Prod
    

### **Tested Environment**

*   [x] Dev [https://jam.dev/c/2d2163b9-d188-45ea-b3a6-9459c70ffc73](https://jam.dev/c/2d2163b9-d188-45ea-b3a6-9459c70ffc73)
*   [ ] Staging
*   [ ] Prod

### **Additional Notes**

*   The issue may be caused by:
    
    *   Invoice calculation not being recalculated after voucher application
        
    *   Voucher logic applied only at payment processing stage
        
    *   Missing frontend refresh or backend recalculation trigger
        
*   This bug impacts:
    
    *   Billing accuracy
        
    *   User trust in voucher and discount mechanisms
        
    *   Transparency before payment confirmation

allWorkPackages.subject: Settings-Subscription-payment-Duration Based Voucher Codes Can Be Applied Without Minimum Plan Validation
allWorkPackages.description:
### **Jam.dev Evidence**

*   Jam.dev Link: [https://jam.dev/c/7b56f6f7-894c-454d-bf3b-6a86ef89fcfd](https://jam.dev/c/7b56f6f7-894c-454d-bf3b-6a86ef89fcfd)
    

### **Description**

There is a validation issue in the **Billing / Subscription flow** related to **duration-based voucher codes**.

Any voucher code that contains a **duration keyword** (e.g. `6MONTHS`) can currently be applied to **all subscription plans**, regardless of the selected plan duration. The system does **not enforce minimum plan requirements** based on the voucher code.

### **Steps to Reproduce**

1.  Navigate to **Settings → Subscription → Payments (Billing)**
    
2.  Select a subscription plan with a duration **below the voucher requirement**
    
    *   Example: 1-month or 3-month plan
        
3.  Enter a voucher code that contains a duration keyword
    
    *   Example: `FREE6MONTHS`, `DISCOUNT6MONTHS`, etc.
        
4.  Apply the voucher
    

### **Actual Result**

*   Duration-based voucher codes (e.g. containing `6MONTHS`) can be:
    
    *   Applied to **any plan**
        
    *   Applied to plans **below the required duration**
        
*   There is **no validation** enforcing:
    
    *   Minimum subscription duration
        
    *   Voucher eligibility based on selected plan
        
*   Users can receive unintended benefits on unsupported plans
    

### **Expected Result**

*   Voucher validation should enforce **minimum plan duration rules** based on the voucher:
    
    *   Any voucher containing a duration keyword (e.g. `6MONTHS`) should:
        
        *   Only be applicable to plans with a **minimum duration of 6 months**
            
*   If a user selects a plan **below the required duration**:
    
    *   The voucher should **not be applied**
        
    *   A clear **error or warning message** should be shown
        
*   Rule clarification:
    
    *   **Duration-based vouchers** must enforce minimum plan requirements
        
    *   **Percentage discount vouchers** without minimum SKB may be applied to all plans
        

### **Affected Environment (Bug Found)**

*    Dev
    
*   Staging
    
*   Prod
    

### **Tested Environment**

*   [x] Dev
*   [ ] Staging
*   [ ] Prod

### **Additional Notes**

*   The issue may be caused by:
    
    *   Voucher validation logic not checking plan duration
        
    *   Voucher rules not being mapped correctly to subscription plans
        
*   This bug impacts:
    
    *   Revenue protection
        
    *   Promotion rule enforcement
        
    *   Correct application of voucher terms and conditions (SKB)

allWorkPackages.subject: Add Option change to Image for Live Chat Widget Launcher
allWorkPackages.description:
PRD: [https://docs.google.com/document/d/1i1H3r4OCqQUd9cmSZtkEVHqjcMFtXlF4xGeH6\_Z4eE0/edit?tab=t.7ap2pibi24bm](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1i1H3r4OCqQUd9cmSZtkEVHqjcMFtXlF4xGeH6_Z4eE0/edit?tab=t.7ap2pibi24bm) 

Design: [https://www.figma.com/design/RAAuLaQKUufWMWWEm0kMb9/-V2--Satuinbox-Web-Specs?node-id=576-69012&t=ZXYlpCb7enYTHhe8-11](https://www.figma.com/design/RAAuLaQKUufWMWWEm0kMb9/-V2--Satuinbox-Web-Specs?node-id=576-69012&t=ZXYlpCb7enYTHhe8-11)

<br style="page-break-after:always;">

  
  

#### Scope

*   Add option **Launcher Type = Image** (alongside existing Icon) on **Settings → Widget → Penampilan → Tema & Merek Widget → Ikon Peluncur**.
    
*   When selected, admin can **upload image** to be used as the **launcher button**.
    

#### Functional Requirements

*   Support upload formats: **PNG, JPG/JPEG, WEBP**.
    
*   System performs **auto-compress/optimize** on upload (server-side).
    
*   Persist config:
    
    *   `launcher.type = "image"`
        
    *   `launcher.image_url = <cdn_url>`
        
*   If `launcher.type = "image"`, widget uses uploaded image as launcher button.
    
*   If image fails to load (broken URL/CDN error), **fallback to icon launcher**.
    

#### Rendering Requirements (No Distortion / No “Gepeng”)

*   Launcher image MUST **preserve aspect ratio** (no stretch).
    
*   Image MUST be centered and fit inside launcher container:
    
    *   Use equivalent of `object-fit: contain; object-position: center;`
        
*   Non-square images may show padding, but **never distort**.
    

#### Validation Rules

*   Reject unsupported mime types.
    
*   Enforce max file size (recommend): **≤ 5MB** (before compression).
    
*   Enforce minimum dimension (recommend): **≥ 64×64**.
    
*   On validation fail: show inline error, keep previous launcher config unchanged.
    

#### Admin UX

*   Upload controls: **Upload / Replace / Remove**.
    
*   Switching between Icon ↔ Image does not delete the other setting (keep stored; only active one applied).
    

#### Acceptance Criteria

*   Upload PNG/JPG/WEBP → preview & production launcher uses image.
    
*   Upload rectangular image → renders without distortion (aspect ratio preserved).
    
*   Upload invalid type/too large → blocked with error, previous launcher stays.
    
*   Simulate image load failure → launcher falls back to icon.

allWorkPackages.subject: Settings-subscription-payment-vc- Voucher Quota Consumed Even When Subscription Transaction Fails
allWorkPackages.description:
### **Jam.dev Evidence**

*   Jam.dev Link: https://jam.dev/c/f6f7c444-cc3a-407e-92f3-7fcd7f88dc62
    

## **Description**

There is an issue in the **voucher usage logic** in **Settings → Subscription → Payments → Manage Package**.

When a user creates a subscription package using a **voucher**, and the transaction later becomes **Failed**, the **voucher quota is still reduced** and cannot be reused.

This prevents users from applying the same voucher again, even though the transaction was not successfully completed.

## **Steps to Reproduce**

1.  Navigate to **Settings → Subscription → Payments → Manage Package**
    
2.  Create a new package using a **voucher code**
    
3.  Proceed until a **transaction is created** (status becomes **Pending**)
    
4.  Attempt to create another package using the **same voucher**
    
    *   At this stage, the system blocks usage because the voucher is already considered used
        
5.  Let the transaction eventually become **Failed**
    
6.  Try creating a **new package again using the same voucher**
    

## **Actual Result**

*   Voucher quota is **reduced immediately** when creating the package
    
*   Voucher is considered **already used** even when:
    
    *   Transaction is still **Pending**, or
        
    *   Transaction later becomes **Failed**
        
*   User **cannot reuse the voucher**, even though the payment did not succeed
    

## **Expected Result**

Voucher quota logic should follow the transaction lifecycle:

1.  **Voucher usage should only be finalized when the transaction is successful**
    
2.  When a package is created:
    
    *   Voucher should be **reserved temporarily**, not permanently consumed
        
3.  When transaction status becomes:
    
    *   **Pending** → voucher remains reserved
        
    *   **Failed / Cancelled / Expired** → voucher quota should be **returned**
        
    *   **Paid / Success** → voucher quota should be **deducted permanently**
        

This ensures vouchers are not incorrectly consumed when payments fail.

## **Affected Environment (Bug Found)**

*    \[ \]  Dev
    

*   [ ] Staging
*   [ ] Prod

## **Tested Environment**

*   [x] Dev
*   [ ] Staging
*   [ ] Prod

## **Additional Notes**

*   Possible root cause:
    
    *   Voucher quota deducted during **package creation** instead of **payment success**
        
    *   Missing voucher rollback when transaction becomes **Failed**
        
*   Impact:
    
    *   Voucher quotas are incorrectly consumed
        
    *   Users lose voucher usage unfairly
        
    *   Billing promotion logic becomes unreliable

allWorkPackages.subject: Auth - create endpoint for deactivate/activate member
allWorkPackages.description:
## Tujuan

Memberikan kemampuan pada Admin untuk menonaktifkan member (tidak bisa login) dan mengaktifkan kembali member yang dinonaktifkan. Juga digunakan sebagai endpoint unregister untuk integrasi mobile apps (IOS/Android).

## Ringkasan dari PRD (v1.2)

### P0 — Auth Service & API Gateway

1. **Toggle isActive** — Endpoint gRPC `ToggleUserActiveStatus` di Auth Service + REST `PATCH /auth/member/:id/toggle-active-status` di API Gateway
2. **Login Guard** — `isActive = false` memblokir login (LocalStrategy) dan refresh token (RefreshTokenStrategy) dengan pesan "Akun dinonaktifkan"
3. **Force Logout** — Saat deaktivasi, semua session dihapus + invalidation reason toast
4. **Reactivation** — `isActive = true`, member bisa login kembali
5. **Idempotent** — Toggle ke state yang sama return success tanpa side effect
6. **Authorization** — Endpoint dilindungi `JwtAuthGuard` + `MemberSettingPermission.UPDATE`
7. **AUX Preservation** — Deaktivasi TIDAK menutup open AUX interval. AUX data tetap utuh untuk analytics & SLA
8. **Conversation/Ticket Preservation** — Deaktivasi TIDAK meng-unassign conversation/ticket. Berbeda dengan soft delete
9. **Round Robin Exclusion** — Auto-pull engine harus exclude deactivated member dari eligibility (`isMemberAvailableForAutoPull()` return false saat `isActive = false`)
10. **Mobile self-deactivation** — Endpoint bisa dipanggil mobile app dengan JWT user sendiri untuk unregister flow
11. **Auth isActive Only** — Deaktivasi hanya toggle `isActive` di Auth schema. `isActive` di Member schema (people-service) TIDAK berubah

### Perbedaan Deactivate vs Soft Delete

| Aspek | Deactivate | Soft Delete |
|-------|-----------|-------------|
| Login | Diblokir | Diblokir |
| Sessions | Dihapus | Dihapus |
| Conversations | **Tetap assigned** | **Unassigned** |
| Tickets | **Tetap assigned** | **Unassigned** |
| Team membership | **Tetap di tim** | **Dihapus dari tim** |
| AUX intervals | **Tidak disentuh** | Tidak relevan |
| Reversible dari UI | Ya | Tidak |
| Last Admin guard | Tidak ada | Ada (diblokir) |
| Member list visibility | **Visible** sebagai "Nonaktif" | **Hidden** |

### Member Visibility Rules (P0)

Ada dua `isActive` field terpisah:
- **Auth `isActive`** — dikontrol oleh deactivate/reactivate
- **Member `isActive`** — hanya berubah saat soft delete

Implikasi:
- Deactivated member tetap muncul di **member settings page** (sebagai "Nonaktif")
- Deactivated member **TIDAK muncul** di assignment/search contexts (ticket, conversation)
- Soft-deleted member tetap **TIDAK muncul** di mana pun

Changes needed:
- API Gateway `GET /member` → hapus default `isActive: true` (biar return semua member aktif + nonaktif)
- `member.repository.ts` `findMembersByIds()` → hapus filter `isActive: true`
- FE assignable lists → tambah `params.isActive = true` secara eksplisit

### P1 — Frontend UI

1. **Status Badge** — Kolom status "Aktif" (hijau) / "Nonaktif" (merah/abu) di tabel member
2. **Row Menu Action** — "Nonaktifkan anggota" / "Aktifkan anggota" di popover menu
3. **Confirmation Modal** — Konfirmasi sebelum toggle. Deaktivasi: tampilkan note bahwa assignments tidak terpengaruh
4. **Toast Notification** — Sukses/gagal setelah toggle

### File Utama yang Diubah

- `proto/auth.proto` — tambah RPC `ToggleUserActiveStatus`
- `apps/auth-service/src/app/app.service.ts` — tambah method `toggleUserActiveStatus()`
- `apps/auth-service/src/app/app.controller.ts` — tambah gRPC handler
- `apps/api-gateway/src/app/auth/auth.controller.ts` — tambah REST endpoint
- `apps/api-gateway/src/app/member/member.controller.ts` — hapus default `isActive: true` (line 140)
- `apps/people-service/src/app/repositories/member.repository.ts` — hapus filter `isActive: true` di `findMembersByIds()` (line 111)
- `apps/conversation-service/src/app/services/conversation.service.ts` — update `isMemberAvailableForAutoPull()` untuk cek `isActive`
- `apps/omnichannel/hooks/member/use-manage-member-api-request.ts` — tambah method API
- `apps/omnichannel/services/member/action-toggle-active-member.ts` — service baru
- `apps/omnichannel/services/member/use-get-ticket-assignable-member-list.service.ts` — tambah `isActive: true`
- `apps/omnichannel/stores/setting/organization/member-store.ts` — tambah state modal
- `apps/omnichannel/components/molecules/member/TableMember.tsx` — tambah action di PopoverOption + status badge
- `apps/omnichannel/components/molecules/member/TableFilters.tsx` — pastikan tidak kirim `isActive` param

### Test Scenarios (34 TC)

- **API** (TC-001 s/d TC-010): Deactivate, reactivate, idempotent, 404, 401, 403, login block, refresh block, force logout
- **AUX & Round Robin** (TC-011 s/d TC-016): Open AUX interval preserved, AUX analytics intact, Round Robin excludes deactivated, reactivated member becomes eligible, conversation tetap assigned, maxConversation tidak berubah
- **Member Visibility BE** (TC-017 s/d TC-022): Member list shows deactivated, hides soft-deleted, assignable list excludes deactivated, findMembersByIds returns deactivated, search behavior
- **FE** (TC-023 s/d TC-028): Status badge, row menu label, confirmation modal, toast, error handling, preservation note
- **Security & Mobile** (TC-029 s/d TC-034): Self-toggle, last Admin, concurrent toggle, mobile self-deactivation, invalid token, re-registration after reactivation

Referensi PRD: `PRD/Auth/PRD Setting - activate-deactivate-member.md` (v1.2)

allWorkPackages.subject: TICKET - ticket detail -  conversaton in ticket is not 1 : 1 with conversation room
allWorkPackages.description:
**Jamdev :**

**Description :**

Chat yang masuk di ticket seharusnya 1:1 dengan source conversation yang terkait. Komunikasi yang dilakukan di ticket harus diterima juga di conversation, dan sebaliknya. Saat ini message count tidak sinkron dan menyebabkan FRT/TTC tidak berjalan dengan benar.

---

**Cara Pembuatan Ticket:**

1. **Conversation as Ticket** — source = conversation room
2. **Bubble Message as Ticket** — source = specific bubble message dari conversation
3. **Create dari halaman Ticket** — source = kosong (tidak ada conversation terkait)

---

**Confirmed Behavior:**

**1. Chat di Ticket (Bubble as Ticket)**
- Chat yang ditampilkan di ticket dimulai dari **bubble message yang menjadi sumber ticket**, bukan dari awal conversation
- Pesan selanjutnya dari conversation yang masuk setelah bubble tersebut akan terus masuk ke ticket
- Scope chat di ticket = bubble message + semua pesan setelahnya dari conversation yang sama
- *Note:* Jika 1 conversation menghasilkan lebih dari 1 bubble ticket, pesan setelah masing-masing bubble akan muncul di lebih dari 1 ticket — ini **intended behavior**, bukan bug

**2. Customer Reply — Deteksi Otomatis**
- Pesan customer dari conversation **otomatis masuk ke ticket** jika ticket dibuat dari conversation tersebut (baik conversation as ticket maupun bubble message as ticket)
- Tidak perlu action manual dari agent
- Ticket yang dibuat tanpa source conversation tidak akan menerima pesan otomatis dari manapun

**3. Conversation Closed vs Ticket Open**
- Ketika conversation di-close, ticket bisa tetap open
- Cross-send dari ticket ke closed conversation harus **diblokir**
- Berikan notifikasi: *"Conversation is closed, cannot send cross message"*
- Komunikasi selanjutnya di ticket yang open hanya bisa via **internal notes**

**4. FRT (First Response Time) Logic**

FRT trigger: **salah satu assignee ticket** membalas di ticket, setelah ada **respons pertama dari customer** (customer selalu membalas dari conversation, dan otomatis masuk ke ticket).

- Assignee bisa lebih dari 1, siapapun yang reply pertama kali dianggap sebagai FRT trigger
- Jika setting FRT **dijeda**: timer pause saat menunggu balasan customer, resume ketika customer reply masuk ke ticket
- Jika setting FRT **tidak dijeda**: timer berjalan terus dari ticket created

**FRT — Skenario Edge Case:**

| Skenario | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| Conversation closed sebelum customer sempat reply | FRT di-set ke nilai **maksimum sesuai setting user** (contoh: jika limit FRT = 50 menit, maka FRT = 50 menit) |
| Ticket tanpa source conversation | Lihat poin 5 |

**5. SLA untuk Ticket Tanpa Source Conversation — Opsi B (Confirmed)**

- Ticket saat dibuat selalu berada di stage **Not Started (Submitted)**
- Ketika ticket mulai di-handle, agent mengubah stage ke **Active** (In Progress atau stage aktif lainnya sesuai konfigurasi user — stage active bisa dibagi ke beberapa tahapan)
- **FRT dihitung dari perubahan stage Not Started → Active** sebagai pengganti trigger dari conversation event
- TTC tetap berjalan dari ticket created sampai ticket closed
- Opsi B ini berlaku **jika memungkinkan secara teknis** — jika ada constraint, fallback ke Opsi A (SLA nonaktif)

**Stage Ticket — Definisi:**

| Stage | Keterangan |
|---|---|
| Not Started / Submitted | Stage awal saat ticket pertama dibuat |
| Active | Stage ketika ticket sedang di-handle (bisa In Progress atau tahapan lainnya sesuai kebutuhan user) |
| Closed | Ticket selesai — TTC tercapai |

**6. Multi-Ticket dari 1 Conversation (Bubble)**
- 1 conversation bisa menghasilkan lebih dari 1 ticket aktif (dari bubble yang berbeda)
- Setiap ticket harus menyimpan referensi `source_message_id` (bukan hanya `source_conversation_id`) untuk filtering yang benar
- Chat di masing-masing ticket di-scope berdasarkan timestamp/message-id dari bubble masing-masing

---

**Actual :**

- Message count di ticket dan conversation tidak sinkron (tidak 1:1)
- FRT dan TTC tidak berjalan ketika chat tidak tersinkronisasi dengan benar
- Ketika conversation di-close lalu user kirim cross-send dari ticket, sistem membuka conversation room baru secara silent — history chat dari POV customer tidak continuous

**Expectation :**

- Chat di ticket dimulai dari bubble message sumber ticket, dan meneruskan pesan berikutnya dari conversation
- Pesan customer dari conversation otomatis masuk ke ticket tanpa action manual dari agent
- Ketika conversation CLOSED, cross-send di ticket terkait diblokir dengan notifikasi yang jelas
- Ticket tetap bisa open walaupun conversation sudah closed, komunikasi lanjutan hanya via internal notes
- FRT dihitung sejak ticket dibuat, di-trigger ketika salah satu assignee reply pertama kali setelah customer membalas dari conversation
- Jika conversation closed sebelum customer reply, FRT di-set ke nilai maksimum sesuai setting (tidak dibiarkan menggantung)
- TTC berjalan normal dari ticket created sampai ticket closed
- Ticket tanpa source conversation: FRT dihitung dari stage Not Started → Active (Opsi B), jika tidak memungkinkan secara teknis maka SLA dinonaktifkan (Opsi A)

allWorkPackages.subject: Offline Report History Older Than 8 Days Still Allows Download Action
allWorkPackages.description:
## Jam.dev Evidence

Jam.dev Link: [https://app.betterbugs.io/session/6a0e8141247a3e53fa3086d5](https://app.betterbugs.io/session/6a0e8141247a3e53fa3086d5)

## Description

There is an issue in Analytics → Offline Report related to expired report history behavior.

Based on the PRD, offline report history older than 8 days should be considered expired, and the download button should become disabled or unavailable.

However, reports older than 8 days still allow the download action and do not appear as expired.

## Steps to Reproduce

1.  Navigate to Analytics
    
2.  Open Offline Report
    
3.  Check report history data
    
4.  Find reports older than 8 days from the current date
    
5.  Observe the download button/action state
    

## Actual Result

*   Reports older than 8 days still have active download buttons
    
*   Users can still attempt/download expired reports
    
*   Expired state is not enforced
    

## Expected Result

*   Reports older than 8 days should be marked as expired
    
*   Download button should be disabled/unavailable
    
*   Users should not be able to download expired reports
    
*   UI should clearly indicate expired status
    

## Affected Environment (Bug Found)

*   [x] Dev
*   [ ] Staging
*   [x] Prod

## Tested Environment

*   [ ] Dev
*   [ ] Staging
*   [ ] Prod

## Additional Notes

Possible Root Causes:

*   Missing expiration validation based on report created date
    
*   Download button state not synchronized with PRD expiration rules
    
*   Frontend does not calculate/report expired duration correctly
    
*   Backend still allows expired report download requests
    

Impact:

*   Users can access expired reports outside intended retention period
    
*   PRD behavior is not enforced
    
*   Potential data retention policy inconsistency
    
*   Confusing expired/download state in Offline Report history

allWorkPackages.subject: Add RLT and Wait Time in Queue Metrics for Conversation and Linked Ticket
allWorkPackages.description: Implement two new response metrics for SatuInbox: 1\. \*\*Response Lead Time (RLT)\*\*      Measures staff handling time after a conversation is assigned to an agent.        \`\`\`    RLT = First Customer-Facing Agent Reply Time - First Agent Assignment Time    \`\`\`     2\.  \*\*Wait Time in Queue\*\*      Measures how long the customer waits before the conversation is assigned to an agent.        \`\`\`    Wait Time in Queue = First Agent Assignment Time - First Customer Inbound Message Time    \`\`\` These metrics are added as \*\*tracked metrics only\*\* in Phase 1. They must be stored in database, displayed as live timers in Conversation Detail and linked Ticket Detail, and included in Offline Report Download exports. Existing \*\*FRT\*\* and \*\*TTC\*\* are already available and must not be changed. Design: [https://www.figma.com/design/RAAuLaQKUufWMWWEm0kMb9/-V2--Satuinbox-Web-Specs?node-id=11659-314113&t=BgUk4VEUSHdNUyt4-1](https://www.figma.com/design/RAAuLaQKUufWMWWEm0kMb9/-V2--Satuinbox-Web-Specs?node-id=11659-314113&t=BgUk4VEUSHdNUyt4-1) ## What’s New ## Out of Scope ## Acceptance Criteria ## Suggested Column Additions for Export

allWorkPackages.subject: Conversation- Conversation Count Mismatch & API Data Inconsistency
allWorkPackages.description:
### **Jam.dev Evidence** Jam.dev Link: [https://app.betterbugs.io/session/69ef1059b1ac0d1fedf16de9](https://app.betterbugs.io/session/69ef1059b1ac0d1fedf16de9) ### **Description** There are two issues in **Conversation → Your Inbox (Open)**: 1. **UI counter mismatch** The number displayed in the counter next to _Your Inbox_ does not match the actual number of conversations shown in the list. 2. **Mismatch between backend data and UI display** The total count returned from the API does not match the number of conversations rendered in the UI. ### **Steps to Reproduce** 1. Navigate to **Conversation** 2. Click on **Your Inbox** 3. Select status **Open** 4. Observe: * The counter next to _Your Inbox_ * The number of conversations displayed in the list 5. To validate backend data: * Open the following API in a browser or Postman: https://v2-api.satuinbox.com/api/conversation?assign=true&status=open&sort=isPinned:desc,pinnedAt:desc,timestamp:desc&hideEmpty=true&limit=20&page=1
6. Compare: * Total value from API response * Number of items displayed in UI ### **Actual Result** * UI displays **5 conversations**, while: * The counter shows a different number (off by 1) equal 4 * API response shows **total = 6**, but: * Only **5 conversations** are rendered in the UI ### **Expected Result** * [x] The values should be consistent across: * UI counter * Displayed conversation list * Backend API total * [x] If API returns **6 conversations**, then: * UI should display **6 conversations** * Counter should also show **6** ### **Affected Environment (Bug Found)** * [x] Dev * [ ] Staging * [ ] Prod ### **Tested Environment** * [x] Dev * [ ] Staging * [ ] Prod ### **Additional Notes** **Possible Root Causes:** * Additional filtering on the frontend (e.g., `hideEmpty=true`) not aligned with backend total calculation * Backend `total` count does not reflect the same filtering logic as the returned data * One conversation is excluded from rendering (e.g., null/invalid/hidden state) * Pagination or slicing issue on the frontend **Impact:** * Confusing for users due to inconsistent counts * Reduces trust in the system data * Risk of missing conversations that are not displayed in the UI

1.  Pada saat masuk pesan maka harus ada notifikasi suara di atas:
    
2.  Pada saat pesan masuk pada title berubah menjadi "(x) Pesan Baru Masuk"
    

## ✅ Minimum Requirement Passed (MRP)

### 1\. Notifikasi Suara

**Scenario:**

*   Ketika **pesan baru masuk** dan:
    
    *   User sedang berada di halaman aplikasi **atau**
        
    *   Tab browser sedang **tidak aktif**
        
*   Maka:
    
    *   Sistem **memutar 1 suara notifikasi**
        
    *   Volume menggunakan **default browser volume**
        
    *   Suara **tidak diputar berulang** untuk pesan yang sama
        

**Acceptance Criteria:**

*   ✔️ Suara diputar setiap ada pesan baru
    
*   ✔️ Tidak error di browser modern (Chrome, Firefox)
    
*   ✔️ Tidak memerlukan interaksi tambahan setelah izin audio diberikan browser kecuali Dekstop Notifikasi masih perlu izin popup
    

### 2\. Perubahan Title Browser

**Scenario:**

*   Ketika **1 atau lebih pesan baru masuk**
    
*   Maka:
    
    *   Title browser berubah menjadi  
        `**(x) Pesan Baru Masuk**`
        
    *   `x` adalah jumlah pesan yang **belum dibaca**
        

**Scenario Lanjutan:**

*   Ketika user:
    
    *   Membuka halaman chat **atau**
        
    *   Menandai semua pesan sebagai dibaca
        
*   Maka:
    
    *   Title browser kembali ke **judul awal aplikasi**
        

**Acceptance Criteria:**

*   ✔️ Counter `x` bertambah saat pesan baru masuk
    
*   ✔️ Counter berkurang / reset saat pesan dibaca
    
*   ✔️ Title tidak terus bertambah jika pesan sudah terbaca
    

### 3\. Kondisi Minimum Teknis

*   Notifikasi hanya berjalan jika:
    
    *   User **sudah login**
        
    *   Koneksi realtime aktif (WebSocket / polling)
        
*   Tidak perlu:
    
    *   Push Notification OS
        
    *   Pengaturan custom suara
        
    *   Konfigurasi user preference

allWorkPackages.subject: Conversation - star & spam  - Conversation Filter & Counter Mismatch (Starred and Spam Tabs)
allWorkPackages.description:
### **Jam.dev Evidence**

Jam.dev Link: [https://app.betterbugs.io/session/69f956cfb3460672b69d0d38](https://app.betterbugs.io/session/69f956cfb3460672b69d0d38)

### **Description**

There are issues in the **Conversation** module related to filtering and counter display for **Starred** and **Spam** categories.

1.  **Starred Tab Issue**
    
    *   Conversations that have been marked as starred are not displayed when accessing the **Starred** tab.
        
    *   The counter next to the **Starred** label shows **0**, even though starred conversations exist.
        
2.  **Spam Tab Counter Issue**
    
    *   Conversations in the **Spam** tab are successfully displayed.
        
    *   However, the **counter remains 0**, which does not reflect the actual number of spam conversations.
        

### **Steps to Reproduce**

1.  Navigate to **Conversation**
    
2.  Mark one or more conversations as **Starred or SPam**
    
3.  Click on the **Starred** tab
    
4.  Observe:
    
    *   The displayed conversation list
        
    *   The counter to “Starred”
        
5.  Navigate to **Spam** tab
    
6.  Observe:
    
    *   The displayed spam conversations
        
    *   The counter  to “Spam”
        

### **Actual Result**

*   **Starred Tab:**
    
    *   No data is displayed
        
    *   Counter shows **0**
        
*   **Spam Tab:**
    
    *   Data is displayed correctly
        
    *   Counter shows **0** (incorrect)
        

### **Expected Result**

*   **Starred Tab:**
    
    *   Should display all conversations marked as starred
        
    *   Counter should reflect the correct number of starred conversations
        
*   **Spam Tab:**
    
    *   Counter should match the number of displayed spam conversations
        

### **Affected Environment (Bug Found)**

*   [ ] Dev
*   [ ] Staging
*   [x] Prod

### **Tested Environment**

*   [ ] Dev
*   [ ] Staging
*   [ ] Prod

### **Additional Notes**

**Possible Root Causes:**

*   Incorrect filtering logic for starred conversations (missing `isStarred=true` condition)
    
*   Counter is not synchronized with filtered data
    
*   Backend API does not return correct total count for filtered categories
    
*   Separate logic used for data list and counter calculation (not aligned)
    

**Impact:**

*   Users cannot access starred conversations properly
    
*   Misleading counters reduce trust in the system
    
*   Poor user experience in conversation management

**In Scope:** * Support **Custom Field type: Image** (atau file berformat image). * XLSX berisi **non-expiring preview link** untuk image yang bisa dibuka “anytime” (butuh internet). * Link bisa **di-revoke**. **Out of Scope (MVP):** * Password-protected share link * Expiry per-link (opsional saja)
## Functional Requirements 


## Field & Validation
**Catatan aturan mapping:** * Jika field type = **Image**, pakai FR-IMG-001. * Jika field type = **File** tapi MIME image/\*, treat as **Image** (opsional tapi recommended biar konsisten).
## API Minimum **Create** * POST /api/share-image Request: fileKey (required), neverExpire (optional, default true) Response: shareToken, previewUrl **Resolve** * GET /api/share-image/{shareToken}/image Response: 302 to presigned TTL <= 60s OR 200 stream 403 revoked, 404 not found **Revoke** * POST /api/share-image/{shareToken}/revoke Response: revoked: true, revokedAt
## Security & Observability (Minimum)
## Acceptance Criteria 1. Given export XLSX contains image fields, when opened after **> 7 days**, then image preview links still work (token-based). 2. Given user clicks preview link from XLSX, when FE preview page opens, then image loads successfully via BE resolve flow. 3. Given a token is revoked, when preview link is opened, then BE returns **403** and viewer shows **“Link revoked”** state. 4. Given XLSX is inspected, then no cell contains S3/object URL or presigned URL.

allWorkPackages.subject: Conversation Event Logs
allWorkPackages.description: PRD: US 07, AC 07 [https://docs.google.com/document/d/1i1H3r4OCqQUd9cmSZtkEVHqjcMFtXlF4xGeH6\_Z4eE0/edit?tab=t.8eo2s0wbioev](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1i1H3r4OCqQUd9cmSZtkEVHqjcMFtXlF4xGeH6_Z4eE0/edit?tab=t.8eo2s0wbioev) Design:  [Sidebar: https://www.figma.com/design/RAAuLaQKUufWMWWEm0kMb9/-V2--Satuinbox-Web-Specs?node-id=11417-18112&t=U1il17P6onmxExr2-4](https://www.figma.com/design/RAAuLaQKUufWMWWEm0kMb9/-V2--Satuinbox-Web-Specs?node-id=11417-18112&t=U1il17P6onmxExr2-4)  Expand: [https://www.figma.com/design/RAAuLaQKUufWMWWEm0kMb9/-V2--Satuinbox-Web-Specs?node-id=3895-110472&t=U1il17P6onmxExr2-4](https://www.figma.com/design/RAAuLaQKUufWMWWEm0kMb9/-V2--Satuinbox-Web-Specs?node-id=3895-110472&t=U1il17P6onmxExr2-4)  ## Minimum Requirements ### Goal Tampilkan **Conversation Events timeline** di **Conversation Detail** agar user bisa track perubahan penting (assignment, status, SLA, sender number, dll) dalam **chronological order**. ## Scope (Must-have) ### A) UI (Conversation Detail) * Tambah panel **“Conversation Events”** (collapsible). * Default tampilkan **latest 5 events** (atau sesuai UI screenshot) + CTA **“See all”**. * “See all” membuka **full list** (drawer/modal/new page) dengan: * infinite scroll / pagination (minimum: “Load more”) * sorting **newest → oldest** * Format timestamp: * label **Today / Yesterday** + time **WIB** (ikuti existing app timezone handling). ### B) Event record (minimal fields) Setiap event row minimal punya: * `event_id` * `conversation_id` * `event_type` (string enum) * `occurred_at` (timestamp) * `actor_type` (`user` | `system`) * `actor_id`, `actor_name` (nullable kalau system) * `payload` (JSON) untuk before/after atau list entity (agent ids, team inbox, sender number, etc) ### C) Event types yang wajib dicatat (minimum) **SAPX gating** * Event `conversation.screenshot_sent` hanya: * dibuat bila tenant/plan = **SAPX enabled** * ditampilkan hanya untuk tenant tersebut ## Out of Scope (explicit) * `internal_note_created` / internal notes events (tidak dicatat, tidak ditampilkan) * message-level events (sent/received/read), typing indicator, reaction, dsb * advanced filtering/search dalam “See all” (boleh next iteration) ## Acceptance Criteria (untuk QA) 1. Di Conversation Detail muncul panel **Conversation Events** dengan list **max 5 item** terbaru dan tombol **See all**. 2. Clicking **See all** menampilkan list lengkap, sorted **newest → oldest**, load more bekerja. 3. Event minimal yang muncul sesuai trigger: * close/reopen * add/remove members (batch add/remove ditampilkan dalam 1 event) * team inbox added/changed * sender number changed * SLA due changed & SLA breached (system actor) * **SAPX**: screenshot sent (hanya tenant SAPX) 4. Timeline selalu render **chronological** konsisten (tidak random/out-of-order). 5. Access control: hanya user yang bisa buka conversation tersebut yang bisa lihat events (no cross-team leakage). ## Edge cases (minimum handling) * **Batch action**: add/remove multiple members → **1 event** dengan list (hindari spam). * **Unknown actor** (system job / deleted user) → tampilkan “System” atau “Unknown user”. * **Duplicate events** akibat retry → backend dedupe (minimum: unique `event_id` + idempotency on write). * **Same timestamp** → secondary sort by `event_id`/sequence.

In certain cases, after selecting a Start Date, the End Date picker still allows users to select dates before the chosen Start Date. For example: * Start Date selected: May 3 * End Date picker still allows selecting dates before May 3 This issue indicates inconsistent disabled date logic in the date picker component. ## Steps to Reproduce 1. Repeat selection multiple times if needed ## Actual Result * End Date picker still allows selecting dates before the selected Start Date * Disabled/enabled date logic behaves inconsistently * Invalid date range can still be selected ## Expected Result * End Date picker should disable all dates before the selected Start Date * Users should only be able to select: * The same date as Start Date * Dates after the Start Date * Disabled date logic should behave consistently ## Affected Environment (Bug Found) * [x] Dev * [ ] Staging * [ ] Prod ## Tested Environment * [ ] Dev * [ ] Staging * [ ] Prod ## Additional Notes Possible Root Causes: * Date comparison logic not updated after Start Date selection * Date picker component state synchronization issue * Disabled date calculation uses stale state/reference * Timezone/date normalization inconsistency Impact: * Users can create invalid date ranges * Filtering/report results may become inaccurate * Confusing UX in date selection flow * Inconsistent validation behavior in date component

allWorkPackages.subject: analitycs- report offline - Analytics Report Form State Does Not Reset When Switching Between Channel and Ticket Tabs
allWorkPackages.description: ## Jam.dev Evidence Jam.dev Link: [https://app.betterbugs.io/session/6a0d1672247a3e53fa3053dfini](https://app.betterbugs.io/session/6a0d1672247a3e53fa3053dfini) ## Description There is a state reset issue in Analytics → Report Menu → Link Page / Create Report button. The issue occurs when switching between tabs such as: * Channel * Ticket While both tabs already contain filled values for: * Start Date * End Date and specifically in the Channel tab: * Junk & Spam checkbox is checked When switching between tabs, the previous state/data is still retained instead of resetting to the default state for the selected tab. Each tab should initialize with its own default state when opened. ## Steps to Reproduce 1. Navigate to Analytics 2. Open Report Menu / Create Report 3. Open Channel tab 4. Fill: * Start Date * End Date 5. Enable/check: * Junk & Spam 6. Switch to Ticket tab 7. Fill: * Start Date * End Date 8. Switch back between: * Channel tab * Ticket tab 9. Observe the form state ## Actual Result * Previous tab state is still retained * Start Date and End Date remain filled * Junk & Spam checkbox remains active * Form state is not reset when switching tabs ## Expected Result * Each tab should reset to its default state when opened/switched * Previous tab values should not persist across tabs * Date fields and Junk & Spam checkbox should return to default values unless intentionally persisted by design ## Affected Environment (Bug Found) * [x] Dev * [ ] Staging * [ ] Prod ## Tested Environment * [ ] Dev * [ ] Staging * [ ] Prod ## Additional Notes Possible Root Causes: * Shared state between Channel and Ticket tab forms * Missing form reset on tab switch event * State persistence unintentionally reused between tabs * Form component not reinitialized during tab change Impact: * Confusing user experience * Incorrect filter/report generation risk * Users may accidentally submit reports with unintended filters * Form behavior becomes inconsistent across tabs

  - Setup RBAC untuk team access

### 4. Monitoring & Logging

allWorkPackages.subject: [WebhookService] TICKET_CREATED Webhook Delivery Failed After 3 Retries — ENOTFOUND webhook-test.com
allWorkPackages.description:
## Summary
`WebhookService` failed to deliver a `TICKET_CREATED` event to the configured endpoint `https://webhook-test.com/3cec79e3fa376555e35fa1abbb6b4dd3` after exhausting all 3 retry attempts. The DNS resolution of `webhook-test.com` failed every time (`ENOTFOUND`), indicating the target host is either unreachable, misconfigured, or does not exist.

## Fingerprint
`webhookservice:webhook-delivery-failed:enotfound:2026-04-08`

## Error Details

### Retry Sequence
| Time | Attempt | Duration | Error |
|------|---------|----------|-------|
| 06:40:19 AM | #1 | 114ms | `getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND webhook-test.com` |
| 06:40:24 AM | #2 | 6ms | `getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND webhook-test.com` |
| 06:40:29 AM | #3 | 6ms | `getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND webhook-test.com` |
| 06:40:29 AM | Final | — | `Webhook TICKET_CREATED failed after 3 attempts for ticket: 69d5f852c70e21885dbf80fa` |

### Final Error Log
```
[WebhookService] Webhook TICKET_CREATED failed after 3 attempts for ticket: 69d5f852c70e21885dbf80fa
— 04/08/2026 6:40:29 AM
```

## Statistics
- **Affected ticket ID:** `69d5f852c70e21885dbf80fa`
- **Affected event:** `TICKET_CREATED`
- **Target URL:** `https://webhook-test.com/3cec79e3fa376555e35fa1abbb6b4dd3`
- **DNS failure:** `ENOTFOUND` — all 3 attempts failed
- **Retry pattern:** ~5 second intervals

## Severity
**LOW-MEDIUM** — Webhook event delivery failed silently after retries. If any downstream system depends on `TICKET_CREATED` events, it will not have received the notification.

## Impact
- Downstream webhook subscriber did not receive `TICKET_CREATED` event
- Silent failure — no further retry or DLQ mechanism visible in logs
- `webhook-test.com` may be a test/staging endpoint that was not properly configured

## Recommended Actions
1. Verify the webhook URL `https://webhook-test.com/3cec79e3fa376555e35fa1abbb6b4dd3` is correct and reachable.
2. Check if `webhook-test.com` is a test domain that should be replaced with the real endpoint.
3. Implement a dead-letter queue (DLQ) or persistent retry for failed webhooks.
4. Add alerting for webhook delivery exhaustion (after max retries reached).
5. Consider validating webhook URL reachability before registering it in the system.

allWorkPackages.subject: [compass-web / Fastify] Repeated Missing/Bad Authorization Header — FST_BASIC_AUTH (6 occurrences)
allWorkPackages.description:
## Summary
The `compass-web` Fastify service is repeatedly returning HTTP `401 Unauthorized` due to missing or malformed `Authorization` headers. Error code `FST_BASIC_AUTH_MISSING_OR_BAD_AUTHORIZATION_HEADER` from `@fastify/basic-auth` is triggered 6 times across 3 distinct request IDs, indicating a client integration issue — clients are not sending the required Basic Auth header.

## Fingerprint
`compass-web:fastify-basic-auth-missing-header:2026-04-08`

## Error Details

### Error Type
```
FastifyError: Missing or bad formatted authorization header
  code: FST_BASIC_AUTH_MISSING_OR_BAD_AUTHORIZATION_HEADER
  statusCode: 401
  at Object.basicAuth (@fastify/basic-auth/index.js:91:12)
```

### Occurrence Log
| Time (Unix) | Request ID | Status Code |
|-------------|------------|-------------|
| 1775611733212 | req-n7 | 401 |
| 1775611733212 | req-n7 | 401 |
| 1775613787685 | req-n8 | 401 |
| 1775613787685 | req-n8 | 401 |
| 1775629395689 | req-n9 | 401 |
| 1775629395689 | req-n9 | 401 |

## Statistics
- **Total occurrences:** 6 (3 unique request IDs × 2 log entries each)
- **Affected endpoint:** Fastify server with `@fastify/basic-auth` middleware
- **Date:** 2026-04-08 (timestamps ~03:28 AM, ~04:03 AM, ~08:30 AM UTC)
- **Hostname:** `413c0d68c60a` (Docker container)

## Severity
**MEDIUM** — Repeated 401 failures across multiple request IDs suggest clients are consistently missing the `Authorization` header. This may be:
- A client integration bug (forgot to include Basic Auth credentials)
- A misconfigured API consumer
- A browser/client caching issue clearing auth credentials

## Stack Trace Summary
Error thrown inside `basicAuth` hook → `hookIterator` → `fastifyCookieHandler` → `fastifyWebSocket` → `@fastify/view`. The error is triggered in the `onRequest` hook pipeline.

## Impact
- Clients failing to access compass-web endpoints
- Repeated 401 responses generating error log noise
- Potential user-facing access issues

## Recommended Actions

allWorkPackages.subject: Client-side pending outbound chat persistence
allWorkPackages.description:
**Description**  
When user sends an outbound chat, the pending bubble must be persisted locally on client-side before making any backend API call. This prevents message loss if backend is down, network fails, page reloads, or backend error occurs.  
  

**Technical Requirements**  
1\.  On message send:  
   - Generate client unique message ID (UUID v4) immediately  
   - Save complete message object to IndexedDB / localStorage before API call  
   - Render bubble in pending state in UI immediately  
   - Only make backend API call after successful local save  
2\.  State management:  
   - Track message lifecycle: pending → sent → delivered → read  
   - Update local storage when backend returns confirmation  
   - On application load: check for pending messages and auto-retry  
3\.  Failure handling:  
   - If backend call fails: keep message locally, mark as failed with retry button  
   - Retry logic with exponential backoff (max 5 attempts)  
   - Never remove message from local storage until backend confirms receipt  
  

**Acceptance Criteria**

*   [ ] Message appears instantly in chat window when user hits send
*   [ ] Refreshing browser does NOT lose pending message
*   [ ] Network failure / backend error does not lose message
*   [ ] User can retry failed messages
*   [ ] Messages are cleaned up only after backend confirms success

allWorkPackages.subject: Make it outbound queue to queue per platform
allWorkPackages.description: ### **#Problem overview** saat ini semua outbound message (WhatsApp, Widget, Email, Instagram, Messenger) menggunakan **\*\*1 shared queue\*\*** (\`outbound-messages\`). Ketika WhatsApp service down, \`adapter.sendMessage()\` memblokir queue hingga ~132 detik per message, menyebabkan **\*\*semua channel lain\*\*** ikut terblokir. ### **#Solution** Split outbound queue menjadi per-channel queues sehingga kegagalan di satu channel tidak mengganggu channel lainnya. #### **#Outbound queue architecture before** Semua message masuk ke 1 queue. Jika WA blocking, message Widget & Email menunggu di belakang. #### **#Outbound queue architecture after** `OutboundQueueRouter` memetakan `platformType` ke queue terpisah. `OutboundMessageProcessor` tetap satu handler — NestJS otomatis menerima dari semua queue yang terdaftar. Jika WA down, hanya `outbound-whatsapp-web` yang menumpuk. Queue Widget, Email, dll tetap lancar. ### Manual Verification 1. **Happy path**: Kirim pesan ke setiap channel (WA Web, WA API, Widget, Email, Instagram, Messenger). Semua harus terkirim normal. 2. **Isolation test**: * Matikan WhatsApp service atau channel lainnya * Kirim pesan ke WhatsApp → harus fail/retry hanya di queue WhatsApp * Kirim pesan ke Widget → **harus langsung berhasil** tanpa delay 3. **RabbitMQ dashboard**: Verify 6 queue baru terbentuk di management console dengan DLQ masing-masing. 4. **Backward compat**: Verify queue lama `outbound-messages` masih dikonsumsi dan pesan existing terproses. 5. **Rollback**: Jika ada issue, revert `emitOutboundMessage()` ke menggunakan `outboundMessageQueue` langsung → semua message kembali ke shared queue.

allWorkPackages.subject: Outbound messages stuck in PENDING - shared RMQ queue blocked by degraded channel service
allWorkPackages.parentName: Make it outbound queue to queue per platform
allWorkPackages.description:
## Problem

After 2-3 days of server uptime, outbound messages across **all channels** (WhatsApp, Widget, Email, Instagram, Messenger) get stuck in `PENDING` status. Restarting the WhatsApp service temporarily fixes it.

## Root Cause

All outbound messages from ALL channel types are published to a single shared RMQ queue: `outbound-messages` (consumed by `conversation-service` `OutboundMessageProcessor` with `prefetchCount=10`).

Each channel adapter uses `ClientProxy.send()` (request-response pattern) with **no timeout**:

```typescript
// whatsapp-web.adapter.ts:44 — same pattern in all 6 adapters
return await firstValueFrom(
  this.clientWhatsappWebAsync.send(EVENT, payload), // NO TIMEOUT
);
```

When the WhatsApp service degrades over time (memory leak, Baileys session issues), `send()` calls hang indefinitely. Each hanging call holds an unacked RMQ message consuming one of the 10 prefetch slots. Once all 10 slots are filled by hanging WhatsApp calls, the consumer is completely blocked — **no messages from any channel can be processed**.

## Affected Files

- `apps/conversation-service/src/app/adapters/whatsapp-web.adapter.ts:44`
- `apps/conversation-service/src/app/adapters/whatsapp-api.adapter.ts:43`
- `apps/conversation-service/src/app/adapters/email-smtp.adapter.ts:44`
- `apps/conversation-service/src/app/adapters/instagram.adapter.ts:52`
- `apps/conversation-service/src/app/adapters/messenger.adapter.ts:43`
- `apps/conversation-service/src/app/adapters/widget.adapter.ts:46`
- `apps/conversation-service/src/app/processors/outbound-message.processor.ts:129`

## Reproduction Steps

1. Add `await delay(120000)` at the top of `sendMessage()` in `apps/whatsapp/src/app/app.controller.ts:209`
2. Send **10 WhatsApp outbound messages** rapidly to fill all prefetch slots
3. Send a message on any other channel (Widget, Email, etc.)
4. **Result**: Non-WhatsApp message stays `PENDING` forever
5. Check RabbitMQ UI (`http://localhost:15672`): `outbound-messages` queue shows `Unacked: 10`, `Ready: N`

## Additional Issue: Restart Does Not Fully Recover

Restarting only the WhatsApp service does NOT unjam the queue because:
- The `firstValueFrom()` in conversation-service has no timeout
- When WhatsApp restarts, replies for in-flight requests never arrive
- The 10 messages remain unacked, prefetch stays full
- **Both WhatsApp AND conversation-service must be restarted** to fully recover

## Fix

### 1. Add timeout to all channel adapters (High Priority)

```typescript
import { timeout } from 'rxjs';

async sendMessage(payload: MessageOutboundDto): Promise<ISendMessageResult> {
  return await firstValueFrom(
    this.client.send(EVENT, payload).pipe(timeout(30_000)),
  );
}
```

Apply to all 6 adapters. Add constant `ADAPTER_SEND_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000` in `base.constant.ts`.

### 2. Add PENDING recovery cron job (Medium Priority)

Scheduled job to scan messages stuck in `PENDING` for >60s and re-emit them to the outbound queue. Handles crash-between-DB-insert-and-RMQ-emit edge case.

### 3. Separate queues per channel type (Long-term)

Use separate queues (`outbound-messages-whatsapp`, `outbound-messages-email`, etc.) so one degraded channel cannot block others.

allWorkPackages.subject: TIcket List - Archived Ticket Types Still Selectable and Visible in Ticket List
allWorkPackages.description:
### **Jam.dev Evidence**

*   Jam.dev Link: [https://app.betterbugs.io/session/69e9cd279f3e754a20ade605](https://app.betterbugs.io/session/69e9cd279f3e754a20ade605)
    

## **Description**

There are issues in the **Ticket List** related to handling **Archived ticket types**.

1.  **Archived ticket types are still selectable** when creating a new ticket.
    
2.  Existing tickets that were created using a ticket type that has since been **archived remain visible**, instead of being hidden or excluded.
    

This results in inconsistent behavior between **ticket type status (Active vs Archived)** and how it is used or displayed in the system.

## **Steps to Reproduce**

1.  Navigate to **Settings → Tickets**
    
2.  Ensure there is a **ticket type in Active state** that has already been used in Ticket List
    
3.  Change the ticket type status to **Archived**
    
4.  Go back to **Ticket List**
    
5.  Perform the following checks:
    
    *   Click **Create Ticket**
        
    *   Open the **Ticket Type selection dropdown**
        
    *   Observe available options
        
6.  Check the **existing ticket list data**
    

## **Actual Result**

*   **Archived ticket types**:
    
    *   Still appear in the **ticket type selection dropdown**
        
    *   Can be selected and used to create new tickets successfully
        
*   **Existing tickets**:
    
    *   Tickets using archived ticket types are still **visible in the ticket list**
        

## **Expected Result**

### **Ticket Creation**

*   Ticket type dropdown should:
    
    *   Only include **Active ticket types**
        
    *   **Exclude all Archived ticket types**
        
*   Backend/API should:
    
    *   Not return archived ticket types in selection endpoints
        

### **Existing Ticket List**

*   Tickets associated with **archived ticket types** should:
    
    *   Be **hidden** from the ticket list  
        **or**
        
    *   Be handled according to defined business rules (e.g., filtered out by default)
        

## **Affected Environment (Bug Found)**

*    \[x\]  Dev
    

*   [ ] Staging
*   [ ] Prod

## **Tested Environment**

*   [x] Dev
*   [ ] Staging
*   [x] Prod

## **Additional Notes**

Possible root causes:

*   Backend still returning archived ticket types in API response
    
*   Missing filter condition (`status = active`) in ticket type queries
    
*   Ticket list not re-evaluating ticket type status dynamically
    

Impact:

*   Users can create tickets using invalid/archived types
    
*   Data inconsistency between ticket configuration and usage
    
*   Potential reporting and filtering issues

allWorkPackages.subject: analitycs - laporan offline-Archived Ticket Templates Appear in Template Selection (Offline Report Request)
allWorkPackages.description:
### **Jam.dev Evidence**

*   Jam.dev Link: [https://app.betterbugs.io/session/69e87dde9f3e754a20adb6e2](https://app.betterbugs.io/session/69e87dde9f3e754a20adb6e2)
    

## **Description**

There is a data filtering issue in **Analytics → Offline Report → Request Report**, specifically in the **Template selection dropdown**.

Ticket templates that are in **Archived status** are still appearing in the **template select list**, even though they should be excluded from active usage.

This creates confusion, as users may select templates that are no longer valid or intended for use.

## **Steps to Reproduce**

1.  Navigate to **Settings → Tickets**
    
2.  Move a ticket/template to **Archived**
    
3.  Navigate to:
    
    *   **Analytics → Offline Report → Request Report**
        
4.  Click on the **Template select dropdown**
    
5.  Observe the list of available templates
    

## **Actual Result**

*   Templates with **Archived status** are still visible in the dropdown
    
*   No distinction between **Active vs Archived** templates
    
*   Users can select archived templates
    

## **Expected Result**

*   Template dropdown should:
    
    *   Display only **Active templates**
        
    *   **Exclude all Archived templates**
        
*   Data should be filtered based on ticket status:
    
    *   Only templates with **Active status** are selectable
        

## **Affected Environment (Bug Found)**

*    \[x\]  Dev
    

*   [ ] Staging
*   [ ] Prod

## **Tested Environment**

*   [x] Dev https://app.betterbugs.io/session/69eade689f3e754a20ae0d67
*   [ ] Staging
*   [ ] Prod

## **Additional Notes**

Possible root causes:

*   Missing filter condition for `status = active` in template query
    
*   Backend/API returning both active and archived templates
    
*   Frontend not filtering archived data
    

Impact:

*   Users may select invalid or inactive templates
    
*   Leads to incorrect report generation
    
*   Reduces data integrity and UX clarity

allWorkPackages.subject: analitycs - laporan offline - Custom Field Columns Included in Export When Using Default (No Ticket Type Selected)
allWorkPackages.description:
### **Jam.dev Evidence**

*   Jam.dev Link: [https://app.betterbugs.io/session/69eae50b9f3e754a20ae0dfe](https://app.betterbugs.io/session/69eae50b9f3e754a20ae0dfe)
    

## **Description**

There is an issue in **Analytics → Offline Report → Create Report** when generating a report using **default settings (without selecting a specific ticket type)**.

When users only select a **date range (e.g. This Month)** and do not choose any ticket type, the exported Excel file still includes:

*   **Custom field columns**
    
*   **Custom field data**
    

This behavior is incorrect, as custom fields should only be included when a **specific ticket type is selected**.

## **Steps to Reproduce**

1.  Navigate to **Analytics → Offline Report**
    
2.  Click **Create Report**
    
3.  Do **not select any Ticket Type**
    
4.  Select a date range:
    
    *   Example: **This Month**
        
5.  Click **Submit / Generate Report**
    
6.  Download or preview the exported Excel file
    
7.  Open the Excel file
    
8.  Compare with **Ticket List data**
    

## **Actual Result**

*   Exported Excel includes:
    
    *   **Custom field column headers**
        
    *   **Custom field data**
        
*   This happens even though:
    
    *   No ticket type is selected
        
    *   Export is in default mode
        

## **Expected Result**

*   When **no ticket type is selected**:
    
    *   Export should only include **default ticket fields**
        
    *   **Custom field columns and data should NOT be included**
        
*   Custom fields should:
    
    *   Only appear when a **specific ticket type is selected**
        
    *   Match the selected ticket type schema
        

## **Affected Environment (Bug Found)**

*    \[x\]  Dev
    

*   [ ] Staging
*   [ ] Prod

## **Tested Environment**

*   [x] Dev
*   [ ] Staging
*   [x] Prod

## **Additional Notes**

Possible root causes:

*   Backend export logic not checking selected ticket type
    
*   Default export query includes all possible fields (including custom fields)
    
*   Missing conditional logic for custom field inclusion
    

Impact:

*   Exported data becomes cluttered and misleading
    
*   Columns appear without context
    
*   Reduces usability of exported reports

allWorkPackages.subject: Leads - Tag - Need Longer Delay Before Auto-Refresh After Tag Stored
allWorkPackages.description:
**Jamdev :**

**Description : After a tag is successfully stored in the database, the system triggers an immediate auto-refresh to display the new data. This prevents users from adding multiple tags. A longer delay/debounce time is needed after the data is stored before the refresh triggers, allowing for continuous input.**

**more record related :**

**Steps :**

1.  Login to the web application
    
2.  Navigate to Leads > Lead Detail
    
3.  Add a new Tag
    
4.  Attempt to add another tag immediately before the page refreshes

allWorkPackages.subject: Add Last Update Timestamp to All Analytics Pages
allWorkPackages.description:
Example Design: [https://www.figma.com/design/RAAuLaQKUufWMWWEm0kMb9/-V2--Satuinbox-Web-Specs?node-id=537-15559&t=VCZjNSVNLpcvaSnN-4](https://www.figma.com/design/RAAuLaQKUufWMWWEm0kMb9/-V2--Satuinbox-Web-Specs?node-id=537-15559&t=VCZjNSVNLpcvaSnN-4)
## Minimum Requirement ### Objective Show **last successful data update timestamp** on all analytics tab pages so users can understand data freshness. ### Scope Tambahkan **Last update** di page header untuk: 1. **Conversation** 2. **Ticket** 3. **Responsiveness** 4. **Member Performance** 5. **Broadcast** ## User Story * As a user, I want to see when the analytics data was last updated so that I can judge whether the data is fresh or delayed. ## Acceptance Criteria ### AC-01 Page Coverage * System must show **Last update** timestamp on: * Conversation analytics page * Ticket analytics page * Responsiveness analytics page * Member Performance analytics page * Broadcast analytics page ### AC-02 Placement * Last update must appear in the **top page header area**, near page title, consistent across all analytics pages * Placement should not interfere with existing filters ### AC-03 Value Source * Last update must reflect the **last successful analytics data refresh** * It must not use page open time or browser local refresh time ### AC-04 Format * Timestamp should be shown in readable format, for example: * **Last update 2 Feb 2026, 14:00 WIB** * Use tenant/app standard timezone display * Format must be consistent across all analytics pages ### AC-05 Loading State * While analytics data is still loading, Last update area may show: * **Last update: Memuat...** * or skeleton state ### AC-06 Error / Fallback State * If latest timestamp cannot be fetched but cached analytics data is shown: * system should still show the last available successful update timestamp * If no timestamp exists: * show fallback text such as **Last update tidak tersedia** ### AC-07 Filter Independence * Changing filter values such as date range, team inbox, agent, or channel must **not** change the Last update timestamp unless a newer analytics dataset is actually loaded * Last update represents dataset freshness, not filter interaction time ### AC-08 Consistency * All 5 analytics pages must use the same component behavior, label pattern, and timestamp format ## Functional Requirements ## UI / UX Minimum * Label: * **Last update 2 Feb 2026** * atau lebih lengkap **Last update 2 Feb 2026, 14:00 WIB** * Recommended with small clock icon * Style secondary, not competing with KPI cards * Same location on every analytics tab page ## allWorkPackages.subject: TIcket List - Missing Image Size Validation on Image Upload (Ticket Type & Ticket Creation)
allWorkPackages.description: ### **Jam.dev Evidence** * Jam.dev Link: [https://jam.dev/c/43f91e27-0615-4847-9541-3ca0a88d625e](https://jam.dev/c/43f91e27-0615-4847-9541-3ca0a88d625e) ## **Description** There is a missing validation issue for **image upload fields** in two different areas of the system. Currently, image uploads do **not enforce a maximum file size limit**, allowing users to upload images larger than expected. This behavior is inconsistent with the validation implemented in **Ticket Detail**, where image uploads are limited to **2 MB**. The system should apply the **same validation rule across all image upload components** to maintain consistency. ## **Steps to Reproduce** ### **Issue 1 – Image Upload in Ticket Type Custom Field** 1. Navigate to **Ticket List** 2. Go to **Manage Ticket Types (Kelola Jenis Ticket)** 3. Click **Create Ticket Type** 4. Focus on the **Image custom field upload** 5. Upload an image larger than **2 MB** ### **Issue 2 – Image Upload When Creating a Ticket** 1. Navigate to **Ticket List** 2. Click **Create Ticket** 3. Locate the **Image field** 4. Replace the default image by clicking **Select File** 5. Upload an image larger than **2 MB** ## **Actual Result** * Images larger than **2 MB** can be uploaded * No validation message appears * The upload proceeds without restriction ## **Expected Result** * Image uploads should enforce a **maximum file size of 2 MB** * When uploading images larger than **2 MB**: * Upload should be **blocked** * A clear validation message should appear * Validation behavior should be **consistent with Ticket Detail image upload rules** ## **Affected Environment (Bug Found)** * \[x\]  Dev * [ ] Staging * [ ] Prod ## **Tested Environment** * [ ] Dev * [ ] Staging * [ ] Prod ## **Additional Notes** Possible root causes: * Image upload component missing file size validation * Validation implemented only in Ticket Detail but not reused in other upload components Impact: * Users can upload excessively large files * Potential performance and storage issues * Inconsistent UX across image upload features

allWorkPackages.subject: Use Member Name as Assignee Display in Conversation Detail and Ticket Detail
allWorkPackages.description: ## Minimum Requirement ### Feature Use **Member Name** as assignee display label in: 1. **Inbox > Conversation Detail** 2. **Ticket > Ticket Detail > Ticket Assignee** ### Objective Replace visible assignee label from **username** to **display name**, where display name is sourced from **Member List Name**. ## Scope ### In Scope * Conversation Detail assignee display * Ticket Detail assignee display * Assignee chips * Assignee selected values in assignment UI * Assignee search result primary label * Existing conversation/ticket assignee rendering ### Out of Scope * Edit member page to change display name * Username/login flow * Member onboarding flow change * Audit log text migration * Historical export/report updates * New standalone `display_name` field ## Source of Truth * **Display label source**: `member.name` * Current `member.name` is created from **Full name during onboarding** * `username` remains for login/internal auth only * Future ability to edit member name can reuse the same source, but that is **not included in this scope** ## User Story * As an agent or supervisor, I want assignee names to use the same human-readable name shown in Member List, so that assignee identity is clear and consistent across the product. ## Acceptance Criteria ### AC-01 Conversation Detail * In **Inbox > Conversation Detail**, assignee names must display using `member.name` * Username must not be shown as the main assignee label ### AC-02 Ticket Detail * In **Ticket Detail > Ticket Assignee**, assignee names must display using `member.name` * Team inbox display remains unchanged * Unassigned state remains unchanged ### AC-03 Assignment Selector * In assignee dropdown/search/select state: * primary visible label = `member.name` * saved value must still use internal `user_id` * Username must not be the primary visible label ### AC-04 Existing Data * Existing assigned tickets and conversations must automatically show `member.name` without needing reassignment ### AC-05 Future Compatibility * If later Member Edit allows changing `member.name`, all assignee displays should automatically reflect the latest name because they read from the same source field * No extra display-name-specific migration is needed for this scope ### AC-06 Fallback * If `member.name` is empty or missing, fallback to `username` * UI must never render blank assignee label ## Functional Requirements ## Edge Cases ## UI Rule * **Read-only detail panel**: show only `member.name` * **Selector/search dropdown**: show `member.name` as primary * Optional helper text for duplicate names can be added later if needed, but not mandatory for minimum scope

allWorkPackages.subject: Autentikasi- Incorrect WhatsApp Number Validation in register and Missing Cooldown on Resend Email Verification
allWorkPackages.description: ### **Jam.dev Evidence** * Jam.dev Link: [https://jam.dev/c/7eeae640-04ef-4263-ade5-fc067127b8ec](https://jam.dev/c/7eeae640-04ef-4263-ade5-fc067127b8ec) ## **Description** There are validation and UX issues in the **Register Form and Email Verification process**. 1. The **WhatsApp number input validation** only allows **10–12 digits**, which is inconsistent with the expected range for valid WhatsApp numbers. 2. The **Resend Email Verification button** can be clicked repeatedly without any delay or cooldown, allowing users to trigger multiple resend requests continuously. These issues can lead to incorrect user validation and potential abuse of the email verification system. ## **Steps to Reproduce** ### **Issue 1 – WhatsApp Number Validation** 1. Navigate to the **Register page** 2. Enter a WhatsApp number longer than **12 digits** 3. Observe the validation behavior ### **Issue 2 – Resend Email Verification** 1. Complete the registration process 2. Navigate to the **Email Verification page** 3. Click **Resend Email Verification** 4. Immediately click the button repeatedly ## **Actual Result** ### **WhatsApp Number** * Validation only allows **10–12 digits** * Numbers with more digits are rejected ### **Resend Email** * The **Resend Email button can be clicked repeatedly** * No cooldown or waiting time is applied * Multiple verification emails can be triggered rapidly ## **Expected Result** ### **WhatsApp Number Validation** * The system should validate numbers between: * **12–16 digits** ### **Resend Email Verification** * After clicking **Resend Email**: * The button should be **disabled temporarily** * A **cooldown timer** should appear (e.g., 30–60 seconds) * Users should only be able to resend verification **after the cooldown ends** ## **Affected Environment (Bug Found)** * [x]  Dev *  [ ]  Staging *  [x]  Prod ## **Tested Environment** *  [ ]  Dev *  [ ]  Staging *  [ ]  Prod ## **Additional Notes** Possible root causes: * Incorrect input validation rules for WhatsApp numbers * Missing rate limiting or cooldown logic for resend verification Impact: * Users with valid WhatsApp numbers cannot register * Email verification endpoint may be abused via repeated requests * Potential spam or server load issues

allWorkPackages.subject: Whatsapp Web - Inbound Voice Note Playback Support in Chatroom
allWorkPackages.description:
Design: [https://www.figma.com/design/RAAuLaQKUufWMWWEm0kMb9/-V2--Satuinbox-Web-Specs?node-id=8629-3177&t=7jZdaRnFsP2d8wsK-11](https://www.figma.com/design/RAAuLaQKUufWMWWEm0kMb9/-V2--Satuinbox-Web-Specs?node-id=8629-3177&t=7jZdaRnFsP2d8wsK-11) 

### Scope (MVP)

*   Inbound only: voice note dari customer tampil di chat bubble dan bisa diputar.
    
*   Inline audio player:
    
    *   Play/Pause
        
    *   Loading indicator
        
    *   Countdown timer (remaining time)
        
    *   Seekable progress bar (drag/geser)
        

### Out of scope

*   Send voice note (outbound)
    
*   Waveform, playback speed, transcription
    

## Functional Requirements

### 1) Rendering (Chat Bubble)

*   Jika message type = voice note, render bubble dengan:
    
    *   Play/Pause button
        
    *   Progress bar + draggable thumb
        
    *   Remaining time label `mm:ss` (opsional tampilkan total duration kecil)
        
    *   (Opsional) Download action/icon mengikuti pattern attachment
        

### 2) Fetch & Playback

*   Audio tidak auto-download saat open room.
    
*   Klik Play memicu fetch audio (on-demand).
    
*   State:
    
    *   `idle` → `loading` (tampil spinner, disable play)
        
    *   `loading` → `playing` (audio start)
        
    *   `playing` → `paused`
        
    *   `playing` → `ended` (reset ke awal, progress 0, remaining = total)
        
*   Single playback: play voice note lain otomatis pause/stop yang sedang jalan.
    

### 3) Seek (Drag Progress Bar)

*   User bisa drag untuk seek.
    
*   Jika belum ready/buffered:
    
    *   tampilkan loading saat seek, lalu lanjut play/paused sesuai state terakhir.
        

### 4) Loading & Error

*   Loading indicator muncul untuk:
    
    *   initial fetch
        
    *   buffering setelah seek (jika perlu)
        
*   Jika fetch gagal:
    
    *   tampil error state inline + retry (klik Play lagi trigger refetch)
        
*   Jika codec/format tidak didukung:
    
    *   tampil error state + (opsional) tombol Download
        

### 5) Download Confirmation (Jika ada Download)

*   Klik Download wajib muncul confirmation prompt sebelum download.
    

### 6) Guardrails

*   Limit size mengikuti attachment limit: jika melebihi, tampil error “File terlalu besar” dan tidak attempt streaming.
    
*   Access control: audio hanya bisa diputar oleh user yang punya akses ke team inbox / conversation terkait (signed URL / short TTL).
    

## Acceptance Criteria (QA)

1.  Voice note inbound muncul sebagai audio player inline di bubble.
    
2.  Klik Play menampilkan loading lalu audio mulai diputar.
    
3.  Remaining time berkurang real-time sampai selesai.
    
4.  Progress bar bergerak real-time saat playing.
    
5.  Drag progress bar melakukan seek dan audio loncat ke posisi baru; remaining time ikut update.
    
6.  Jika play voice note lain, yang sebelumnya berhenti (pause/stop).
    
7.  Jika fetch gagal, UI menampilkan error dan retry bisa memutar lagi.
    
8.  Jika Download tersedia: klik Download memunculkan confirmation prompt sebelum download.
    
9.  User tanpa akses ke team inbox/conversation tidak bisa fetch/play (error/blocked state).
    

## Edge Cases

*   Duration metadata belum tersedia: timer tampil `--:--` sampai ready.
    
*   Spam klik Play/Pause: tidak double-fetch, state konsisten.
    
*   Network lambat/putus saat buffering: loading tampil, retry bekerja.
    
*   Seek saat loading: tidak crash, posisi final mengikuti seek terakhir.

allWorkPackages.description:
PRD: [https://docs.google.com/document/d/1i1H3r4OCqQUd9cmSZtkEVHqjcMFtXlF4xGeH6\_Z4eE0/edit?tab=t.crw8p2ejed1d](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1i1H3r4OCqQUd9cmSZtkEVHqjcMFtXlF4xGeH6_Z4eE0/edit?tab=t.crw8p2ejed1d) 

Design: [https://www.figma.com/design/RAAuLaQKUufWMWWEm0kMb9/-V2--Satuinbox-Web-Specs?node-id=410-90143&t=2LM5a3XZf9JAsOjg-11](https://www.figma.com/design/RAAuLaQKUufWMWWEm0kMb9/-V2--Satuinbox-Web-Specs?node-id=410-90143&t=2LM5a3XZf9JAsOjg-11) 

## Minimum requirement

### Behavior

*   Add **Team Inbox** filter (dropdown + search) on Broadcast History List.
    
*   Default = **All** (no filter).
    
*   **Team Inbox mapping is optional**:
    
    *   Broadcast from numbers **with Team Inbox mapping** → `teamInboxId` filled.
        
    *   Broadcast from numbers **without mapping** → `teamInboxId = null`.
        
*   When user selects a specific Team Inbox:
    
    *   Show only broadcasts where `teamInboxId == selectedTeamInboxId`.
        
    *   Broadcast with `teamInboxId = null` are **excluded** (but still included when filter = All).
        

### API contract (minimum)

*   List endpoint supports `teamInboxId` (optional query param).
    
*   Response includes `teamInboxId` (nullable) per broadcast row (resolved at send time).
    

### Edge case (lean)

*   Mapping changes later should **not** change historical rows → store `teamInboxIdAtSendTime` (or store `teamInboxId` at creation/sending time).

allWorkPackages.subject: Change Ticket Detail Composer Default to Internal Note
allWorkPackages.description:
Design: [https://www.figma.com/design/RAAuLaQKUufWMWWEm0kMb9/-V2--Satuinbox-Web-Specs?node-id=7021-29869&t=2GSfLgxEqR90Q4WY-4](https://www.figma.com/design/RAAuLaQKUufWMWWEm0kMb9/-V2--Satuinbox-Web-Specs?node-id=7021-29869&t=2GSfLgxEqR90Q4WY-4)

## Minimum Requirement

**Description:**  
Update the composer in the Ticket Detail page so **Internal note** becomes the default selected mode instead of **Reply to customer**.  
Also update the tab position so **Internal note** appears first, and **Reply to customer** appears second.

## Scope

*   Change tab order in Ticket Detail composer:
    
    *   First: **Internal note**
        
    *   Second: **Reply to customer**
        
*   Set **Internal note** as the default selected tab when Ticket Detail is opened.
    
*   Keep existing send behavior by mode:
    
    *   **Internal note** sends an internal-only note.
        
    *   **Reply to customer** sends a customer-visible message.
        
*   Keep current closed ticket behavior unchanged.
    

## Acceptance Criteria

1.  When an agent opens Ticket Detail, the composer defaults to **Internal note**.
    
2.  **Internal note** is displayed before **Reply to customer** in the composer tab/switcher.
    
3.  When the agent sends while **Internal note** is selected, the message is stored and displayed as an internal note only.
    
4.  When the agent manually switches to **Reply to customer** and sends, the message is sent as a customer-visible reply.
    
5.  When the ticket is closed, composer behavior remains unchanged, including disabled send action.
    

## Out of Scope

*   Per-user default composer preference.
    
*   Remembering the last selected tab across refresh/session.
    
*   Any change to message storage, permissions, or ticket lifecycle logic.
    

## Notes

*   Current behavior defaults to **Reply to customer**.
    
*   This task is only for **Ticket Detail** page composer default state and tab order.
