is **not re-fetched** after exiting the dropdown. As a result, the UI continues to use stale data. ## **Steps to Reproduce** 1. Navigate to **Ticket List** 2. allWorkPackages.subject: UI Ticket List - “More” Ticket Type Tab Displays Unlimited List Without Scroll or Search (Ticket List)
allWorkPackages.description:
### **Jam.dev Evidence**

*   Jam.dev Link: [https://jam.dev/c/68dba122-427f-41ff-91be-c8873c51a574](https://jam.dev/c/68dba122-427f-41ff-91be-c8873c51a574)
    

### **Description**

There is a UI/UX issue in the **Ticket List** under the **Ticket Type tabs**, specifically when clicking the **“More”** option.

When the **More** tab is clicked, all remaining ticket types are displayed **without any display limit**, **max height**, or **scroll handling**. This causes the list to overflow beyond the viewport, especially when the number of ticket types is large (e.g. hundreds or thousands).

Additionally, there is **no search input** to help users quickly find a specific ticket type within the **More** list.

### **Steps to Reproduce**

1.  Navigate to the **Ticket List** page
    
2.  Look at the **Ticket Type tabs** at the top
    
3.  Click the **“More”** tab
    
4.  Observe how the remaining ticket types are displayed
    

### **Actual Result**

*   All remaining ticket types are rendered **at once**
    
*   There is **no max height limitation**
    
*   The list **overflows beyond the viewport** (laptop and other devices)
    
*   There is **no scroll behavior**
    
*   There is **no search/filter input** to quickly find a ticket type in dropdown
    
*   UX becomes worse as the number of ticket types increases (e.g. 1000–2000 items)
    

### **Expected Result**

*   The **More** ticket type list should:
    
    *   Have a **defined max height**
        
    *   Support **vertical scrolling**
        
*   A **search input** should be provided to dropdown:
    
    *   Filter ticket types by keyword
        
    *   Allow quick selection of a ticket type
        
*   Behavior expectations:
    
    *   When the search input is **empty**, users can scroll through the list
        
    *   When users type a keyword, the list should be **filtered accordingly**
        
*   The UI should remain usable regardless of the number of ticket types
    

### **Affected Environment (Bug Found)**

*    [ ]  Dev
*   [ ] Staging
*   [ ] Prod

### **Tested Environment**

*   [ ] Dev
*   [ ] Staging
*   [ ] Prod

### **Additional Notes**

*   The issue may be caused by:
    
    *   Missing max-height and overflow handling on the More list container
        
    *   Lack of search/filter logic for large datasets
        
*   This bug impacts:
    
    *   UX and usability
        
    *   Performance for large ticket type datasets
        
    *   Accessibility on smaller screens and devices

allWorkPackages.subject: Improve Fix Round Robin System
allWorkPackages.description:
## 0) Tujuan & prinsip * Setiap **chat inbound** yang masuk akan **otomatis dibagikan** ke **1 agent utama (primary assignee)** yang **eligible**. * Kalau **belum ada agent eligible** atau **semua penuh kuota**, chat **masuk Queue (antrian)** dan **akan otomatis ke-assign** begitu ada agent yang eligible / slot tersedia. * Distribusi harus **adil (bergiliran / round robin)**: sistem membagi **1 chat per agent per putaran**, lalu lanjut putaran berikutnya sampai Queue habis atau semua penuh. * **Multi-assign (menambahkan agent lain)** dan **manual assign (Supervisor/Admin)**: * **Tidak mengubah giliran round robin**. * Dampaknya hanya ke **kuota** (slot) agent. ## 1) Definisi agent “Eligible” (bisa terima chat) Agent dianggap **Eligible** jika memenuhi semua: 1. **Online** * Agent dianggap **Online** kalau sesi realtime masih aktif. * Jika **offline > 10 menit** → dianggap **tidak online (timeout)**. 1. **Status kerja (Presence/AUX)** * **Active** = bisa terima chat * **Away** (meeting/toilet/lunch/out of office/dll) = tidak terima chat 1. **Kuota belum penuh (Max Active Conversations)** * Tiap agent punya batas jumlah percakapan aktif. * Jika sudah mencapai limit → agent **tidak eligible** sampai ada slot kosong. **Definisi “memakai kuota”** * Kuota agent bertambah saat agent jadi: * **Primary assignee**, atau * **Ditambahkan sebagai additional assignee (multi-assign)** (karena tetap beban kerja) * Kuota berkurang saat percakapan selesai/ditutup 1. **Jam kerja (Shift)** * Jika **di luar shift** → default **tidak eligible** * Kecuali agent mengaktifkan toggle **“Terima chat di luar jam kerja”** (personal) > Muncul Di dashboard berupa banner kalau online tapi diluar jam kerja bisa toggle on/off. ## 2) Banner & toggle “Terima chat di luar jam kerja” (Per User) **Kapan muncul?** * Agent **Online + Active**, tapi **di luar shift**. **Isi & aksi** * Banner: “Terima chat di luar jam kerja?” + Toggle: (ON/OFF) **Auto-expire toggle** * Jika agent **offline (timeout) > 10 menit** → toggle otomatis **OFF**. **Dampak toggle ON** * Agent jadi **Eligible** untuk menerima chat inbound **meski di luar shift**. ## 3) Queue + Round Robin ### State percakapan * **Waiting (Queue):** menunggu (karena belum ada agent eligible / semua penuh) * **Assigned:** sudah punya **primary assignee** ### Urutan Queue * **FIFO**: yang masuk duluan diproses duluan. ### Cara round robin bekerja * Sistem menyimpan **“giliran terakhir”** per Team Inbox. * Saat akan membagikan chat: 1. Sistem kumpulkan daftar agent yang **Eligible** 2. Sistem pilih **agent berikutnya** setelah giliran terakhir (berputar) 3. Chat di-assign ke agent itu sebagai **primary assignee** 4. “Giliran terakhir” pindah ke agent itu ### Aturan fairness saat Queue panjang * Dalam 1 putaran, sistem mencoba membagi **maksimal 1 chat per agent** (yang eligible & masih punya slot). * Lalu lanjut putaran berikutnya sampai: * Queue habis, atau * Semua agent eligible penuh kuota. ### Multi-assign & manual assign (pengaruhnya) * **Multi-assign (agent menambahkan agent lain)**: * Tidak mengubah siapa yang dipilih round robin sebagai **primary assignee** * Hanya menambah **kuota** agent yang ditambahkan * **Manual assign oleh Supervisor/Admin**: * Tidak mengubah urutan/giliran round robin * Hanya memengaruhi **kuota** agent yang dituju (jadi bisa penuh / bisa jadi eligible/tidak eligible berikutnya) ## 4) Flow end-to-end ### A) Chat inbound masuk 1. Chat masuk → masuk **Queue (Waiting)** 2. Sistem cek agent eligible: * Jika ada → ambil chat paling depan → assign via round robin → jadi **Assigned** * Jika tidak ada → chat tetap di Queue ### B) Agent baru jadi eligible (mulai “narik otomatis”) Trigger contoh: * Agent login (jadi Online) * Presence berubah jadi Active * Toggle luar jam kerja ON * Slot kuota kosong (habis menutup chat) * Masuk jam shift Flow: 1. Sistem mendeteksi ada agent eligible / slot bertambah 2. Sistem mulai memproses Queue: * bagi 1 chat per agent per putaran (round robin) 3. Berhenti kalau Queue habis atau semua penuh ### C) Semua agent penuh kuota * Semua inbound tetap masuk Queue * Begitu ada slot kosong → sistem otomatis assign chat terdepan (mengikuti round robin) ### D) Tidak ada agent online (timeout > 10 menit) * Semua inbound masuk Queue * Begitu ada agent online + eligible → sistem langsung assign otomatis dari Queue ### E) Agent di luar shift * Toggle OFF → tidak ikut menerima * Toggle ON → ikut round robin dan mulai menerima dari Queue (sesuai giliran) ## 5) Aturan penting * **Satu chat hanya punya 1 primary assignee** (hasil round robin atau manual assign). * Sistem harus mencegah **chat yang sama ter-assign dua kali** (mis. saat banyak chat masuk bersamaan). * Sistem melakukan pengecekan ulang saat terjadi perubahan: * chat masuk * agent online/offline (timeout 10 menit) * presence Active/Away * kuota berubah * toggle luar jam kerja berubah * shift berubah (masuk/keluar jam kerja) ## 6) User Stories 1. **Auto assignment + Queue** * As an **Admin**, I want inbound chats to be automatically assigned using **Round Robin**, so that workload is distributed fairly without manual work. 1. **No eligible → wait and auto-assign** * As a **System**, I want chats to enter a **Queue** when no agent is eligible, so that chats are not lost and will be assigned automatically when agents become available. 1. **Outside working hour toggle** * As an **Agent**, I want a personal toggle to accept chats outside working hours, so that I can optionally take chats beyond my shift. 1. **Timeout behavior** * As an **Admin/Agent**, I want agents who are offline for >10 minutes to be treated as not online, so that assignment only goes to truly available agents and outside-hours toggle resets. 1. **Multi-assign & manual assign impact** * As a **Supervisor/Admin/Agent**, I want multi-assign and manual assign to affect only **quota**, so that it doesn’t disturb the fairness of round robin rotation. ## 7) Acceptance Criteria (AC) ### AC1 — Auto-Assign Round Robin (1 primary assignee) * Given inbound chat masuk ke Team Inbox
When ada minimal 1 agent eligible
Then sistem assign chat tersebut ke **1 primary assignee** berdasarkan round robin. ### AC2 — Queue saat tidak ada eligible / semua penuh * Given inbound chat masuk
When tidak ada agent eligible **atau** semua agent eligible sudah penuh kuota
Then chat masuk status **Waiting (Queue)** dan tidak hilang. ### AC3 — Auto-drain Queue saat agent jadi eligible * Given ada chat di Queue
When ada agent berubah menjadi eligible atau slot kuota bertambah
Then sistem otomatis memproses Queue dan melakukan assignment tanpa tindakan manual. ### AC4 — Fairness “1 chat per agent per putaran” * Given Queue berisi banyak chat dan ada >1 agent eligible
When sistem melakukan proses assignment dari Queue
Then sistem membagikan maksimal **1 chat per agent per putaran** sebelum mengulang putaran berikutnya. ### AC5 — Eligibility: Online timeout * Given agent tidak aktif/terputus
When offline selama **>10 menit**
Then agent dianggap **tidak online** dan **tidak eligible** untuk auto-assign. ### AC6 — Outside-hours banner & toggle (personal) * Given agent Online + Active, tapi di luar shift Then sistem menampilkan banner + toggle “Terima chat di luar jam kerja”. * Given toggle ON Then agent bisa menjadi eligible meski di luar shift. * Given agent offline >10 menit Then toggle otomatis **OFF**. ### AC7 — Presence/AUX effect * Given agent berstatus **Away** Then agent tidak eligible menerima chat baru, walaupun Online atau toggle luar jam kerja ON. * Given agent kembali **Active** dan masih Online Then agent kembali eligible (jika kuota tersedia dan rule shift/toggle terpenuhi). ### AC8 — Kuota effect (termasuk multi-assign & manual assign) * Given agent sudah mencapai limit kuota Then agent tidak eligible untuk auto-assign sampai kuota berkurang. * Given percakapan di-**manual assign** ke agent X Then kuota agent X bertambah dan eligibility agent X mengikuti aturan kuota, **tanpa mengubah giliran round robin**. * Given agent X ditambahkan lewat **multi-assign** Then kuota agent X bertambah, **tanpa mengubah giliran round robin**. ### AC9 — Tidak ada double-assign * Given dua inbound chat masuk hampir bersamaan Then setiap chat hanya memiliki 1 primary assignee dan tidak terjadi chat yang sama ter-assign ke dua agent. ## Out of scope * Batas maksimal per **channel** (di next phase 2).

allWorkPackages.subject: Clean up history Scaling
allWorkPackages.description:
No new config file needed — existing autoscaler in default namespace is handling it.

why i get scale-down-night-29542500-8q7xf                 0/1     Completed   0          34h  
scale-down-night-29543940-6flv5                 0/1     Completed   0          10h  
scale-up-day-29541605-4qtg2                     0/1     Completed   0          39h  
scale-up-day-29543045-hj67j                     0/1     Completed   0          25h  
scale-up-day-29544485-vkvqt                     0/1     Completed   0          95m every day like add more and more

Those are completed Job pods from your CronJobs. Kubernetes keeps a history of finished jobs by default, so they pile up over time.

Fix: Set history limits in your CronJob specs:

\`\`\`yaml  
  spec:  
    successfulJobsHistoryLimit: 1  # keep only 1 completed  
    failedJobsHistoryLimit: 1      # keep only 1 failed  
\`\`\`

Quick cleanup for the existing ones:

\`\`\`bash  
  kubectl delete jobs -l app=scale-down-night --field-selector status.successful=1  
  kubectl delete jobs -l app=scale-up-day --field-selector status.successful=1  
\`\`\`

Or just nuke all completed jobs:

\`\`\`bash  
  kubectl delete jobs --field-selector status.successful=1  
\`\`\`

Want me to check your CronJob configs and add the history limits?

on what path i shoud add spec

Found them! They're deployed directly in the cluster (no local file). Currently set to keep 3 history each — that's why they pile up.

Quick fix — patch directly:

\`\`\`bash  
  # Reduce history to 1  
  kubectl patch cronjob scale-down-night -p '{"spec":{"successfulJobsHistoryLimit":1,"failedJobsHistoryLimit":1}}'  
  kubectl patch cronjob scale-up-day -p '{"spec":{"successfulJobsHistoryLimit":1,"failedJobsHistoryLimit":1}}'

\# Clean up existing completed jobs  
  kubectl delete jobs --field-selector status.successful=1  
\`\`\`

Want me to run this for you?

i would like to have it on repo ~/project/omnichannel-satuinbox-be

Done! Created devops/k8s/22-scheduled-scaling.yaml with history limits set to 1 (down from 3).

Apply the update:

\`\`\`bash  
  AWS\_PROFILE=satuinbox kubectl apply -f ~/project/omnichannel-satuinbox-be/devops/k8s/22-scheduled-scaling.yaml  
\`\`\`

Clean up existing completed jobs:

\`\`\`bash  
  AWS\_PROFILE=satuinbox kubectl delete jobs --field-selector status.successful=1  
\`\`\`

Want me to run these?

the schedule is here /home/agitnaeta/project/omnichannel-satuinbox-be/devops/k8s/schedule/00.scheduled-scaling.yaml

Done! Changed successfulJobsHistoryLimit and failedJobsHistoryLimit from 3 → 1 for both CronJobs.

Apply & cleanup:

\`\`\`bash  
  AWS\_PROFILE=satuinbox kubectl apply -f ~/project/omnichannel-satuinbox-be/devops/k8s/schedule/00.scheduled-scaling.yaml  
  AWS\_PROFILE=satuinbox kubectl delete jobs --field-selector status.successful=1  
\`\`\`

### **Description**

Fokus utama saat ini adalah optimalisasi dan validasi akhir pada seluruh ekosistem Billing untuk penyesuaian UAT di _production_. Diperlukan percepatan _follow-up_ kepada tim _developer_ agar perbaikan segera tuntas, sehingga tim _devops_ dapat segera melakukan proses _staging_.

Cakupan pengujian meliputi:

1.  **Billing Subscription Feature**: Pengujian paket berlangganan.
    
2.  **Billing Usage**: Validasi pemotongan kuota (_deduct_) untuk broadcast, member, screenshot, dan channel.
    
3.  **Voucher System**: Pengujian fitur _Prepaid_ menggunakan sistem voucher.
    

### **Bug Reports & Findings**

#### **1\. Billing Subscription (Package & Pagination)**

*   **Pagination Issue**: Data tagihan pada halaman kedua tidak muncul, menghalangi proses pembayaran.
    
*   **Filtering Issue**: Fitur filter pada riwayat berlangganan tidak berfungsi.
    
*   **Sorting Issue**: Urutan data riwayat tidak berdasarkan waktu terbaru (acak/terbalik).
    

#### **2\. Billing Usage (Deduct Logic)**

*   **Validation**: Memastikan pemotongan saldo/kuota berjalan akurat untuk setiap aksi:
    
    *   Broadcast pesan.
        
    *   Penambahan/kuota Member.
        
    *   Penggunaan fitur Screenshot.
        
    *   Aktivasi/penggunaan Channel.
        

#### **3\. Voucher System (Prepaid Feature)**

*   **Integration**: Validasi klaim voucher untuk penambahan saldo/masa aktif.
    
*   **Logic Check**: Memastikan sistem _prepaid_ memotong saldo dengan benar sesuai penggunaan.
    

#### **4\. Top-Up Feature**

*   **Filtering Issue**: Ditemukan _bug_ pada filtrasi riwayat top-up (meskipun modal dan penambahan token sudah sukses).
    

### **TO-DO List**

*    \[x\]  **Intensive Bug Follow-up**: Menyerahkan detail _bug_ pagination dan filter kepada _developer_ untuk perbaikan segera.
    

*   [x] **DevOps Staging Request**: Melakukan koordinasi dengan _devops_ untuk _deployment_ ke server _staging_ setelah perbaikan _logic_ divalidasi.

allWorkPackages.subject: Test - [Ticket] - Bulk Reply
allWorkPackages.description:
**Acceptance Criteria:**

1.  Bulk Reply Action
    
    1.  available from ticket list bulk action bar
        
    2.  enabled when one or more tickets are selected
        
    3.  applicable for tickets with status open and closed
        
    4.  clicking action opens bulk reply modal
        
2.  Ticket Type Selection
    
    1.  default value is all when opened from tab "ALL"
        
    2.  auto-filled with active tab ticket type when opened from specific ticket type tab
        
    3.  determines available identifier options
        
    4.  affects downloadable template structure
        
3.  Identifier Configuration
    
    1.  default identifier is Ticket ID
        
    2.  identifier dropdown is enabled
        
    3.  available identifier types :
        
        1.  ticket ID
            
        2.  custom field (text, option only)
            
    4.  calendar and image type fields are not selectable
        
    5.  when ticket type = **ALL :**
        
        1.  only **Ticket ID** is allowed
            
        2.  custom field option is disabled
            
        3.  helper text is displayed explaining limitation
            
    6.  when ticket type = specific type :
        
        1.  user can select **Custom Field**
            
        2.  uset must select one field as identifier
            
4.  Selected Tickets List
    
    1.  displays total number of selected tickets
        
    2.  shows identifier value per ticket
        
    3.  shows identifier value per ticket
        
    4.  identifier column changes based on selected identifier
        
    5.  user can remove individual ticket from selection
        
    6.  removing ticket updates counter in real time
        
5.  Upload Reply File
    
    1.  upload reply :
        
        1.  accepts only .xlsx file
            
        2.  required columns :
            
            1.  identifier
                
            2.  reply
                
        3.  upload supports :
            
            1.  click to upload
                
            2.  drag and drop
                
        4.  system validates file before job creation
            
    2.  file validation :
        
        1.  block upload if required columns are missing
            
        2.  block upload if file size > 10 MB
            
        3.  block upload if total rows > 5000
            
        4.  block rows with empty identifier
            
        5.  block rows with empty reply
            
        6.  show clear error message per validation failure
            
6.  Template Download
    
    1.  available after identifier is selected
        
    2.  template columns follow selected identifier
        
    3.  template format .xlsx
        
    4.  template contains header only, no sample data
        
7.  Visibility Configuration
    
    1.  single visibility setting for entire bulk job
        
    2.  checkbox label : **Send To Costumer**
        
    3.  default state :
        
        1.  checked for agent
            
        2.  forced checked for client user
            
    4.  behavior
        
        1.  checked -> all replies are **public**
            
        2.  unchecked -> all replied are **internal notes**
            
    5.  helper text explains visibility impact
        
    6.  client user cannot submit job with unchecked visibility
        
8.  Submit Bulk Reply
    
    1.  submit button is disabled until :
        
        1.  identifier selected
            
        2.  valid file uploaded
            
    2.  clicking submit :
        
        1.  creates bulk reply job
            
        2.  starts asynchronous processing
            
        3.  redirects user to jojb progress view
            
9.  Job Creation Result
    
    1.  after submit
        
        1.  system shows upload progress
            
        2.  job status displayed as :
            
            1.  queued
                
            2.  processing
                
            3.  completed
                
            4.  failed
                
        3.  progress counters shown :
            
            1.  total
                
            2.  processed
                
            3.  success
                
            4.  failed
                
10.  Partial Failure Handling
     
     1.  row processing
         
         1.  each row processed independently
             
         2.  one failed row does not fail entire job
             
         3.  replies are creates only for successful rows
             
         4.  failed rows do not create any message
             
11.  Result Report
     
     1.  available when job is completed
         
     2.  downloadable as **.xlsx**
         
     3.  report contains per row :
         
         1.  identifier
             
         2.  resolved ticket ID
             
         3.  status (success/failed)
             
         4.  message ID (if success)
             
         5.  error code and error message (if failed)
             
     4.  report available for 30 days

allWorkPackages.subject: Ticket List - Inline Edit Validation Issues on Tag and Assign Agent
allWorkPackages.description:
### **Jam.dev Evidence**

*   Jam.dev Link: [https://jam.dev/c/5a4b562d-963e-4328-8630-0072615100e8](https://jam.dev/c/5a4b562d-963e-4328-8630-0072615100e8)
    

### **Description**

There are multiple issues in the **Ticket List inline edit feature**, specifically in the **Tag (Penanda)** and **Assign Agent** columns.

The current implementation lacks proper **validation and rendering behavior**, resulting in incomplete data rendering, missing maximum limits, and missing character validation.

### **Steps to Reproduce**

1.  Navigate to the **Ticket List** page
    
2.  Focus on the **ticket list table**
    
3.  Locate the **Assign Agent** column
    
4.  Use **inline edit** and try selecting agents as many as possible
    
5.  Observe how many assigned agents are rendered
    
6.  Locate the **Tag (Penanda)** column
    
7.  Use **inline edit** to select multiple tags
    
8.  Try creating a new tag with more than **32 characters**
    

### **Actual Result**

*   **Assign Agent**:
    
    *   Inline edit does **not enforce the maximum limit**
        
    *   Users can assign **more than 20 agents**
        
    *   Only **25 assigned agents are rendered/displayed**
        
    *   Remaining assigned agents are hidden and not visible in the UI
        
*   **Tag (Penanda)**:
    
    *   Only **25 selected tags are rendered/displayed**
        
    *   There is **no validation for a maximum of 50 tags**
        
    *   When creating a tag:
        
        *   There is **no 32-character validation**
            
        *   Users can input more than 32 characters
            
        *   The UI only truncates the text using ellipsis (`...`), but the full value is still saved
            
*   **Rendering Issue**:
    
    *   Both **Assign Agent and Tag** behave similarly by rendering only a subset of selected data
        

### **Expected Result**

*   **Assign Agent**:
    
    *   Inline edit should enforce a **maximum of 20 assigned agents**
        
    *   **All assigned agents should be rendered/displayed**, not limited to 25
        
*   **Tag (Penanda)**:
    
    *   Users should be able to assign a **maximum of 50 tags**
        
    *   **All selected tags should be rendered/displayed**
        
    *   During tag creation:
        
        *   Input should be **validated to a maximum of 32 characters**
            
        *   Users should not be able to exceed the character limit
            
*   Inline edit behavior should strictly follow the defined **validation and rendering rules**
    

### **Affected Environment (Bug Found)**

*    \[ \]  Dev
    

*   [ ] Staging
*   [x] Prod

### **Tested Environment**

*   [x] Dev
*   [ ] Staging
*   [x] Prod
    
    [inline edit infinite scroll and max assign agent/tag](https://jam.dev/c/02ac7d31-119f-4c9e-ba3c-4089a7952ae7)
    
    AND
    
    [create new tag max chars validation](https://jam.dev/c/2ccc60ec-9061-491b-93b2-986f91052490)
    

### **Additional Notes**

*   Issues may be caused by:
    
    *   Hardcoded rendering limits (25 items)
        
    *   Missing frontend validation logic
        
    *   Inconsistent UX handling for large selections
        
*   These issues impact:
    
    *   Data visibility
        
    *   Data integrity
        
    *   User confidence when using inline edit in Ticket List

allWorkPackages.subject: [QA] test schenario for baylies
allWorkPackages.description: # Test Scenarios: WhatsApp Memory Leak Fix ## Overview Test scenarios to validate the memory leak fixes in WhatsApp session management. ## 1\. Session Cleanup on Disconnection ### Scenario 1.1: Force Recreate Disconnected Session **Objective:** Verify that `checkSessions()` properly destroys and recreates disconnected sessions. **Pass Criteria:** * Only session-B gets recreated * `onModuleDestroy()` is called before recreation * Memory usage does not increase after recreation ### Scenario 1.2: Multiple Disconnected Sessions **Objective:** Verify multiple disconnected sessions are handled independently. **Pass Criteria:** * Exactly 2 sessions recreated * Connected sessions untouched * No orphaned socket references ## 2\. Redis TTL for Unread Messages ### Scenario 2.1: Unread Messages Expire After 24 Hours **Objective:** Verify unread message keys in Redis have TTL set. **Redis Commands to Verify:** ```bash # Check key exists KEYS "unread_message:*" # Check TTL TTL "unread_message::" # Expected: 86400 (or less if time has passed) ``` **Pass Criteria:** * Every `rpush` is followed by `expire` * TTL is set to ONE\_DAY (86400 seconds) * No permanent unread message keys accumulate ### Scenario 2.2: Self Messages Not Stored **Objective:** Verify messages from self (fromMe=true) are not stored. **Pass Criteria:** * `rpush` not called for fromMe=true messages ## 3\. Memory Cleanup on Session Destroy ### Scenario 3.1: All References Nulled on Destroy **Objective:** Verify `onModuleDestroy()` clears all references for garbage collection. **Pass Criteria:** * All 3 references are null after destroy * No lingering event listeners * Memory can be reclaimed by GC ### Scenario 3.2: Repeated Init/Destroy Cycles **Objective:** Verify no memory leak over multiple reconnection cycles. **Pass Criteria:** * Memory does not continuously increase * Each destroy releases allocated memory * No orphaned objects after 10 cycles ## 4\. Connection Service Cleanup ### Scenario 4.1: Cleanup Before Reconnect **Objective:** Verify `scheduleReconnect()` properly cleans up before creating new socket. **Pass Criteria:** * Old socket is closed before new one is created * `removeAllListeners()` called on old socket * No duplicate event handlers ### Scenario 4.2: Reconnect Debounce **Objective:** Verify reconnect doesn't trigger too frequently. **Pass Criteria:** * Debounce prevents rapid reconnects * `lastReinit` check works correctly ## 5\. Integration Test: Long-Running Session ### Scenario 5.1: 24-Hour Stability Test **Objective:** Verify session stability over extended period. **Pass Criteria:** * Memory usage stable (no leak) * Redis keys have TTL, don't accumulate * All reconnects successful * No OOM crashes ## 6\. Edge Cases ### Scenario 6.1: Destroy Already-Destroyed Session **Objective:** Verify graceful handling of double-destroy. **Pass Criteria:** * No exception on double-destroy * Idempotent behavior ### Scenario 6.2: Cleanup with Null Socket **Objective:** Verify cleanup handles null socket gracefully. **Pass Criteria:** * No null pointer exception * Graceful no-op ## Metrics to Monitor ## Test Environment * **Pod Memory Limit:** 3Gi * **NODE\_OPTIONS:** `--max-old-space-size=2560` * **Sessions:** 10-50 concurrent WhatsApp connections * **Duration:** Minimum 24 hours for stability test

allWorkPackages.subject: Migrate vm type to handle 400+ user
allWorkPackages.description:
**\# Infrastructure Optimization - 2026-02-25**

**\*\*Date:\*\*** 2026-02-25  

**\*\*Author:\*\*** Sage (AI Assistant)

**\*\*Status:\*\*** Completed

**\*\*Target:\*\*** 400+ active users with spike handling

\---

**\## Summary**

This document covers three major infrastructure improvements:

1\. **\*\*WhatsApp OOMKilled Fix\*\*** - Memory configuration alignment

2\. **\*\*Node Migration c6in → m6i\*\*** - 2x RAM, 31% cost savings

3\. **\*\*HPA/VPA Optimization\*\*** - Stability + spike handling

\---

**\## 1. WhatsApp OOMKilled Fix**

**\### Problem**

Pod \`whatsapp-7cc45cdcfd-th7rx\` was repeatedly crashing (4 restarts) due to OOMKilled.

**\*\*Root Cause:\*\*** Memory misconfiguration

\- Container limit: 2Gi

\- NODE\_OPTIONS: \`--max-old-space-size=4096\` (4GB)

\- Node.js tried to use more memory than container allowed → OOMKilled (exit code 137)

**\### Solution Applied**

**\*\*File:\*\*** \`devops/k8s/08.whatsapp.yaml\`

\`\`\`yaml

\# Before

resources:

limits:

memory: '2Gi'

env:

\- name: NODE\_OPTIONS

value: "--max-old-space-size=4096"

\# After

resources:

requests:

cpu: '250m'

memory: '1536Mi'

limits:

cpu: '1000m'

memory: '3Gi'

env:

\- name: NODE\_OPTIONS

\# Keep at ~85% of memory limit to prevent OOMKilled

value: "--max-old-space-size=2560"

\`\`\`

**\### Rule**

> **\*\*Always align Node.js \`max-old-space-size\` to ~85% of container memory limit\*\***

\---

**\## 2. Node Migration: c6in → m6i**

**\### Problem**

\- c6in instances are **\*\*compute-optimized\*\*** (high CPU, low RAM)

\- Messaging platform is **\*\*memory-heavy\*\*** (WebSockets, buffers)

\- Memory overcommitment at 135-217% on nodes

\- Frequent OOM issues

**\### Solution**

Migrated to **\*\*m6i (balanced)\*\*** instances with 2x RAM:

| Node Group | Before            | After             | RAM Change |

| ---------- | ----------------- | ----------------- | ---------- |

| General    | c6in.large (4GB)  | m6i.large (8GB)   | +100%      |

| Heavy      | c6in.xlarge (8GB) | m6i.xlarge (16GB) | +100%      |

**\### Cost Impact**

| Metric       | Before | After | Change |

| ------------ | ------ | ----- | ------ |

| Monthly Cost | ~$504  | ~$346 | -31%   |

| Total RAM    | ~28GB  | ~40GB | +43%   |

**\### Migration Steps Executed**

1\. **\*\*Created new node groups\*\*** (eksctl)

\`\`\`bash

eksctl create nodegroup -f devops/cluster.yaml --include=satuinbox-vm-m6i

eksctl create nodegroup -f devops/cluster.yaml --include=satuinbox-vm-heavy-m6i

\`\`\`

2\. **\*\*Cordoned old nodes\*\*** (prevent new scheduling)

\`\`\`bash

kubectl cordon -l node.kubernetes.io/instance-type=c6in.large

kubectl cordon -l node.kubernetes.io/instance-type=c6in.xlarge

\`\`\`

3\. **\*\*Drained nodes\*\*** (graceful pod migration)

\`\`\`bash

kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=60

\`\`\`

4\. **\*\*Deleted old node groups\*\***

\`\`\`bash

eksctl delete nodegroup --cluster=satuinbox-cluster --name=satuinbox-vm --drain=false

eksctl delete nodegroup --cluster=satuinbox-cluster --name=satuinbox-vm-heavy --drain=false

\`\`\`

5\. **\*\*Applied deployment updates\*\*** (nodeSelector for heavy workloads)

\`\`\`bash

kubectl apply -f devops/k8s/04.api-gateway.yaml

kubectl apply -f devops/k8s/11.conversation-service.yaml

kubectl apply -f devops/k8s/08.whatsapp.yaml

\`\`\`

**\### Final Node Configuration**

**\*\*File:\*\*** \`devops/cluster.yaml\`

\`\`\`yaml

managedNodeGroups:

\# General purpose node group (m6i.large = 8GB RAM)

\- name: satuinbox-vm-m6i

instanceType: m6i.large

desiredCapacity: 3

minSize: 3

maxSize: 22

tags:

project: satuinbox

\# Heavy node group for memory-intensive workloads (m6i.xlarge = 16GB RAM)

\- name: satuinbox-vm-heavy-m6i

instanceType: m6i.xlarge

desiredCapacity: 1

minSize: 1

maxSize: 3

labels:

workload: heavy

tags:

project: satuinbox

\`\`\`

**\### Services on Heavy Node**

Added \`nodeSelector: workload: heavy\` to:

\- \`04.api-gateway.yaml\` - Entry point, handles all traffic

\- \`11.conversation-service.yaml\` - Core chat logic

\- \`08.whatsapp.yaml\` - Memory-intensive WebSocket connections

\---

**\## 3. HPA/VPA Optimization**

**\### Problems Identified**

1\. **\*\*VPA Auto mode + 1 replica\*\*** = Downtime risk during pod eviction

2\. **\*\*api-gateway\*\*** max=1 replica, can't handle spikes

3\. **\*\*email\*\*** at 100% memory, can't scale

4\. **\*\*Orphan HPAs\*\*** cluttering the system (typos, deleted services)

**\### Fixes Applied**

**\#### A. Cleaned Orphan HPAs**

\`\`\`bash

kubectl delete hpa boardcast-service-hpa    # typo

kubectl delete hpa email-service-hpa        # no matching deployment

kubectl delete hpa instagram-service-hpa    # no matching deployment

kubectl delete hpa whatsapp-official-service-hpa  # no matching deployment

kubectl delete hpa people-service           # duplicate

\`\`\`

**\#### B. Fixed VPA Modes**

Changed from \`Auto\` to \`Initial\` mode (safe for single replicas):

\`\`\`bash

kubectl patch vpa api-gateway-vpa --type='json' \\

\-p='\[{"op": "replace", "path": "/spec/updatePolicy/updateMode", "value": "Initial"}\]'

kubectl patch vpa email-vpa --type='json' \\

\-p='\[{"op": "replace", "path": "/spec/updatePolicy/updateMode", "value": "Initial"}\]'

\`\`\`

**\*\*Why Initial mode?\*\***

\- \`Auto\` mode evicts pods to apply new resource values

\- Single replica + Auto mode = brief downtime

\- \`Initial\` mode only sets resources at pod creation (no eviction)

**\#### C. Fixed HPA Scaling Limits**

**\*\*api-gateway\*\*** (critical entry point):

\`\`\`bash

kubectl patch hpa api-gateway-hpa --type='json' \\

\-p='\[{"op": "replace", "path": "/spec/minReplicas", "value": 2},

{"op": "replace", "path": "/spec/maxReplicas", "value": 4}\]'

\`\`\`

**\*\*email\*\*** (was overloaded at 100% memory):

\`\`\`bash

kubectl patch hpa email-hpa --type='json' \\

\-p='\[{"op": "replace", "path": "/spec/maxReplicas", "value": 2}\]'

\`\`\`

**\### Final Autoscaler Configuration**

| Service              | VPA Mode | HPA Min | HPA Max | Notes                                  |

| -------------------- | -------- | ------- | ------- | -------------------------------------- |

| api-gateway          | Initial  | 2       | 4       | Entry point, must handle spikes        |

| email                | Initial  | 1       | 2       | Fixed overload                         |

| whatsapp             | Initial  | 1       | 1       | Stateful WebSocket, VPA handles sizing |

| conversation-service | -        | 2       | 3       | HPA only                               |

| messenger            | -        | 2       | 5       | High memory usage                      |

| Others               | -        | 2       | 3-5     | Standard config                        |

**\### Why WhatsApp Stays at 1 Replica**

WhatsApp (Baileys library) uses **\*\*stateful WebSocket connections\*\***:

\- Each connection maintains session state

\- Horizontal scaling would break session management

\- VPA handles vertical scaling (more RAM/CPU) instead

\- Memory limit set to 3Gi with NODE\_OPTIONS aligned

\---

**\## Final Architecture**

\`\`\`

┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐

│  HEAVY NODE (m6i.xlarge - 16GB RAM)                         │

│  ├── api-gateway (2+ replicas, HPA 2-4)                     │

│  ├── conversation-service (2-3 replicas)                    │

│  ├── whatsapp (1 replica, VPA Initial)                      │

│  ├── redis                                                  │

│  └── omnichannel, channel-service, etc.                     │

│                                                             │

│  GENERAL NODES (3x m6i.large - 8GB RAM each)                │

│  ├── messenger (2-5 replicas, memory-driven)                │

│  ├── people-service, company-service                        │

│  ├── notification-service, ticket-service                   │

│  ├── media-service, payment-service                         │

│  ├── instagram, whatsapp-api                                │

│  └── widget, widget-fe, analytics, broadcast, email         │

└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

\`\`\`

\---

**\## Metrics After Optimization**

| Metric               | Before    | After          |

| -------------------- | --------- | -------------- |

| Nodes                | 6 (c6in)  | 4 (m6i)        |

| Total RAM            | 28GB      | 40GB           |

| Monthly Cost         | ~$504     | ~$346          |

| Pods                 | 48        | 47             |

| OOM Events           | Frequent  | None           |

| api-gateway Replicas | 1 (fixed) | 2-4 (scalable) |

\---

**\## Files Modified**

\`\`\`bash

\# Create c6in node groups

eksctl create nodegroup --cluster=satuinbox-cluster \\

\--name=satuinbox-vm-rollback \\

\--instance-type=c6in.large \\

\--nodes=5

\# Cordon m6i nodes and drain

kubectl cordon -l node.kubernetes.io/instance-type=m6i.large

allWorkPackages.subject: Ticket List - Search Input Does Not Support Comma-Separated Values by Scope (Ticket List)
allWorkPackages.description:
### **Jam.dev Evidence**

*   Jam.dev Link: [https://jam.dev/c/2a2032e5-6740-46f5-bf9a-5aecce5d4d82](https://jam.dev/c/2a2032e5-6740-46f5-bf9a-5aecce5d4d82)
    

### **Description**

There is an issue with the **search input by scope** in the **Ticket List** where **comma-separated values are not supported**.

Currently, when users enter multiple search terms separated by commas, the system treats the entire input as **a single search value**, instead of splitting it into multiple parts and searching each part individually.

In addition, the search input does **not enforce validation rules** related to the total character limit.

### **Steps to Reproduce**

1.  Navigate to the **Ticket List** page
    
2.  Select a search **Scope** (e.g. **Client**)
    
3.  In the search input, type a valid value (e.g. `rizal`)
    
    *   Observe that results are returned correctly
        
4.  Add a comma and continue typing a second value
    
    *   Example: `rizal, toko kucing`
        

### **Actual Result**

*   The input `rizal, toko kucing` is treated as **one single search term**
    
*   The system does **not split** the input by comma
    
*   Search is not performed separately for each part
    
*   There is **no validation** for the **total character limit**
    
*   Users can continue typing indefinitely
    

### **Expected Result**

*   The search input should support **comma-separated values**:
    
    *   Each value separated by a comma should be treated as **an individual search term**
        
    *   The system should search using **all separated parts**
        
*   Example:
    
    *   Input: `rizal, toko kucing`
        
    *   Expected behavior: Search for **rizal OR toko kucing**
        
*   Validation rules should be applied:
    
    *   **No character limit per part**
        
    *   **Maximum 500 total characters**, including commas and spaces
        
    *   When the total character limit is reached:
        
        *   Users should not be able to type additional characters
            
        *   Users should not be able to add another comma (new part)
            

### **Affected Environment (Bug Found)**

*    Dev
    
*   Staging
    
*   Prod
    

### **Tested Environment**

*   [x] Dev
    
    evidence : [jam.dev](https://jam.dev/c/6feaabaf-d9b1-48fe-bc4c-e9fd4ff8b928)
    
*   [ ] Staging
*   [x] [Prod](https://jam.dev/c/5d10f426-89ca-484f-9042-439419fcc992)

### **Additional Notes**

*   The issue may be caused by:
    
    *   Search logic only handling single input values
        
    *   Missing parsing logic for comma-separated input
        
    *   Missing frontend input length validation
        
*   This bug impacts:
    
    *   Multi-value search usability
        
    *   Efficiency when searching multiple entities
        
    *   User expectations for scoped search behavior

allWorkPackages.subject: Conversation Satu Inbox - Acceptance Criteria
allWorkPackages.description:
**Design:**

**User Story** :

**Team Activity** :

**Technical Analysis :**

**Acceptance Criteria** :

1.  Navigation Panel
    
    1.  inbox navigation section :
        
        1.  Your inbox :
            
            1.  set as default when inbox page visited
                
            2.  display all assigned chat from all organization channel
                
            3.  chat handler must same as userlogin
                
            4.  chat status is assigned
                
            5.  highlighted when active
                
            6.  have counter
                
        2.  Unassigned :
            
            1.  display all unassigned chat from all organization channel
                
            2.  chat handler must be empty
                
            3.  chat status is unassigned
                
            4.  highlighted when active
                
            5.  have counter
                
        3.  All
            
            1.  display all chat from all organization channel
                
            2.  chat handler must same as userlogin
                
            3.  highlighted when active
                
            4.  have counter
                
        4.  Starred
            
            1.  display all favorite chat from all organization channel
                
            2.  chat handler must same as userlogin
                
            3.  isStarred value is userId (multiple userId)
                
            4.  _chat that marked as favorite_
                
            5.  highlighted when active
                
            6.  have counter
                
        5.  Spam
            
            1.  display all spam chat from all organization channel
                
            2.  isSpam value is userId (multiple userId)
                
            3.  highlighted when active
                
            4.  have counter
                
            5.  _apply to general ( company )_ → isSpam value is userId (multiple userId)
                
            6.  when conversation marked as spam, it should :
                
                1.  displayed only in spam
                    
                2.  if isStarred then marked as spam, it should only displayed at spam too
                    
                3.  if message pinned, then marked as spam, it should remove pin and only displayed at spam
                    
                4.  do not display on channel or team
                    
            7.  when conversation unmarked as spam, it should :
                
                1.  listed back to original place
                    
                2.  if isStarred, then unmarked as spam, listed back to original place, it still have starred
                    
                3.  listed back to channel or team
                    
    2.  Channel navigation section
        
        1.  Group Chat → need breakdown and grooming
            
            1.  **Message Synchronization – All Group Messages Must Appear in SatuInbox**
                
                1.  **Inbound Message Sync**
                    
                    *   The system must receive all inbound messages from WhatsApp:
                        
                    *   **text, media, files, location, sticker, contact, system messages.**
                        
                    *   Messages must appear in the UI with minimal delay (target latency < **1 second**).
                        
                    *   Ordering must follow WhatsApp timestamps; messages must never appear out of sequence.
                        
                    *   Any failed message processing must go to a **retry queue** and be reprocessed without duplication.
                        
                2.  **No Missing Messages**
                    
                    *   Every incoming messageId must be stored and checked to ensure no gaps.
                        
                    *   If messageId or timestamp gaps are detected → trigger **automatic backfill**.
                        
                    *   Baileys may skip messages during reconnect; therefore:
                        
                        *   Track `lastMessageTimestamp` per group.
                            
                        *   If the gap is greater than 1–3 minutes → call `sock.loadMessages(groupJid, count)` to backfill.
                            
                        *   Periodically call `groupMetadata(groupJid)` for metadata self-healing.
                            
                3.  **No Duplicates**
                    
                    *   Messages that already exist must not be stored again even if Baileys sends duplicates.
                        
                    *   Deduplication rules:
                        
                        *   messageId
                            
                        *   groupId
                            
                        *   (timestamp + sender + contentHash) as fallback
                            
                4.  **Ordering**
                    
                    *   Sort using `message.messageTimestamp`.
                        
                    *   Never rely solely on Baileys’ event order.
                        
            2.  **Group Member Synchronization – Full Member List in SatuInbox**
                
                1.  **Member Sync**
                    
                    *   SatuInbox must always reflect the correct WhatsApp group membership.
                        
                    *   If a member is invited from mobile, SatuInbox updates immediately.
                        
                    *   Members who leave are marked **“left”** but their message history must remain.
                        
                2.  **Member Identity**
                    
                    *   For every group member, store and display:
                        
                        *   phone number
                            
                        *   default name (if provided by WhatsApp)
                            
                        *   role (admin / member)
                            
                    *   If WhatsApp doesn’t provide a name → display only the phone number.
                        
                    *   If a matching Contact Profile exists in SatuInbox → display enriched profile name.
                        
                3.  **Multi-company Member View**
                    
                    *   Member A (Company A) and Member B (Company B) can participate in the same WhatsApp group.
                        
                    *   Both must see **one shared group room**.
                        
                    *   The room must be globally unique by **whatsapp\_group\_id**, not by company.
                        
            3.  **Inbound & Outbound Messaging (Text, Media, Files)**
                
                1.  **Sending Messages**
                    
                    1.  Agents must be able to send the following:
                        
                        *   text
                            
                        *   image
                            
                        *   video
                            
                        *   document
                            
                        *   audio / voice note
                            
                    2.  All uploads must go through storage (S3 / MinIO) before sending to WhatsApp.
                        
                2.  **Delivery Status**
                    
                    1.  The UI must show:
                        
                        *   sent
                            
                        *   delivered
                            
                        *   read
                            
                        *   failed (with retry option)
                            
                3.  **Outbound Validation**
                    
                    *   If an agent’s division does not have access to the WA number connected to the group:
                        
                        *   Disable the input box
                            
                        *   Show appropriate error message
                            
                4.  **Queue-based Outbound Processing**
                    
                    *   All outbound messages must go to `outbound.message.queue`.
                        
                    *   Worker sends to Baileys.
                        
                    *   Worker must be **idempotent**.
                        
                5.  **Delivery Feedback Handling**
                    
                    *   Store the Baileys result (message ID) in DB.
                        
                    *   Handle `messages.update` events to update delivery and read status.
                        
            4.  **Multi-company / Multi-division Handling**
                
                1.  **Global Group Room**
                    
                    *   A WhatsApp group must map to **one single room** across all companies.
                        
                    *   No per-company duplication.
                        
                    *   Room access controlled by:
                        
                        *   division ownership of the WA number
                            
                        *   agent permissions
                            
                2.  **Company Data Isolation**
                    
                    1.  Agents from Company A:
                        
                        *   can see the entire group chat
                            
                        *   can see messages from members of Company B
                            
                        *   **cannot** see Company B’s internal information:
                            
                            *   tags
                                
                            *   CRM profile
                                
                            *   notes
                                
                    2.  Only phone number and public profile are allowed.
                        
                3.  **Conflict-free Message Routing**
                    
                    *   Messages from Company B members must appear in the same room.
                        
                    *   SatuInbox must never create a private chat room from group messages.
                        
                4.  **Member Left Behavior**
                    
                    1.  If a member has left from WhatsApp and their number is connected in SatuInbox:
                        
                        *   If the room remains open in SatuInbox: **Disable message input** for outbound messages from that number.
                            
            5.  **Real-time Membership Events**
                
                1.  **Join Event**
                    
                    1.  When receiving a "new member invited" event:
                        
                        *   Update member list within ≤ 1 second
                            
                        *   Add system message: **“X joined the group”**
                            
                        *   Assign default role = member
                            
                2.  **Promote / Demote**
                    
                    *   Update admin/member roles
                        
                    *   Optional system message for clarity
                        
                3.  **Leave Event**
                    
                    *   Mark status as **“left”**, do NOT delete from DB
                        
                    *   Add system message: “X left the group”
                        
                    *   Prevent accidental re-add states
                        
            6.  **High Throughput Messaging Capability**
                
                1.  **Scalability**
                    
                    *   System must process ≥ **200 requests/second** (inbound + outbound).
                        
                    *   Workers must support horizontal scaling.
                        
                2.  **Latency**
                    
                    *   Inbound processing: < **150ms**
                        
                    *   Outbound processing (including WhatsApp send): < **250ms**
                        
                3.  **Database Indexes**
                    
                    1.  Indexes required:
                        
                        *   groupId
                            
                        *   messageId (unique)
                            
                        *   timestamp
                            
                        *   senderNumber
                            
                4.  **Burst Traffic Optimization**
                    
                    1.  For 100–1000 messages/second:
                        
                        *   Batch insert (≈100 messages per batch)
                            
                        *   UI must consume data via **streaming**, not polling
                            
            7.  **Queueing Architecture (RabbitMQ)**
                
                1.  **Queue Structure**
                    
                    1.  Minimum required queues:
                        
                        *   inbound.message.queue
                            
                        *   outbound.message.queue
                            
                        *   group.events.queue (join / leave / metadata updates)
                            
                        *   retry.queue (DLQ)
                            
                2.  **Retry Logic**
                    
                    *   Maximum retries: **3 times**
                        
                    *   Exponential delay: **1s → 3s → 10s**
                        
                    *   Permanent failure → move to DLQ
                        
                3.  **Worker Idempotency**
                    
                    *   Same action executed twice must NOT create duplicate outputs
                        
                    *   Use:
                        
                        *   distributed lock
                            
                        *   messageId lock
                            
                4.  **Autoscaling Rules**
                    
                    1.  Workers auto-scale based on:
                        
                        *   queue length
                            
                        *   processing time
                            
                        *   backlog threshold
                            
            8.  **Error Handling, Security, and Monitoring**
                
                1.  **Error Visibility**
                    
                    1.  All worker errors must be logged to:
                        
                        *   Sentry / logging pipeline
                            
                        *   monitoring dashboards (Grafana / Graphite)
                            
                        *   DLQ viewer
                            
                2.  **System Recovery**
                    
                    1.  If the server or worker restarts:
                        
                        *   Workers must resume processing automatically
                            
                        *   No messages should be lost
                            
                        *   DB consistency must be guaranteed
                            
                3.  **Edge Cases**
                    
                    *   **Member uninstalls WhatsApp**
                        
                        *   Still appears in list
                            
                        *   Messages remain visible
                            
                    *   **Group name changed from phone**
                        
                        *   Auto-update unless overridden in SatuInbox
                            
                    *   **Baileys sends duplicate webhook events** → ignore via dedupe
                        
                    *   **Group deleted or archived in WhatsApp**
                        
                        *   Room → `inactive`
                            
                        *   Outbound disabled
                            
                    *   **Multiple WA numbers from the same company in the same group**
                        
                        *   Treat each as separate identities
                            
                        *   Avoid misrouting outbound messages
                            
                4.  **File Handling**
                    
                    *   Validate file type and size
                        
                    *   Antivirus scanning recommended
                        
                    *   Reject malicious or unsupported files

         3.  action pull rules
             
             1.  When the agent clicks **"Get Conversation"**, the system fetches available conversations in **FIFO order** (oldest unassigned first).
                 
             2.  Conversations are **immediately assigned** to the requesting agent.
                 
             3.  Assigned conversations appear in the agent’s **“Your Inbox”** with status = `Assigned to Agent`.
                 
             4.  If no unassigned conversations exist, a message appears: **"No available conversations in queue."**
                 
             5.  Supervisors can view the agent assignment activity in the **audit log / dashboard** for traceability.
                 
         4.  adjuster section rules
             
             1.  A **numeric input field** is displayed next to the "Pull Conversation" button.
                 
             2.  Default value = total number of conversations available in the queue.
                 
             3.  Minimum allowed value = 1.
                 
             4.  The agent can edit this field before clicking "Pull Conversation".
                 
             5.  When the field is empty or invalid (e.g., zero or non-numeric), a validation message appears:
                 
             6.  _“Please enter a valid number greater than 0.”_
                 
             7.  The system only assigns up to the entered batch size, following **FIFO order**.
                 
             8.  System prevents agents from exceeding queue size (e.g., if 3 requested but only 2 available, assign 2).
                 
         5.  assigned after pull rules
             
             1.  When "Get Conversation" is executed, each conversation’s status updates to `Assigned to Agent`.
                 
             2.  Assignment happens atomically — no other agent can claim the same conversation simultaneously.
                 
             3.  The system logs `assignedBy`, `assignedTo`, and `assignedAt` metadata for auditing.
                 
             4.  Conversations instantly appear in the agent’s inbox view without needing manual refresh.
                 
             5.  If assignment fails for any conversation (e.g., race condition), the system retries or logs the conflict visibly.

allWorkPackages.subject: Settings-Subscription- Payment-Inconsistent Language Usage in Subscription Card on Billing Page (database)
allWorkPackages.description:
### **Jam.dev Evidence**

*   Jam.dev Link: [https://jam.dev/c/7b2be89a-1f54-48e9-ba4d-0c19dab8a708](https://jam.dev/c/7b2be89a-1f54-48e9-ba4d-0c19dab8a708)
    

### **Description**

There is a language inconsistency issue on the **Billing page**, specifically in the **Subscription Selection card**.

Some texts within the subscription card are displayed in **English**, while the rest of the application uses **Bahasa Indonesia**. This inconsistency is caused by **English text values coming directly from the database response**, which are rendered on the page without localization handling.

### **Steps to Reproduce**

1.  Navigate to **Settings (Pengaturan)**
    
2.  Go to **Subscription (Langganan)**
    
3.  Open the **Billing (Penagihan)** section
    
4.  Observe the language used in the **subscription selection card**
    

### **Actual Result**

*   Texts in the subscription card are displayed in **English**
    
*   Other parts of the page and application are displayed in **Bahasa Indonesia**
    
*   Language usage is inconsistent within the same page
    
*   The English text originates from the **database/API response**
    

### **Expected Result**

*   All texts in the **subscription selection card** should be displayed in **Bahasa Indonesia**
    
*   Language usage should be **consistent** across:
    
    *   Billing page
        
    *   Entire application
        
*   Database responses should:
    
    *   Either store localized values, **or**
        
    *   Use language-agnostic keys that are mapped via **i18n** on the frontend
        

### **Affected Environment (Bug Found)**

*    [x]  Dev
*    [ ]  Staging
*    [x]  Prod

### **Tested Environment**

*    Dev
    
*   Staging
    
*   Prod
    

### **Additional Notes**

*   Root cause:
    
    *   **English strings are returned directly from the database**
        
    *   No localization (i18n) mapping is applied before rendering
        
*   Possible solutions:
    
    *   Normalize database values to language-neutral keys
        
    *   Apply frontend i18n mapping based on user language
        
*   This bug impacts:
    
    *   UX consistency
        
    *   Localization quality
        
    *   Professional appearance of the product

allWorkPackages.subject: Permanent Shareable Image Link (for XLSX Export Lincah)
allWorkPackages.description:
Kasusnya Lincah ingin bisa punya export data yang assetsnya bisa di lihat oleh kurir jadi bagaimana caranya bisa terlihat sementara di satuinbox ada expired image
## Minimum Requirements ### Goal Provide **non-expiring, shareable preview links** inside exported **XLSX** that remain valid “anytime” (requires internet), while **not exposing S3 object URLs** and allowing **revoke**. ## Scope * Generate **permanent share link**: `https://fe.xxxx/previewimage/{shareToken}` * Preview page loads image securely via BE. * BE validates token, then serves image via: * **302 redirect** to **short-lived S3 presigned URL** (recommended), or * **stream** from S3 (allowed fallback) ## User Stories 1. As a user, I can export XLSX containing links to image previews that work anytime. 2. As an user tech team, I can revoke a share link so it no longer works. ## Functional Requirements (FR) ### Link Generation * **FR-001** System MUST provide API to create a share link for a stored image. * **FR-002** Default share link MUST be **non-expiring** (no expiry), unless explicitly specified (optional). * **FR-003** Returned value MUST include `shareToken` and `previewUrl` (FE domain). ### Preview Page (FE) * **FR-004** `GET /previewimage/{shareToken}` MUST render an image viewer page. * **FR-005** Viewer MUST request image from BE using the shareToken (no direct S3 link stored in FE). ### Image Resolution (BE) * **FR-006** BE MUST validate shareToken and map to `file_key`. * **FR-007** If token valid and not revoked, BE MUST return: * **302 redirect** to S3 presigned URL with TTL **<= 60 seconds**, OR * **200 stream** image bytes (fallback) * **FR-008** If token invalid: return **404**. * **FR-009** If token revoked: return **403**. ### Revoke * **FR-010** System MUST provide API to revoke a share token. * **FR-011** Revoked token MUST immediately stop resolving image (403). * **FR-012** Revoke MUST be idempotent (revoke twice returns success with same revoked state). ## API Minimum (OpenAPI) - Just for references ### 1) Create share link * **POST** `/api/share-image` * Request: * `fileKey: string` (required) * `neverExpire: boolean` (optional, default `true`) * Response `201`: * `shareToken: string` * `previewUrl: string` ### 2) Resolve image (used by FE viewer) * **GET** `/api/share-image/{shareToken}/image` * Response: * `302` redirect to presigned URL (preferred) * or `200` streamed bytes * `403` revoked * `404` not found ### 3) Revoke * **POST** `/api/share-image/{shareToken}/revoke` * Response `200`: * `revoked: true` * `revokedAt: datetime` ## Data Model Minimum Table `share_images`: * `id` (uuid) * `token_hash` (sha256) **(store hash only, not raw token)** * `file_key` (string) * `revoked_at` (nullable datetime) * `created_at` (datetime) * `created_by` (optional) ## Security Requirements * **SEC-001** Token MUST be high entropy random (>= 256-bit). * **SEC-002** Store only `token_hash` in DB. * **SEC-003** Resolve endpoint MUST NOT accept `fileKey` from client (token → DB mapping only). * **SEC-004** Add basic rate limiting on resolve endpoint (per token/IP). * **SEC-005** Response headers for resolve endpoint SHOULD include `Cache-Control: no-store` (avoid caching redirect). ## Observability Minimum * **OBS-001** Log token resolution events: `shareTokenHash`, status (200/302/403/404), timestamp. * **OBS-002** Log revoke events with actor (if available). ## Acceptance Criteria * Exported XLSX from Lincah features is contains preview links that still work after >7 days (because link is FE token-based). * Clicking XLSX link (from Lincah) opens FE preview page and shows image successfully. * Revoked link returns 403 (viewer shows “Link revoked” state). * No S3 URL is embedded inside XLSX. * Presigned URL generated per request has short TTL (<= 60s). ## Out of Scope (MVP) * Password-protected share links

allWorkPackages.subject: WA Web - Continue Conversion Room Session When Changed Number
allWorkPackages.description:
## Minimum Requirement

Conversation ownership is based on a stable `conversation_id` (room id); **phone number mapping only affects new chats**; open conversations remain in original team (sticky/legacy-bound) unless explicitly moved. 

## Scope

**Channel:** WhatsApp Web (Baileys engine)  
**Area:** Conversation Room (Inbox System)  
**Trigger:** Outbound message sent (especially from **broadcast resend**) with a **different sender number** than before.

## Functional Requirements (Minimum)

### FR-1 — **Session continuity on sender number change**

When sending an outbound WA Web message to the same recipient (`to_number`) **and there is an active/open session in the same** `**team_owner_id**`, the system **must append the message to the existing** `**conversation_id**` even if the outbound `sender_number` changes.  
(No new conversation/session created.)

### FR-2 — **Create new session only when no active session**

Create a new session only if:

*   No open conversation exists for `(team_owner_id, channel=WA Web, to_number)`, **or**
    
*   The existing conversation is **Resolved/Closed** (i.e., not active).
    

### FR-3 — **Deterministic selection if duplicates exist (anti-bug guardrail)**

If multiple open conversations exist for the same `(team_owner_id, to_number, channel)` (legacy bug condition), system must:

*   Pick **the most recent** (`last_message_at` max) as the target `conversation_id`
    
*   Append outbound message there
    
*   Write audit note that dedup routing occurred (no need to auto-merge history in this ticket).  
    (Lean: prevents creating even more sessions.)
    

### FR-4 — **UI indicator: sender number change info**

In Conversation Room, when the outbound sender number used differs from the previous outbound sender in the same conversation, show a **system note** in timeline:

> “Sender changed from {Old Sender} to {New Sender}.”

### FR-5 — **Audit logging**

Add an entry to the conversation **Audit Panel** for:

*   Sender change event (Actor: user/system; Number: old→new; Notes: reason = broadcast/manual)
    
*   Dedup routing event (if FR-3 happens)
    

### FR-6 — **Permission & ownership integrity**

This feature must **not** move conversation ownership across teams. It only controls **which session to append** within the same `team_owner_id`.

### FR-7 — **Send blocking unchanged**

If chosen sender is not permitted/available, sending remains blocked until a permitted sender is selected (existing behavior).

## Acceptance Criteria (Ready to paste)

1.  **Append on sender change**
    

*   Given there is an **open** WA Web conversation for recipient `X` in Team Inbox `T`
    
*   When a broadcast resend sends to `X` using sender number `S2` (previous sender was `S1`)
    
*   Then message is appended to the **same** `**conversation_id**` (no new session)
    
*   And timeline shows: “Sender changed from S1 to S2.”
    
*   And audit logs sender change.
    

1.  **New session when no active conversation**
    

*   Given no open WA Web conversation exists for recipient `X` in Team Inbox `T`
    
*   When outbound message is sent to `X`
    
*   Then system creates a **new** conversation/session.
    

1.  **New session when conversation resolved**
    

*   Given the last conversation for recipient `X` in Team Inbox `T` is **Resolved/Closed**
    
*   When outbound message is sent to `X`
    
*   Then a **new** session is created (not appended).
    

1.  **Duplicate open sessions guardrail**
    

*   Given 2+ open sessions exist for `(T, X, WA Web)`
    
*   When outbound message is sent
    
*   Then system appends to the session with **latest** `**last_message_at**`
    
*   And logs a “dedup routing” audit entry
    
*   And does not create a new session.
    

## Edge Cases / Negative Scenarios (Minimum)

*   Sender number disconnected/not permitted → send blocked; user must active new number
    
*   Race condition: two sends at the same time → deterministic selection (FR-3) + audit.
    
*   Recipient exists in multiple teams (map open WA Web conversation exists for recipient X in Team Inbox T  
    When outbound message is sent to X  
    Then system creates a new conversation/session.  
    New session when conversation resolved  
    Given the last conversation for recipient X in Team Inbox T is Resolved/Closed  
    When outbound message is sent to X  
    Then a new session is created (not appeping changed) → if an **open** conversation exists, keep appending in original team (legacy-bound).

allWorkPackages.subject: WhatsApp Web: Outbound messages must show Agent name (actual sender) + hover shows Connected Account used (like v1)
allWorkPackages.description:
### Problem

Outbound messages in **WhatsApp Web** currently display only **Connected Account (name + phone)**, so it’s unclear **which agent** sent the reply.

### Goal

Default view shows **Agent Display Name** (actual sender). Hover reveals **which Connected Account (WA contact/number)** was used to send the message (v1 behaviour).

## Minimum Requirements

### Definitions

*   **Actual sender** = the internal user/agent who triggered the send action for that message.
    
*   **Connected Account** = WhatsApp Web account/number used to deliver the outbound message.
    

### UI Behaviour

1.  **Outbound message header (right bubble)**
    
    *   MUST display: **Agent Display Name** (e.g., “Eka Viora”).
        
2.  **Hover on the outbound header (agent name)**
    
    *   MUST show tooltip with:
        
        *   **Sent via:** `<Connected Account Display Name> (<E.164 phone>)`
            
        *   (Optional) **Sent at:** full timestamp
            
    *   Tooltip content is the “identifier” showing _which WA contact/number was used_.
        
3.  **Conversation Attributes panel**
    
    *   “Connected Account” MUST be **secondary** and shown **on hover** (match v1 behaviour), not as the primary always-visible value.
        

## Data

For each outbound message (WhatsApp Web), MUST include:

*   actual sender
    
*   `connected_account.display_name`
    
*   `connected_account.phone_e164`
    

## Fallback Rules (must)

*   If `actor_user` missing (legacy/import): show **Connected Account** as header + tooltip “Agent unknown”.
    
*   If `connected_account` missing: header still shows **Agent name** + tooltip “Account unknown”.
    

## Acceptance Criteria (QA)

*   Outbound WhatsApp Web messages show **agent name** by default.
    
*   Hover on agent name shows **Sent via connected account name + number**.
    
*   Connected Account is not the primary always-visible identifier in the attributes panel; it appears on hover (v1-like).
    
*   No regression to Livechat/other channels.

### **Description**

There is a functional issue in the **Bulk Reply (Balas Massal) modal** on the **Ticket List**, specifically in the **Ticket Type select input**.

When users search for a ticket type by typing a keyword, the search result does **not filter or return matching options**. It appears that the **search/filter logic for the select list is not implemented or not working correctly**.

### **Steps to Reproduce**

1.  Navigate to the **Ticket List** page
    
2.  Open **Bulk Reply (Balas Massal)**
    
3.  Locate the **Ticket Type** select field
    
4.  Type a keyword into the search input
    
    *   Example: `ticket-type-9`
        

### **Actual Result**

*   The search returns **no results (Not Found)**
    
*   The input keyword does **not filter** the ticket type list
    
*   Existing ticket types that should match the input are **not shown**
    

### **Expected Result**

*   The **Ticket Type** select input should support **search/filter functionality**
    
*   When users type a keyword:
    
    *   The list should be filtered based on the input
        
    *   Matching ticket types (e.g. `ticket-type-9`) should be displayed
        
*   The search should match against available ticket type data (e.g. name or identifier)

### **Additional Notes**

[**https://jam.dev/c/5d782cc5-1c4b-4225-a10e-31a8cc9532b8**](https://jam.dev/c/5d782cc5-1c4b-4225-a10e-31a8cc9532b8)

### **Description**

There are several UI style issues in the **Filter Button → Filter Modal Form** on the **Ticket List** page, specifically affecting the **selection components**.

Some fields have not yet adopted the latest **design system (“hand” style)**, and there are inconsistencies between the implemented UI and the design reference, particularly for **Calendar, Status, and Stage (Tahapan)**.

### **Steps to Reproduce**

1.  Navigate to the **Ticket List** page
    
2.  Click the **Filter icon button**
    
3.  The **Filter Modal Form** appears
    
4.  Observe the selection UI for:
    
    *   Calendar
        
    *   Status
        
    *   Stage (Tahapan)
        
    *   Other selection fields
        

### **Actual Result**

*   **Calendar**:
    
    *   Width is not 100%
        
    *   Border and UI style do not follow the “hand” style
        
*   **Status**:
    
    *   Selection UI has not implemented the “hand” style
        
*   **Stage (Tahapan)**:
    
    *   Uses a separate selection component and **does not follow the “hand” style**
        
    *   The **Stage field does not exist in the design**
        
    *   According to the design, **Stage should be part of Status**
        
*   **Other selection fields**:
    
    *   Some selections still use the old or default styles
        

### **Expected Result**

*   All **selection components in the filter modal** consistently use the **“hand” style**
    
*   **Calendar**:
    
    *   Uses full width (100%)
        
    *   Border and UI match the design
        
*   **Status**:
    
    *   Uses the “hand” style
        
*   **Stage (Tahapan)**:
    
    *   Should not exist as a separate field
        
    *   Should be merged or mapped into **Status** based on the design
        
*   No visual inconsistency between selection components within the filter modal
    

### **Affected Environment (Bug Found)**

*   [ ] Dev
*   [ ] Staging
*   [x] Prod

### **Tested Environment**

*   [ ] Dev
*   [ ] Staging
*   [ ] Prod

### **Additional Notes**

*   The issue may be caused by:
    
    *   Incomplete implementation of the latest design system
        
    *   Inconsistent usage of selection components in the filter modal
        
*   This issue impacts:
    
    *   UI consistency
        
    *   User experience clarity
        
    *   Alignment between design and implementation

### Description

There is a bug on the **Add Ticket** form where the **Priority** label displays text that looks like **raw JSON or parsed JSON data** instead of a proper, human-readable label.  
This makes the form confusing and impacts user experience.

### Steps to Reproduce

1.  Navigate to the **Ticket List** page.
    
2.  Click on **Add Ticket**.
    
3.  Observe the **Priority** field label on the form.
    

### Actual Result

*   The **Priority** label displays text resembling **JSON parsing output**.
    
*   The label is not user-friendly and appears to be unformatted or incorrectly parsed data.
    

### Expected Result

*   The **Priority** label should display a **clean, readable text** (e.g., _Low, Medium, High_).
    
*   No raw JSON or technical data should be shown to the user.

*    Dev

*   Prod
    

### Tested Environment

*    Dev
    
*   Staging
    
*   Prod
    

### Additional Notes

*   This issue likely relates to **label mapping or localization parsing**.
    
*   Possible cause: incorrect handling of JSON response for priority configuration.

Kondisi ini menyebabkan overlay upload stuck dan mengganggu interaksi user pada halaman.

*   UI kembali ke state normal tanpa memerlukan interaksi tambahan (klik manual).
