allWorkPackages.subject: Sales CRM feature
allWorkPackages.description:
## 📍 Ringkasan

Implementasi modul **Leads & Pipeline CRM** untuk manajemen prospek dan proses penjualan guna menangkap, mengelola, mengkonversi lead menjadi opportunity, serta memvisualisasikan pipeline penjualan. Fitur ini akan membantu tim sales melihat status prospek dan memprediksi revenue secara real-time.

## 🎯 Tujuan

1.  Memungkinkan pengguna membuat dan mengelola _leads_ dari berbagai sumber.
    
2.  Menyediakan alur kerja yang jelas dari lead → opportunity → deal closing.
    
3.  Menyediakan pipeline visual dengan tahap-tahap yang dapat disesuaikan.
    
4.  Mendukung _forecasting_ pendapatan dan aktivitas sales.
    

## 🧠 Definisi & Alur Kerja

### 1\. **Leads**

**Deskripsi:**  
Entity awal yang merepresentasikan prospek belum terverifikasi. Sumber bisa dari form website, live chat, email, kampanye marketing, manual input, dsb.

**Data Minimal yang Dibutuhkan:**

*   Nama Lead
    
*   Email / Kontak
    
*   Sumber Lead
    
*   Assigned Salesperson
    
*   Tanggal dibuat
    

**Logika:**

*   Lead dapat diberi _probability score_ berdasarkan konversi historis.
    
*   Lead bisa di-_qualify_ menjadi _Opportunity_.
    

### 2\. **Opportunity**

**Deskripsi:**  
Lead yang sudah dikualifikasi sebagai prospek yang bernilai dan siap ditindak lanjuti oleh tim sales.

**Fitur Utama:**

*   Nilai peluang (expected revenue)
    
*   Probabilitas konversi
    
*   Tanggal penutupan yang diharapkan
    

### 3\. **Pipeline Visual**

**Deskripsi:**  
Tampilan _Kanban_ dari berbagai tahapan proses penjualan, yang bisa di-drag & drop untuk memindahkan _opportunity_ antar tahapan.

**Tahapan Default (Contoh):**

*   New
    
*   Qualified
    
*   Proposal Sent
    
*   Negotiation
    
*   Won
    
*   Lost
    

**Kustomisasi Pipeline:**

*   Admin dapat membuat/edit tahap (mis. “Follow-up”, “Demo Dijadwalkan”) melalui UI.
    
*   Setiap tahap dapat diberi aturan atau aksi otomatis.
    

## ⚙️ Spesifikasi Functional

### A. **UI / UX**

1.  Daftar Leads (kanban / list)
    
2.  Detail Lead (form view)
    
3.  Convert Lead to Opportunity button
    
4.  Pipeline Kanban → drag & drop untuk Opportunity
    
5.  Filter / Search: Salesperson, Stage, Sumber Lead
    

### B. **Rules & Automasi**

1.  _Conversion Rule_
    
    *   Lead yang masuk dapat otomatis dikualifikasi jika memenuhi kriteria tertentu (opsional).
        
2.  _Assignment Rule_
    
    *   Auto-assign lead ke salesperson berdasarkan segment/aturan.
        

### C. **Integrasi**

1.  Integrasi dengan sumber data:
    
    *   Form Website → CRM lead creation
        
    *   Email → lead capture
        
    *   Live chat → automatic lead capture
        

## 📊 Reporting & Analytics

1.  Dashboard pipeline status (jumlah _won_, _lost_, _open_)
    
2.  Forecast pendapatan berdasarkan probability
    
3.  Conversion rate lead → opportunity
    
4.  Segmentasi leads berdasarkan sumber
    

## 🚀 Acceptance Criteria

1.  Pengguna dapat membuat, melihat, edit, dan hapus _lead_.
    
2.  Lead dapat dikonversi menjadi opportunity.
    
3.  Pipeline dapat menampilkan semua opportunity dalam bentuk Kanban.
    
4.  Admin dapat menambah/edit tahap pipeline.
    
5.  Assignment rule bekerja sesuai konfigurasi.
    

## 🧪 Notes / Catatan Teknis

*   Gunakan modul CRM Odoo sebagai basis (model `crm.lead`).
    
*   _Probability_ otomatis mengikuti konfigurasi AI Odoo jika diaktifkan.
    
*   Pastikan dukungan multi-sales team (setiap pipeline bisa dibatasi ke team tertentu).

allWorkPackages.description:
Open Overlay Macro via command slash di textinbox input message di conversation dan ticket chat
## Minimum Requirements “Open Macro Overlay via / in text input”
### 1) Trigger & Overlay Behavior (Composer) * **FR-SL-001** Saat user mengetik karakter `/` di chat input, sistem **munculkan overlay auto-complete list** macros. PRD * **FR-SL-002** Overlay **filter** berdasarkan teks setelah `/` (prefix match minimal). * **FR-SL-003** User bisa pilih macro via: * click item, atau * keyboard: ↑/↓ navigasi, Enter select, Esc close. * **FR-SL-004** Setelah select, sistem **insert macro message** ke input (tidak auto-send). PRD * **FR-SL-005** Overlay bekerja di **Conversation composer** dan **Ticket chat composer** (same component/behavior). > Lean trigger rule (recommended): aktifkan overlay hanya jika `/` berada di **awal input** atau setelah **whitespace/newline** (mengurangi false-trigger saat user nulis URL/path). ### 2) Macro Data & Validation (Existing) * **FR-SL-006** Macro punya: * `shortcut` **required**, **must start with** `**/**`, **unique**, max **30 chars**, allowed **alphanumeric + underscore**. PRD PRD * `message` **required**, multiline, max **2000 chars**. PRD * **FR-SL-007** Setelah macro dipilih, sistem **replace dynamic variables** (mis. `{customer_name}`); jika data kosong, pakai fallback text (mis. “customer”). PRD ### 3) Visibility Scope (Filtering list) * **FR-SL-008** List overlay hanya menampilkan macros yang relevan untuk user: * **Global** * **Team-specific** * **Channel-specific** (mis. WhatsApp, Live Chat) PRD PRD * **FR-SL-009** Untuk Ticket chat: minimal sama konsep scope; jika ticket “channel” tidak applicable, default ke **Global + Team-specific**. ### 4) Permissions (RBAC) * **FR-SL-010** Akses **create/edit** macro mengikuti permission **Manage Shared Macros** (Admin/Supervisor). PRD PRD * **FR-SL-011** Agent **boleh menggunakan** macros via overlay (insert), tanpa permission manage. PRD PRD ### 5) Performance & UX Guardrails * **FR-SL-012** Search/filter response overlay ≤ **1s** untuk update list (client-side filtering ideal). PRD * **FR-SL-013** Jika tidak ada hasil: tampilkan state “No macros found”. * **FR-SL-014** Jika gagal load macros: tampilkan “Failed to load macros” + retry (minimal). ### 6) Edge Cases (Minimum) * **EC-SL-001** Input cuma `/` → tampilkan list default (top N, alphabetical). * **EC-SL-002** User lanjut mengetik spasi setelah `/query` → overlay close. * **EC-SL-003** Multi-line input: `/` di line baru tetap trigger (opsional tapi cheap). * **EC-SL-004** Macro dipilih lalu user edit manual → tidak ada constraint. * **EC-SL-005** Variable tidak tersedia (mis. ticket tidak punya `order_number`) → fallback text. PRD

PRD: [https://docs.google.com/document/d/1i1H3r4OCqQUd9cmSZtkEVHqjcMFtXlF4xGeH6\_Z4eE0/edit?tab=t.ajin4elh8xl#heading=h.ipijlllyp0d](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1i1H3r4OCqQUd9cmSZtkEVHqjcMFtXlF4xGeH6_Z4eE0/edit?tab=t.ajin4elh8xl#heading=h.ipijlllyp0d) 

This PRD defines a lightweight outbound webhook integration that keeps an external ticket frontend in sync with Satuinbox at the ticket level. The scope covers four core events—`TICKET_CREATED`, `TICKET_UPDATED` (status, assignment/ownership, and field changes), `MESSAGE_CREATED` (replies with attachment metadata), and `TICKET_DELETED` (soft delete)—with retry-safe delivery via stable `event_id`, ordering support via timestamps, and basic admin controls for configuring endpoints, selecting events, testing delivery, and viewing logs. The goal is to minimize mismatches between systems while staying simple enough for fast, agile implementation.

Implement Open API endpoints for **standalone tickets** in Satuinbox (source=`open_api`) so external systems can **create tickets**, **post timeline messages** with `send_to_customer` controlling `public` vs `internal` visibility, **update ticket metadata/status**, and **list messages** with strict audience filtering (`client` returns public-only; `agent` returns public+internal). The API must support **external identifiers** (`external_namespace`, `external_ticket_id`, `external_client_id`) for mapping while enforcing **Satuinbox** `**ticket_id**` **as the canonical identifier**, require **idempotency** for create ticket and create message, store **external actor attribution** (`actor.user_type`, `id`, `name`, optional `organization`), and support **attachments via HTTPS file\_url ingestion** with validation (max redirects, block private networks, size limits) and consistent JSON error responses.

allWorkPackages.description:
Dokumentasi : https://docs.google.com/document/d/15f0P6hv3ReXAF5CrRvkvea4mlLvuqh1WOfQxrR5nCas/edit?tab=t.0 **Tech Stack**: * React Native (Expo) * TypeScript * State Management: Context / Zustand (pilih salah satu) * API: REST / GraphQL (disesuaikan backend) * Auth: JWT / Token-based ## 📌 Deskripsi Membuat inisialisasi aplikasi chat berbasis mobile menggunakan **React Native Expo** yang mencakup: 1. Fitur **Login pengguna** 2. Fitur **List Chat (daftar percakapan)** Aplikasi ini akan menjadi fondasi awal untuk pengembangan fitur chat lanjutan seperti messaging, realtime, dan notifikasi. ## 🎯 Scope Pekerjaan ### 1️⃣ Setup Project * Inisialisasi project menggunakan **Expo** * Setup TypeScript * Struktur folder standar:
`src/` `├─ screens/`  `├─ components/`  `├─ services/`  `├─ store/`  `├─ utils/`  `└─ navigation/` ### 2️⃣ Fitur Login **User Story** > Sebagai user, saya ingin login ke aplikasi agar bisa mengakses daftar chat saya. **Fungsi** * Input: * Email / Username * Password * Tombol Login * Validasi form (required, format email) * Call API Login * Simpan token (SecureStore / AsyncStorage) * Redirect ke halaman List Chat jika berhasil **Acceptance Criteria** * User dapat mengisi email & password * Validasi error muncul jika input kosong / invalid * Login berhasil menyimpan token * User otomatis diarahkan ke halaman List Chat * Error API ditampilkan dengan pesan yang jelas ### 3️⃣ Fitur List Chat **User Story** > Sebagai user, saya ingin melihat daftar chat agar bisa memilih percakapan. **Fungsi** * Menampilkan list percakapan: * Foto avatar * Nama user / group * Last message * Timestamp * Fetch data dari API * Loading state & empty state * Pull to refresh **Acceptance Criteria** * List chat tampil sesuai response API * Loading indicator muncul saat fetch data * Empty state muncul jika belum ada chat * Data refresh saat pull down ## 🔐 Authorization & Security * Token disimpan secara aman * API List Chat hanya bisa diakses jika user sudah login * Redirect ke Login jika token invalid / expired ## 🧪 Testing * Manual testing: * Login success & failed * Token expired * List chat kosong * Optional: * Unit test untuk auth service ## 📦 Output * Aplikasi Expo berjalan di Android & iOS * User bisa login * User bisa melihat daftar chat * Struktur project siap untuk fitur chat selanjutnya

allWorkPackages.subject: Create Test Case + Acceptance Criteria Ticket - Bulk Reply
allWorkPackages.description:
**Acceptance Criteria:**

1.  Bulk Reply Action
    
    1.  available from ticket list bulk action bar
        
    2.  enabled when one or more tickets are selected
        
    3.  applicable for tickets with status **open** and **closed**
        
    4.  clicking action opens **bulk reply modal**
        
    5.  modal opens centered with backdrop
        
    6.  modal is dismissible via :
        
        1.  cancel button
            
        2.  click outside modal
            
        3.  ESC key
            
    7.  modal title : **Bulk Reply**
        
2.  Ticket Type Selection
    
    1.  displayed as read only dropdown
        
    2.  default value is all when opened from tab "ALL"
        
    3.  auto-filled with active tab ticket type when opened from specific ticket type tab
        
    4.  user cannot change ticket type manually
        
    5.  ticket type determines :
        
        1.  identifier availability
            
        2.  identifier label
            
        3.  template structure
            
    6.  affects downloadable template structure
        
    7.  switching tab and reopening modal resets ticket type accordingly
        
3.  Identifier Configuration
    
    1.  default identifier is Ticket ID
        
    2.  identifier dropdown is enabled
        
    3.  available identifier types :
        
        1.  ticket ID
            
        2.  custom field
            
    4.  custom field list :
        
        1.  populated based on selected ticket type
            
        2.  only includes filed type
            
            1.  text
                
            2.  options (single select)
                
    5.  calendar and image type fields are not selectable
        
    6.  when ticket type = **ALL :**
        
        1.  identifier is locked to **Ticket ID**
            
        2.  custom field option is hidden or disabled
            
        3.  helper info message displayed
            
            1.  identifier suport 'ticket id' only on tab ALL
                
    7.  when ticket type = specific type :
        
        1.  user can select **Custom Field**
            
        2.  custom field selector appears after selecting custom field
            
        3.  field selector is required
            
4.  Selected Tickets List
    
    1.  displayed as scrollable list
        
    2.  displays total selected count at the top
        
    3.  each row shows :
        
        1.  ticket title
            
        2.  identifier value
            
        3.  identifier type lable
            
    4.  identifier value dynamically updates when identifier changes
        
    5.  each row has remove (x) action
        
    6.  removing a ticket :
        
        1.  updates selected count
            
        2.  removes ticket from bulk job
            
    7.  if all tickets are removed :
        
        1.  submit button is disabled
            
        2.  empty state message shown
            
5.  Upload Reply File
    
    1.  upload reply :
        
        1.  accepts only .xlsx file
            
        2.  required columns :
            
            1.  identifier
                
            2.  reply
                
        3.  upload supports :
            
            1.  click to upload
                
            2.  drag and drop
                
        4.  system validates file before job creation
            
    2.  file validation :
        
        1.  block upload if required columns are missing
            
        2.  block upload if file size > 10 MB
            
        3.  block upload if total rows > 5000
            
        4.  block rows with empty identifier
            
        5.  block rows with empty reply
            
        6.  show clear error message per validation failure
            
6.  Template Download
    
    1.  download template always produces a **.xlsx** file
        
    2.  when bulk reply modal is opened without selected tickets:
        
        1.  active ticket type tab (all or specific ticket type)
            
    3.  identifier column:
        
        1.  uses **Ticket ID** when ticket type = all
            
        2.  uses selected identifier when ticket type = specific ticket type
            
    4.  when bulk reply modal is opened with **selected tickets**:
        
        1.  downloaded template is generated based on selected ticket
            
        2.  identifier column reflects the selected identifier:
            
            1.  Ticket ID -> uses ticket ID values
                
            2.  custom field -> uses selected custom field values
                
        3.  resulting template fields are consistent with the selected identifier
            
    5.  when downloading template from bulk toolbar under selected ticket list:
        
        1.  downloaded template result is identical to downloading template after selecting tickets first
            
    6.  for the same identifier selection:
        
        1.  downloaded template structure is consistent
            
        2.  regardless of where the bulk action is triggered
            
7.  Visibility Configuration
    
    1.  single visibility setting for entire bulk job
        
    2.  checkbox label : **Send To Costumer**
        
    3.  default state :
        
        1.  checked for agent
            
        2.  forced checked for client user
            
    4.  behavior
        
        1.  checked -> all replies are **public**
            
        2.  unchecked -> all replied are **internal notes**
            
    5.  helper text explains visibility impact
        
    6.  client user cannot submit job with unchecked visibility
        
8.  Submit Bulk Reply
    
    1.  submit action is unabled
        
        1.  submit button is disabled until :
            
            1.  identifier selected
                
            2.  valid file uploaded
                
        2.  clicking submit :
            
            1.  creates bulk reply job
                
            2.  starts asynchronous processing
                
            3.  redirects user to jojb progress view
                
    2.  submit action is disabled
        
        1.  submit button disabled when :
            
            1.  no valid file uploaded
                
            2.  identifier not selected
                
            3.  selected ticket count = 0
                
        2.  submit button shows loading state when clicked
            
        3.  cancel button remains available until job starts
            
        4.  after submit :
            
            1.  modal closes
                
            2.  job creation request is sent once (no duplicate)
                
        5.  double submit is prevented
            
9.  Job Creation Result
    
    1.  after submit
        
        1.  system shows upload progress
            
        2.  job status displayed as :
            
            1.  queued
                
            2.  processing
                
            3.  completed
                
            4.  failed
                
        3.  progress counters updated in real time :
            
            1.  total rows
                
            2.  processed rows
                
            3.  success count
                
            4.  failed count
                
        4.  user can navigate away without stopping job
            
10.  Partial Failure Handling
     
     1.  row processing
         
         1.  rows processed sequentially or in batches
             
         2.  failure in one row does not stop processing
             
         3.  successful rows :
             
             1.  create reply message
                 
             2.  follow visibility setting
                 
         4.  failed rows :
             
             1.  do not create any message
                 
             2.  logged with clear error reason
                 
         5.  replies are creates only for successful rows
             
         6.  failed rows do not create any message
             
11.  Result Report
     
     1.  available when job is completed
         
     2.  accessible from progress panel
         
     3.  downloadable as **.xlsx**
         
     4.  report contains per row :
         
         1.  row number
             
         2.  identifier value
             
         3.  resolved ticket ID
             
         4.  status (success/failed)
             
         5.  message ID (if success)
             
         6.  error code (if failed)
             
         7.  error message (if failed)
             
     5.  report is read only
         
     6.  report available for 30 days

allWorkPackages.subject: Test Mobile Development Satu Inbox
allWorkPackages.description:
Dokumentasi : [https://docs.google.com/document/d/15f0P6hv3ReXAF5CrRvkvea4mlLvuqh1WOfQxrR5nCas/edit?tab=t.0](https://docs.google.com/document/d/15f0P6hv3ReXAF5CrRvkvea4mlLvuqh1WOfQxrR5nCas/edit?tab=t.0)

**Tech Stack**:

*   React Native (Expo)
    
*   TypeScript
    
*   State Management: Context / Zustand (pilih salah satu)
    
*   API: REST / GraphQL (disesuaikan backend)
    
*   Auth: JWT / Token-based
    

## **📌 Deskripsi**

Membuat inisialisasi aplikasi chat berbasis mobile menggunakan **React Native Expo** yang mencakup:

1.  Fitur **Login pengguna**
    
2.  Fitur **List Chat (daftar percakapan)**
    

Aplikasi ini akan menjadi fondasi awal untuk pengembangan fitur chat lanjutan seperti messaging, realtime, dan notifikasi.

## **🎯 Scope Pekerjaan**

### **1️⃣ Setup Project**

*   Inisialisasi project menggunakan **Expo**
    
*   Setup TypeScript
    
*   Struktur folder standar:
    
    `src/`  
     `├─ screens/`  
     `├─ components/`  
     `├─ services/`  
     `├─ store/`  
     `├─ utils/`  
     `└─ navigation/`
    

### **2️⃣ Fitur Login**

**User Story**

> _Sebagai user, saya ingin login ke aplikasi agar bisa mengakses daftar chat saya._

**Fungsi**

*   Input:
    
    *   Email / Username
        
    *   Password
        
*   Tombol Login
    
*   Validasi form (required, format email)
    
*   Call API Login
    
*   Simpan token (SecureStore / AsyncStorage)
    
*   Redirect ke halaman List Chat jika berhasil
    

**Acceptance Criteria**

*   User dapat mengisi email & password
    
*   Validasi error muncul jika input kosong / invalid
    
*   Login berhasil menyimpan token
    
*   User otomatis diarahkan ke halaman List Chat
    
*   Error API ditampilkan dengan pesan yang jelas
    

### **3️⃣ Fitur List Chat**

**User Story**

> _Sebagai user, saya ingin melihat daftar chat agar bisa memilih percakapan._

**Fungsi**

*   Menampilkan list percakapan:
    
    *   Foto avatar
        
    *   Nama user / group
        
    *   Last message
        
    *   Timestamp
        
*   Fetch data dari API
    
*   Loading state & empty state
    
*   Pull to refresh
    

**Acceptance Criteria**

*   List chat tampil sesuai response API
    
*   Loading indicator muncul saat fetch data
    
*   Empty state muncul jika belum ada chat
    
*   Data refresh saat pull down
    

## **🔐 Authorization & Security**

*   Token disimpan secara aman
    
*   API List Chat hanya bisa diakses jika user sudah login
    
*   Redirect ke Login jika token invalid / expired
    

## **🧪 Testing**

*   Manual testing:
    
    *   Login success & failed
        
    *   Token expired
        
    *   List chat kosong
        
*   Optional:
    
    *   Unit test untuk auth service
        

## **📦 Output**

*   Aplikasi Expo berjalan di Android & iOS
    
*   User bisa login
    
*   User bisa melihat daftar chat
    
*   Struktur project siap untuk fitur chat selanjutnya

allWorkPackages.subject: [SATUINBOX] Implementasi Widget Chat V2 dengan Backward Compatibility untuk Marketplace
allWorkPackages.description:
### Description

Develop dan deploy widget chat v2 yang mendukung tipe **Widget** dan **Marketplace** dengan memastikan backward compatibility terhadap integrasi existing di partner (Salfok).

PRD: [https://docs.google.com/document/d/1i1H3r4OCqQUd9cmSZtkEVHqjcMFtXlF4xGeH6\_Z4eE0/edit?tab=t.fanb3g9y3hhg#heading=h.xpci5mttzgp1](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1i1H3r4OCqQUd9cmSZtkEVHqjcMFtXlF4xGeH6_Z4eE0/edit?tab=t.fanb3g9y3hhg#heading=h.xpci5mttzgp1) 

### Acceptance Criteria

#### Widget Script v2 harus support command existing:

*   [ ] `window.$satuinbox.push(['set', 'session-marketplace', session])`
*   [ ] `window.$satuinbox.push(['toggle-widget', 'marketplace', payload])`
*   [ ] `window.$satuinbox.push(['hide', 'widgets', { hide: boolean }])`

#### Session Payload harus tetap mendukung:

`{`

`customerId: string`

`email: string`

`fullname: string`

`phoneNumber: string`

`role: 'seller' | 'buyer' | 'affiliate'`

`}`

#### Toggle Payload harus tetap mendukung:

`{`

`isOpen: boolean`

`openChatroom?: {`

`customerId: string`

`fullname: string`

`role: 'seller' | 'buyer' | 'affiliate'`

`}`

`}`

#### Config Interface harus tetap:

`window.__WIDGET_CONFIG__ = {`

`allowedOrigin: string`

`productName: string`

`version: string`

`licenseKey: string`

`}`

### Priority

**Critical**

### Notes

*   Output harus kompatibel dengan integrasi Salfok existing
    
*   Perubahan minimal di sisi partner adalah goal utama
    
*   Dokumentasi migrasi wajib disediakan sebelum deployment
